title: Manufacturing Supervisor - Day Shift
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

About the role:

As a Production Supervisor, you will implement and supervise activities in the production area at Takeda’s Round Lake, Illinois manufacturing facility, to ensure manufacturing goals and project deadlines are met while maintaining compliance with current good manufacturing practices (cGMPs), environmental health and safety (EHS) guidelines and any other regulations that could apply; focus is on optimization in the use of raw materials, equipment and employees in producing quality products; may monitor and oversees labor and capital expenditures; may assist in developing budgets; recommends manufacturing policies, procedures and programs.

How you will contribute:

  • Provide guidance, support, direction, and leadership through positive interactions with all employees during daily operations.

  • Supervise the day-to-day production, scheduling, staffing, material management, compliance, training and auditing activities – to meet customer requirements including deadlines and quality standards.

  • Interview, hire, coach, motivate, develop and discipline staff; conduct annual performance reviews for all team members; assist in setting performance objectives and development plans; monitors progress.

  • Review, approve, and manage documentation for batch and system records; assists in release of product for distribution; assists in meeting product release time goals.

  • Emphasize training programs designed to enable staff to consistently execute all manufacturing processes with strict compliance to cGMPs and EHS regulations.

  • Develop and implement performance measurement and internal auditing programs in order to routinely evaluate operation efficiency and quality; implements changes as needed based on assessments.

  • Perform/lead technical review, investigation and process improvement projects; provides manufacturing input into integration and validation of new equipment and processes.

  • Resolves technical, material and cGMP problems that may impact project deadlines; provides guidance and troubleshooting assistance as needed during a deviation in the process.

  • Represent the company during FDA inspections; provides information as necessary to FDA that establishes credibility and demonstrates compliance with cGMPs.

  • Perform daily gemba walks to engage with employees and ensure their following proper safety practices.

What you bring to Takeda:

  • High School Diploma or GED plus 4+ years of related experience OR Bachelors' degree in science, engineering or other related technical field and 2+ years of related experience. Some leadership experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated interpersonal and leadership skills with ability to interface well with other departments and lead effectively and efficiently in a team environment.

  • Experience working in an FDA regulated environment preferred. • In-depth process knowledge of related manufacturing equipment and processes.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a manufacturing plant setting.

  • Ability to analyze and interpret scientific and statistical data.

  • Have strong teamwork and communication skills, both verbally and written, good documentation skills, customer oriented, work safely and effectively under stressful conditions.

  • Strong professional writing skills and ability to prepare technical reports.

  • Experienced understanding of cGMPs and other regulatory guidelines applicable to the medical/pharmaceutical industry.

  • Strong assessment and troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to respond to detailed inquiries, and present information to groups and senior management.

  • May be required to supervise multiple groups/shifts.

  • Good computer skills. Proficient in MS Word, MS Excel.

How you will contribute:

At Takeda, our patients rely on us to deliver quality products. As a result, we must follow strict rules in our manufacturing facilities to ensure we are not endangering the quality of the product. In this role, you may:

  • Work in a controlled environment requiring special gowning and wear protective clothing over the head, face, hands, feet and body. This may include additional hearing protection for loud areas.

  • Need to remove all make-up, jewelry, contact lenses, nail polish and/or artificial fingernails while in the manufacturing environment.

  • Work in a cold, wet environment.

  • Work multiple shifts, including weekends, or be asked to work supplemental hours, as necessary.

  • Work around chemicals such as alcohol, acids, buffers and Celite that may require respiratory protection.

  • Must be willing and able to work aligned shift.

  • In general, the position requires a combination of sedentary work and walking around observing conditions in the facility.

  • Must be able to carry up to 30 lbs., lift up to 30lbs, push/pull up to 30lbs (with assistance of material handling equipment).

  • Must be able to stand and/or walk for an extended period over an 8–12-hour shift between rooms and across the site.

  • Indoor working conditions.

  • Will work around moving equipment and machinery.

  • Must be able to work overtime as required.

  • May be required to work in a confined area.

  • Some Clean Room and cool/hot storage conditions

More about us:

At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.

Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. We foster an inclusive, collaborative workplace, in which our teams are united by an unwavering commitment to deliver Better Health and a Brighter Future to people around the world.

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautic Systems is seeking a Staff Engineer-Reliability to join our diverse team in Melbourne, FL. This position will be full time, onsite.

The Staff Engineer- Reliability leads reliability engineering initiatives to improve uptime, reduce failure risk, and optimize lifecycle performance of critical operational assets. Drives data-informed decision-making across maintenance, operations, and program planning. Reports to Product Support leadership to ensure requirements meet Program objectives.

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide reliability subject matter expert advice on assigned program.

  • Review and disposition (as required) of system drawings in CAD, NX, Solidworks, specifications and other engineering technical data…includes Northrop Grumman, Supplier, and Government furnished technical data.

  • Perform detailed review and development of technical data to support development of Reliability Centered Maintenance assessments of avionics systems and complete airframes

  • Development of model for meeting MTTR and mission timeline requirements

  • Interface between the reliability organization and other functional elements of the capture program.

  • Provide advice to Systems Engineers regarding their responsibilities in accordance with the Reliability Program.

  • Will interface with other reliability related disciplines and will define the resources needed to perform reliability requirements.

  • Participate in reliability engineering reviews.

  • Create Basis of Estimates for capture efforts for the reliability discipline.

  • Conduct independent reliability analysis as deemed necessary.

  • Perform analysis of design solution reliability under provided requirements.

  • Work with multiple teams and cross-functional departments

  • Compiling reports, plans and presentations for project leaders

Basic Qualifications

  • 12 Years with Bachelors in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math (STEM); 10 Years with Masters; 8 Years with PhD

  • Experience with Root Cause Analysis, FRACAS, FMEA/ FMECA or related Reliability Engineering work

  • Experience with reading and understanding technical data (e.g., Technical Orders, Engineering Drawings, Parts Lists, Bills of Material, Engineering Specifications, etc.)

  • Exercising a high degree of initiative and exhibiting advance organization skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to achieve high performance standards without supervision.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve a variety of problems of moderate scope and complexity.

  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fluid environment with diverse stakeholders.

  • Understanding of logistic elements; maintainability, supportability, and reliability.

  • Understanding of CAMEO requirement management

  • Experience in aviation maintenance, maintenance planning, manufacturing, or design

  • Must have ability to obtain and maintain U.S. Government Secret clearance and ability to be eligibility for Top Secret

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active U.S. Government Secret clearance

  • Active U.S. Government Top Secret clearance

  • Practical hands-on experience performing: Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, FRACAS, ESS, Reliability Testing, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA/FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis, sparing analysis, and related engineering work.

  • Experience with or exposure to digital design initiatives and solutions to include Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Model Based Sustainment (MBS)

  • Experience using CAMEO Enterprise Architecture

  • Experience with Life Cycle Cost Analysis and Modeling/Simulation

  • Min 3 years of technical experience in Logistics Engineering (Reliability / Maintainability / Sustainability)

  • Candidate must have an understanding of the either or both S-Series Standards/Mil-STD 1388 (defunct)

  • Significant experience in military, government, commercial aerospace industry (e.g. aviation/equipment maintenance, aircraft operations, or commercial industrial technology companies)

  • Knowledge of Military Specifications, Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs), Data Item Descriptions (DIDs) and other related technical and contractual documents

  • Experience in completing detailed risk analysis.

  • Experience in completing Basis of Estimates (BOE).

  • Prior experience with Capture Development / Capture Teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.

Primary Level Salary Range: $139,000.00 - $208,600.00

title: Network Engineer
description:
Description

The Sr Network Engineer administers and supports the company’s global data communications network. The position includes design, development, installation, proactive monitoring, optimization, maintenance and support of all network hardware, software, policies, procedures, and associated systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop fully executable network designs based on the concepts, planning and requirements developed by Network Architects

• Ensure that all network designs and deployments are fully documented and supportable by the Network Engineering staff

• Serve as the network subject matter expert for the engineering, configuration, deployment, and operational maintenance for all technologies in the network space including but not limited to – Azure on-ramp/express route, Azure subscription networking, Campus, Plant LAN, Wireless, WAN/SD-WAN, Datacenter LAN

• Troubleshoot escalated issues to identify and repair complex network issues for Cloud, WAN, LAN, Voice, Video, Internet connections and end-user issues

• Communicate and coordinate network maintenance, operational status, and downtime to users and management as per established change management process and procedures

• Ensure that the development of business continuity and disaster recovery plans are supportable, maintain current knowledge of plan executables, and respond to emergency network outages in accordance with the plans

• Perform analysis of network needs and contribute to design, network architecture, integration, and installation

• Participate as a lead in the implementation of projects, taking direction from Network Architects and/or project leads

• Prepare and maintain documentation of network standards, configurations, procedures and cabling layouts

• Ensure via collaboration with internal IT Security as well as external OEMs and vendors that network security hardening/compliance is integrated into all designs and operational remediation

• Provide technical mentoring to team members and foster a continuous improvement mindset

• Monitor and identify network capacity and performance issues to maximize efficiency of company communication systems

• Perform system and equipment audits

• Recommend network design changes based upon system review, test results, monitoring data and company requirements

COMPETENCIES

• Collaboration

• Communication

• Continuous Improvement

• Decision Making

• On-going Learning

• Personal Accountability

• Trust & Reliability

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in computer science, information systems, or related field of study and experience working in a multi-network, multi-protocol environment

• Requires one of the following:

o Cisco CCNP certification, or

o Extensive advanced network routing and switching experience

• Experience with OSPF/EIGRP/Spanning Tree protocols

• Experience with BGP and OSPF routing protocols

• Experience and comprehensive knowledge in two or more of the following areas: Cloud (Azure, AWS) networking, Routing and Switching, Security (Firewalls, Proxy technology), Wireless, Data Center, Video/Voice, SD-WAN

• Experience with Cisco ACI design, configuration, and operations

• Experience implementing and operating a security architecture that secures all corporate enterprise network edges (both ingress and egress)

• Experience creating and maintaining network topology, logical flow and other required documentation with Visio or equivalent tool

• Strong understanding of network QOS methods, markings and mitigation strategies

• Demonstrated experience conducting research and resolving issues across a wide range of networking, telephony, video, security, and wireless issues

• Experience with Network Sniffers to analyze data and resolve network issues

• Experience analyzing network performance data to identify trends/potential problems and providing recommendations to modify and/or upgrade network equipment or services

• Ability to maintain composure and adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced, customer-focused work environment characterized by rapid change, minimal lead times, and multiple competing priorities

• Excellent customer service orientation acting as a positive solution provider for all business and technical encounters

• Excellent verbal and written skills necessary to communicate intricate job-related processes

• Ability to articulate technical and non-technical information to personnel with varying levels of technical knowledge

• Cisco CCIE certification, preferred

• Cisco Central Platform Management experience, preferred

PHYSICAL DEMANDS, WORK ENVIRONMENT AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS

• Up to 25% domestic and international travel

• Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s license and passport

• Requires a favorable motor vehicle report upon hire

• Availability to be on call 24/7 as part of an on-call rotation

description:

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems sector is looking for a Principal Crew and Equipment Design Engineer / Sr. Principal Crew and Equipment Design Engineer with experience in Design and integration in the Aerospace industry to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals. This role is located in Melbourne, FL. This position is fully onsite with no remote work available.

Essential Functions:

  • Develops ICDs, creates layouts, machined parts, sheet metal details, and installs of system equipment (LRU)

  • Uses NX for 3D Model-Based Definition and releases engineering packages using Teamcenter CPLM

  • Experienced in leading and/or mentoring others

  • Working independently under general supervision and as part of a large multi-disciplined team.

  • Collaborate with inter-departmental vehicle sub-system departments including aircraft structure, electrical installation, hydraulics, environmental control systems, and manufacturing teams

  • Facilitating design reviews with key stakeholders to ensure designs meet requirements.

  • Ability to work with suppliers for integration activities

  • Selected candidates should thrive in a fast-paced work environment with high expectations, significantly diverse assignments, and collaborative/team settings across all levels.

  • Candidates must be self-starters capable of flourishing in an environment with minimal direction. Working independently under general supervision and as part of a large multi-disciplined team.

  • Collaborate with inter-departmental vehicle sub-system departments including aircraft structure, electrical installation, hydraulics, environmental control systems, and manufacturing teams.

  • Facilitating design reviews with key stakeholders to ensure designs meet requirements.

  • Attending internal program, customer and/or supplier technical exchange meetings and/or formal program milestone reviews to provide and/or obtain progress status updates.

This role may be filled as a Crew & Equipment Principal Engineer (Level 3) or Sr. Principal Engineer (Level 4) based on the qualifications outlined below.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Basic qualifications for a Principal Engineer include a Bachelor's in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math (STEM) and at least 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree in STEM with 3 years of experience, or a PhD Degree with no experience.

  • Basic qualifications for a Sr. Principal Engineer include a Bachelor's in Science, Technology, Engineering or Math (STEM) and at least 8 years of experience, a Master's Degree in STEM with 6 years of experience, or a PhD Degree with 3 years of experience.

  • Must have an active US Government Secret or higher clearance (with a background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation)

  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance prior to the commencement of employment

  • Experience leading others.

  • Experience in delivering complex technical solutions, within cost and schedule constraints, across the various phases of the engineering lifecycle.

  • Experience interpreting component detail drawings, specifications and assembly drawings.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active In-Scope US Government Top Secret clearance

  • Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.

  • Experience with the design, analysis and integration of equipment/ LRU's onto a platform.

  • Experience with CAD software NX

  • Experience with Teamcenter PLM

  • Experience interpreting component detail drawings, specifications, installation drawings, and test procedures.

  • Experience in delivering complex technical solutions, within cost and schedule constraints, across the various phases of the engineering lifecycle.

Operate and maintain mechanical cage washers and bulk autoclaves in accordance with departmental SOPs to sanitize/sterilize animal caging and related equipment. Sanitize animal research procedure labs and support spaces according to departmental SOPs and in accordance with guidelines of Animal Welfare Act and Public Health Service. title: Director of Reinsurance and Capacity
description:
Steadily is an insurance technology company that specializes in rental property insurance for landlords. We’re four years old, just over 160 people, manage $20B in risk, and are intent on becoming the world’s best and largest insurer of rental properties.

We exist to deliver fast, affordable insurance and to pay claims quickly and fairly. To do that, we hire the best engineers, actuaries, sales, and service people in the country to build the experience that we’d want if we were the client.

Steadily is hiring a Head of Reinsurance and Capacity who will be responsible for laying the runway for us to continue to scale while also managing existing capacity relationships. If you thrive on complexity and lofty goals, this is the role for you. This is an opportunity to bend the growth curve of your career. You will get exposure that could take decades at more established companies. Since we only hire the best, if selected, you'll get to work alongside other team members who are as sharp as you are which will just serve to make you even sharper.

What You'll Do

  • Secure new capacity at favorable terms to enable the company to continue to scale rapidly while producing excellent loss ratios for our partners.

  • Successfully lead the renewal of numerous reinsurance programs and capacity contracts.

  • Manage the day-to-day interactions and relationships with capacity partners such as reinsurance brokers, fronting carriers, carriers, reinsurers, auditors, etc.

  • Lead the development of a partner portal to provide a best-in-class partnership experience.

  • Work closely with underwriting, claims, product, actuarial, and finance to ensure profitability and an overall excellent experience for customers.

  • Assume responsibility for enterprise projects to enhance understanding of how the company operates and drive results.

  • This position reports directly to the Chief Insurance Officer

  • Travel - 15%

Your Background

  • Experienced: You have at least 10 years of experience in reinsurance either as an reinsurance underwriter, a reinsurance broker, or managing reinsurance for a carrier/MGA. You have a lengthy rolodex of industry contacts. You are knowledgeable about property insurance, forecasting, catastrophe modeling, reinsurance terms and structures.

  • Nice to have: ARe and/or CFA

  • Self-Driven: You thrive under intense pressure and can manage a large workload and projects with minimal oversight. There is no task too small or beneath you; “that’s not my job” is not in your mantra. You are resourceful and will run through walls to get stuff done.

  • Communication: This role will require a significant amount of communication inside and outside of the organization. In many environments you will be the face of the company. You are an outstanding communicator and accustomed to working with senior executives.

  • Insurance: Extensive knowledge of the reinsurance and capacity ecosystem. You are familiar with catastrophe models for peak perils. Your knowledge allows you to seamlessly communicate with reinsurance underwriters, accountants, claims, underwriting, finance, etc.

  • Project Management: You have above average project management skills. You’re great at moving the ball forward on multiple projects simultaneously. You know how to get a deal across the finish line at financially favorable terms.

  • Hungry: You want to make the leap into an earlier-stage tech company to rapidly accelerate your growth. You want to roll up your sleeves and hustle – you are not looking for a traditional 9-5 job.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Top of market salary

  • Equity in the company

  • 3 weeks PTO + six federal holidays + 15 days work from home annually

  • Health insurance including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, HSA, FSA

  • 401K

Locations

  • Overland Park, KS

  • Austin, TX

  • Generous relocation package offered

Why Join Us

  • You'll be in good company. Our founders have three successful startups under their belt and have recruited a stellar team to match.

  • We pay top of market (see comp).

  • We're earlier stage, so you'll get to wear a lot of hats and shape product decisions.

  • We have a good time. Culture matters a ton to us.

  • We're growing fast and are exceptionally well-funded.

  • Steadily boasts a very unique culture that our teammates love. We call it like we see it and we’re nothing if not candid. Check out our culture deck to learn what we’re all about.

  • Steadily was awarded Comparably’s Best Company Leadership 2023, Best CEOs for Women 2023, and Best Company for Women 2022

We’re excited to meet you!

title: (Creative / Senior / Lead) Interior Designer
description:
Job Description

Work Arrangement

This role is categorized as on-site. Successful candidates are expected to work full time from the GM China Advanced Technical Center in Shanghai, China.

About GM China Design Studio

GM China Design Studio is both a production design studio and an advanced design studio. We shape meaningful vehicle experiences for GM brands serving customers in China and global markets, connecting near-term production programs with forward-looking exploration.

We are committed to creating an exceptional design environment where creativity, beauty, craftsmanship, and storytelling can thrive. Our designers work across disciplines and cultures to translate customer understanding, brand identity, emerging technologies, and new forms of mobility into compelling interior experiences.

About This Evergreen Requisition

This evergreen requisition is established for talent pipelining purposes. GM China Design Studio is building a long-term pipeline of exceptional Interior Designers across multiple levels, including Creative Designer, Senior Interior Designer, and Lead Interior Designer, in support of current and anticipated business needs.

We welcome applications from outstanding designers around the world who are interested in contributing to exciting production programs and advanced design work in our China studio. Depending on business needs and the candidate’s experience, future opportunities may involve different levels of responsibility, program scope, and creative leadership.

When submitting your application, please include:

  • An updated resume or CV.
  • An updated portfolio that clearly demonstrates your design thinking, creative process, visual communication, and relevant interior design capabilities.
  • Please ensure that your portfolio does not contain undisclosed, confidential, proprietary, or otherwise sensitive information, projects, or materials belonging to current or previous employers or clients.

After your application is submitted, our recruiting and design teams will review your materials. If there is alignment with a current or future opportunity, a recruiter will contact you to discuss potential next steps. Because this is an evergreen requisition, the timing of contact may vary according to business needs and the fit between your experience and upcoming opportunities.

If you do not meet every element listed below but are interested in exploring an opportunity with GM China Design Studio, we still encourage you to apply. We value distinctive creative perspectives, strong design potential, and the ability to contribute to a collaborative studio environment.

The Role -

Interior Designers in GM China Design Studio help define the future of in-vehicle experiences for China and global markets. Depending on level and experience, you may contribute to or lead interior design themes from early advanced exploration through production execution, creating solutions that are emotionally compelling, brand-relevant, user-centered, and technically achievable.

You will collaborate with designers and partners across UX/HMI, CMF, Studio Engineering, Vehicle Systems Engineering, Product Planning, Customer Research, and global design studios. The scope of your contribution may range from developing design proposals and visual narratives to directing programs, presenting to senior leadership, and mentoring other designers.

What You’ll Do

Your responsibilities may include the following, depending on your level, experience, and assigned program:

Creative Designer-level contribution

  • Develop interior design concepts, sketches, renderings, storyboards, and visual narratives under the guidance of more experienced designers.
  • Explore alternative design themes and spatial ideas that respond to brand direction, customer needs, technology opportunities, and program objectives.
  • Communicate interior concepts through strong 2D visualization, digital tools, VR/3D presentations, and other appropriate design media.
  • Support the development of interior proposals from early ideation toward digital models, CAS, clay, or other design representations.
  • Participate in design reviews, research activities, VR evaluations, and cross-functional discussions; incorporate feedback into refined design solutions.
  • Build understanding of design feasibility, ergonomics, safety, regulatory requirements, manufacturing processes, craftsmanship, and surface quality.

Senior Designer-level contribution

  • Independently develop and advance interior themes for assigned advanced or production programs, from early sketches through refined digital or physical design representations.
  • Translate brand strategy, China customer insights, competitive references, and technology roadmaps into differentiated interior concepts and cohesive customer experiences.
  • Create and communicate high-quality sketches, renderings, storyboards, digital models, VR/3D presentations, and design proposals that clearly explain spatial concepts, UX flows, materials, and atmosphere.
  • Partner with UX/HMI and CMF designers to integrate displays, lighting, controls, materials, sound, and other elements into a holistic interior experience.
  • Work with Studio Engineering, Vehicle Systems Engineering, Packaging, and other partners to balance creative ambition with feasibility, manufacturability, safety, ergonomics, regulatory requirements, quality, timing, and cost.
  • Prepare and present design proposals in studio reviews, Design Leadership Team reviews, Global Design Reviews, executive forums, and other program gateways.
  • Support customer clinics, design research, and VR evaluations by helping define stimuli, interpreting feedback, and translating learnings into actionable design directions.
  • Contribute to a collaborative studio culture by sharing expertise and providing informal guidance to less experienced designers when appropriate.

Lead Designer-level contribution

  • Define and drive the creative direction of assigned interior programs across advanced and production design phases, from early exploration through design freeze and production execution.
  • Establish clear design strategies and differentiated interior themes that express GM brand DNA while responding to China-specific customer needs, market dynamics, and innovation opportunities.
  • Direct the development and integration of interior design proposals across spatial experience, UX/HMI, CMF, lighting, controls, materials, sound, and other relevant domains.
  • Lead design alignment with Studio Engineering, Vehicle Systems Engineering, Packaging, Product Planning, Customer Research, and global design studios to deliver solutions that are compelling, feasible, and program-ready.
  • Represent GM China Design in key studio reviews, Design Leadership Team reviews, Global Design Reviews, customer clinics, VR evaluations, and executive design forums.
  • Guide design direction, review work, provide constructive feedback, and mentor designers across different experience levels.
  • Drive design deliverables and decision-making through the applicable Design GVDP process, maintaining alignment on timing, quality, craftsmanship, and leadership expectations.
  • Champion China-specific insights and innovation while supporting consistency with global brand language and design standards.
  • Contribute to advanced and exploratory work involving future cockpit concepts, new interaction models, AI- or data-enabled experiences, and emerging in-cabin technologies.

Contributions shared across levels

  • Maintain a strong awareness of automotive interior design, customer behavior, competitive benchmarks, design trends, materials, digital tools, and emerging technologies.
  • Apply a user-centered design mindset to different in-vehicle scenarios and customer needs.
  • Uphold high standards for proportion, composition, craftsmanship, surface quality, visual communication, and overall design coherence.
  • Engage constructively in a diverse, collaborative, and internationally connected studio environment.
  • Demonstrate discretion and respect for intellectual property and confidential information throughout the design process.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) :

We welcome designers with different career paths, backgrounds, and levels of experience. The following qualifications are intended to describe the capabilities that may be relevant to these opportunities rather than serve as a checklist that every applicant must fully satisfy.

  • A degree in Transportation Design, Automotive Design, Industrial Design, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience and a compelling portfolio may also be considered.
  • Experience in automotive, transportation, mobility, industrial, product, spatial, experience, or another closely related design field. The depth of experience expected will vary by level, from emerging design talent to experienced program and team leaders.
  • The ability to develop relevant and distinctive design concepts, themes, and proposals, with a clear connection between design intent, user experience, brand expression, and execution.
  • Strong 2D visual communication skills, including sketching, rendering, storytelling, presentation, and the ability to communicate design thinking clearly.
  • Experience with digital design tools, 3D visualization, digital modeling, VR, CAS, clay, or other methods used to develop and communicate interior design concepts. The specific toolset is less important than the quality of the design thinking and the ability to learn and adapt.
  • Conceptual thinking and the ability to explore multiple solutions while making clear design decisions.
  • An understanding of how interior design interacts with UX/HMI, CMF, engineering, packaging, manufacturing, ergonomics, safety, regulation, quality, and customer research.
  • A genuine interest in holistic design and the ability to contribute from early concept development through later-stage design refinement and execution.
  • The ability to understand customer needs in different scenarios and use design to improve the in-vehicle experience.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to give and receive feedback in a multicultural and cross-functional environment.
  • For more experienced opportunities: the ability to lead program direction, influence stakeholders, present to senior audiences, mentor designers, and connect creative ambition with business and technical realities.
  • For emerging opportunities: demonstrated design potential, curiosity, willingness to learn, and the ability to develop ideas through a thoughtful and visually compelling process.

Why Join GM China Design Studio

You will have the opportunity to work in a studio that connects advanced design exploration with real production impact. You will collaborate with colleagues across China and the global GM Design network, contribute to vehicle experiences for diverse customers, and help shape the next generation of automotive interiors through creativity, beauty, technology, and storytelling.

We are interested in meeting exceptional designers at different stages of their careers. Your portfolio, perspective, and potential may align with an opportunity even if your experience does not map perfectly to every item in this description.

title: AI Budget Development Prompt Engineer
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on AI Budget Development Consultant to help us automate one of our most time-intensive and manually driven business workflows using Perplexity Enterprise Pro — our enterprise AI platform. We have two core tools that currently operate independently — a Statement of Work spreadsheet that captures all the services, activities, assumptions, and effort estimates for a given clinical trial study, and a Life of Study budget workbook that captures the financial projections for that same study. Right now staff manually translate information between the two tools which is duplicative, time-consuming, and introduces variability and inconsistency — especially when protocol information is incomplete upfront.

Your job is to build a Perplexity-enabled solution that reads completed SOW content and automatically pre-populates Life of Study budget inputs — and vice versa — so that our managers and directors are refining a data-informed baseline rather than starting effort estimations from scratch every time. We have approximately 30 existing SOWs and years of historical Life of Study budgets across our active study portfolio that you will use as training examples to build and test the solution. The solution also needs to generate cost saving recommendations and flag items requiring closer review for budgeting accuracy — including areas where effort may be under-budgeted, over-budgeted, incomplete, or inconsistent with study assumptions.

This is a solo individual contributor role. There is no project manager. You own the work end to end from requirements gathering through solution development, proof of concept, implementation, and knowledge transfer

What You Will Do:

Review and deeply understand both the SOW workbook and the Life of Study budget workbook — their structure, data fields, logic, and how information flows between them

Define how Perplexity will be used to interpret and normalize SOW content into recommended Life of Study budget inputs including rules, prompts, exception handling, and required human review points

Build data mapping and business rules that connect SOW services, assumptions, units of work, estimated hours, and direct cost logic to Life of Study budget stages, effort allocation structures, and budget categories

Develop and test a prototype or minimum viable solution demonstrating how SOW information is translated into draft Life of Study budget inputs for user review and refinement

Build a review and exception framework that highlights recommended checkpoints for accuracy, missing information, unusual effort patterns, and potential under or over budgeting

Generate cost saving recommendations by analyzing how SOW services and assumptions drive Life of Study budget costs and identifying areas where effort or direct costs may be reduced with minimal impact to study quality

Test the solution using representative study scenarios and refine it for robustness, consistency, and operational usability

Manage your own project timeline, deliverables, and progress reporting to a small stakeholder group on a regular cadence

Develop documentation and knowledge transfer materials to support implementation and ongoing use and scaling of the solution after your engagement ends

What You Bring:

Hands-on AI solution building experience — you have actually built and deployed AI solutions from requirements through implementation with documented outcomes. Not a PM, not a product owner, not someone who manages teams that build AI. You do the work yourself

Prompt engineering within enterprise AI platforms — you build solutions inside a fixed platform rather than building custom infrastructure around it. You work within constraints rather than around them

Data mapping and business rules translation — you understand how structured data flows between tools and can codify those mapping rules into AI instructions that produce reliable structured outputs

Independent execution — you take general direction, build your own plan, manage your own timeline, and deliver without hand-holding

Strong communication — you keep stakeholders informed, surface blockers early, and troubleshoot quickly

Documentation and sustainability mindset — you build for the long term and produce knowledge transfer materials that allow teams to manage solutions independently after you leave

Nice to Haves

Perplexity Enterprise Pro experience:

Experience in regulated or compliance-heavy environments where data accuracy and auditability matter

Activity-based budgeting, effort estimation, or scope of work experience in any sector

Clinical trial, biotech, or life sciences background

Experience building exception handling and review frameworks

Familiarity with project portfolio management tools and workflows

Fast learner who can absorb domain knowledge quickly from subject matter experts

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

Experience building within enterprise AI platforms — Perplexity, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or similar. Works within platform constraints rather than building custom infrastructure around them

Structured output design — builds AI workflows that produce consistent, predictable outputs rather than freeform text

Spreadsheet and workbook fluency — understands how data is structured and flows between tools, foundational to building the SOW to LOS budget mapping logic

Proof of concept development — moves quickly from concept to working prototype and refines based on stakeholder feedback

Exception handling and validation logic — builds systems that flag anomalies, missing information, and items requiring human review rather than silently producing incorrect outputs

Basic data analysis — reviews historical data, identifies patterns, and uses those patterns to inform AI mapping logic and business rules

Domain Knowledge

Activity-based budgeting or effort estimation experience in any sector — Jason confirmed this is highly portable across industries

Familiarity with statements of work or scope of work documents in a professional services or consulting context

Experience in regulated or compliance-heavy environments where data accuracy and auditability matter

Project portfolio management familiarity

Soft Skills

Comfortable with ambiguity — works with incomplete information, makes reasonable assumptions, and flags gaps rather than stalling

Fast learner — absorbs domain knowledge quickly from subject matter experts given the tight November 30th deadline

Detail oriented — budget errors have real financial consequences for clinical trials

Sustainability mindset — builds with handoff in mind from day one, documentation is a core deliverable not an afterthought

Proactive communicator — surfaces blockers early and keeps a small stakeholder group aligned without being asked

description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:

1. Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
2. Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.

3. Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.

4. Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.

5. Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.

6. Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.

7. Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.

8. Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
9. Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Other Responsibilities:
1. Completes various accounting, financial, administrative, and other reports and performs other duties as assigned or as necessary.

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.

title: Order Processing Specialist
description:
About the role:

Founded in 1995, Vastian is the leading provider of healthcare and laboratory quality, compliance and accreditation solutions, powering laboratories and hospitals to achieve better clarity and show their higher standards. Its single, configurable integrated platform delivers a standardized, centralized solution that automates quality and compliance tasks and is fully customizable. With Vastian, health systems and labs can get ahead of compliance and quality processes, saving time that can be spent on delivering better care. Vastian is a private equity backed, fast-growing SaaS business based in Lawrenceville, GA, outside Atlanta.

Click here to learn more about Vastian and our suite of solutions.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Order Processing Specialist to join our dynamic SaaS company. In this high-volume, fast-paced role, you will manage straightforward client transactions such as course orders, renewals, and simple service requests. By handling these administrative tasks, you will enable our Account Managers to focus on complex client needs. This role is critical in ensuring a seamless client experience and efficient order management.

In addition to a competitive base salary and performance bonus program, Vastian offers a comprehensive and very pro-employee benefits package which includes the following:

· Medical, dental and vision insurance

· Short- and long-term disability coverage

· Life insurance and AD&D

· Supplemental life insurance

· 401(k) savings plan

· Paid time off

Responsibilities and Duties:

· Process a high volume of client orders accurately and on time - course purchases, flat-rate renewals, and straightforward service changes - in a fast-paced environment where turnaround directly affects the client experience.

· Own a case queue in Salesforce: triage incoming requests, work them to resolution, and keep the queue current.

· Partner directly with Account Managers as day-to-day operational support, taking routine

transactions off their plate so they can focus on complex client needs and growth.

· Put the customer first on every interaction - respond promptly and professionally, follow through until a request is fully closed, and escalate quickly when something needs a decision.

· Maintain accurate order and account data in Salesforce, catching discrepancies and incomplete information before they reach billing.

· Coordinate with Finance to support billing accuracy, invoice generation, and clean revenue data.

· Speak up when a process isn't working. We are a small team, and we expect people to raise problems and propose fixes rather than build workarounds.

· Jump in where the team needs coverage. Priorities shift, and we want someone comfortable with that.

Qualifications:

· 3+ years in order processing, sales operations, customer support, or a similar role, ideally in SaaS or another subscription business.

· Hands-on Salesforce experience, including working from a case- or queue-based workflow.

· Demonstrated ability to work accurately at volume - this role is measured on both throughput and error rate.

· Exceptional attention to detail: you catch the wrong quantity, the date that doesn't match the contract, the renewal term that doesn't make sense.

· Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the judgment to know what has to move today and what can wait.

· Clear, professional written and verbal communication with clients and internal partners.

· Comfort in a small-company environment - no large support org behind you, shifting priorities, and real ability to influence how things get done.

· A collaborative, positive attitude and a willingness to pitch in outside a job description.

· Experience supporting Account Managers or a client-facing sales team.

· Familiarity with subscription or recurring billing models is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.



We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.





Job Description

Summary:

Waters Biosciences is seeking a Build and Release/DevOps Engineer with solid DevOps hands-on experience to join our exciting and growing team. At Waters Biosciences, you will have the opportunity to create software applications that are used to help all people live healthy lives.

Our software portfolio powers industry-leading, groundbreaking medical instruments. The DevOps Engineer plays a key role in understanding our customer challenges and defining innovative solutions to solve them.

As a DevOps team, we are looking for an associate who’s made their mark in Software Engineering. As a software engineer in DevOps, you drove quality through principles and best practices. At the same time, you saw the value of continuous integration and deployment and had a desire to contribute. You feel the need to make things faster and more efficient. That is, you don’t just work hard; you work smart. You are a contributor of continuous improvement and can influence change.

As a Build and Release DevOps Engineer you will:

  • Work very closely and integrated with the Development community to adopt culture change.

  • Coordinate across global time-zones and diverse product lines

  • Together with a team of engineers, enable streamlined software development, by managing and owning the entire automated build pipeline, DevOps toolchain, Installers, and associated test environments from source control to software delivery.

  • Work with peer technical leaders and their teams to enable engineers to seamlessly create CI/CD pipelines for their software components.

  • Develop and maintain software installers.

  • Focus on continuously improving the DevOps tooling, software installers, and software delivery processes.

  • Own and maintain highly reliable environments and toolchains with clear communication and timeliness of any disruptions to internal stakeholders.

  • Leverage industry-standard techniques and processes to help enable and provide better feedback to the development community.

  • Monitor and continually improve the capacity of our production environments’ infrastructure

  • Investigate and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks

Essential Requirements:

  • Undergraduate degree in computer science, IT, software engineering, or similar

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Software Engineering roles as DevOps/Build and Release Engineer.

  • Expert in maintaining and managing software build infrastructure. (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, TravisCI, TFS, TeamForge, etc.)

  • Expert in creating, maintaining, and supporting automated build pipelines.

  • Expert in version control and source control management (Subversion, TFVC, Git)

  • Expert in deploying, managing, and maintaining at least 2 of the following SCM toolchain such as Jenkins, Artifactory, SonarQube, Nexus, TFS, Azure DevOps

  • Working knowledge of MSBuild

  • Strong understanding of programming skillsets, structure, and Versioning.

  • Experience with system management technologies such as Puppet, Ansible, Salt, or Chef.

  • Experience in Windows and Linux as build environments and optimizing which to use in different scenarios.

  • Experience with container technology and subsequent technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, Amazon ECS, Azure Service Fabric, Harbour, Helm, Packer, Terraform

  • Experience with building containers, deploying containers individually and at scale with orchestration, storing containers, and managing a registry

  • Experience in an object-oriented programming language (Java, C++, C#, etc..)

  • Experience in scripting languages such as bash, python, and Powershell.

  • Experience and knowledge of Microsoft system administration and networking.

  • Experience in managing a VMware-based virtualization environment or similar.

  • Experience in creating VM templates and deploying them at scale and tracking revisions.

  • Read and interpret YAML and json files.

  • Knowledge of test-driven development, software configuration management, and automated testing.

Highly Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with system management technologies such as Puppet, Ansible, Salt, or Chef.

  • Experience operating in a highly regulated industry.

  • Experience in managing an automated build pipeline for a mixed set of software assets.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written)

  • Can communicate the same concept in different ways to different stakeholders and partners (Product Owners, Quality Assurance, Developers, Sales, etc)

Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

This is a full-time, onsite contract opportunity and is ideal for someone interested in gaining experience within Human Resources. title: APP NEUROLOGY
description:
Position Title

APP NEUROLOGY

Varies

KU Clinical Research Center 4330

Position Summary / Career Interest:

The Advanced Practice Provider (APP) in the Neurology Department manages health problems and coordinates health care in Neurology specialty settings. These APPs deliver patient care and medical services to individuals, families and groups by utilizing standards of care in accordance with State and Federal rules and regulations to assess health status, diagnose medical conditions, develop medical plan of care, implement treatments and evaluate patient responses in collaboration with collaborative/sponsoring physician as described in a Collaborative Practice Agreement.

Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions
  • Able to evaluate medical problems of clients in the assigned specialty practice setting and appropriately requests consultation of other specialties when indicated
  • Provides education to patients and/or families about preventive care, medical issues and use of prescribed medical treatments and/or medications pertinent to the patient’s condition.
  • Creates diagnostically appropriate treatment plans
  • Documents all medical evaluation, diagnoses, procedures, treatments, outcomes, education, referrals and consultations consistent with NCQA, The Joint Commission, state regulatory standards and evidenced-based standards of care. Maintains documentation compliance for appropriate coding and billing.
  • Facilitates evaluation of records by physician(s), peers and quality standards according to protocols and receives and implements constructive directives.
  • May refer complex and high priority cases to collaborating physician with regards to complicated diagnostic problems, serious illness, complicated therapeutic problems and re-evaluation of chronic conditions.
  • Provides medical and emergency interventions appropriate to the client’s needs; prescribes and monitors medications appropriate to the diagnosis; orders and monitors the appropriateness of emergency interventions.
  • Maintains collegiality with all members of the inter-disciplinary team.
  • Utilizes appropriate chain-of-command and communicates with specialty practice Program Director, APP Director and Medical Director of any clinical issue and contributes to quality improvement or process improvement as necessary.
  • Must be able to perform the professional, clinical and or technical competencies of the assigned unit or department.
  • These statements are intended to describe the essential functions of the job and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Skills and duties may vary dependent upon your department or unit. Other duties may be assigned as required.

Required Education and Experience
  • Master's Degree OR
  • Doctorate from an accredited program in Advanced Practice Nursing for APRNs or Masters in Physician Assistant Studies (whichever is applicable).
  • Age appropriate training for “population served” may depend on APRN/PA program training and may require additional training as determined by the department.

Preferred Education and Experience
  • Previous APRN or PA experience is desired.

Required Licensure and Certification
  • Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - State Board of Nursing Copy of the current advance practice license for the State of Kansas and/or Missouri (depending on practice locations) – PA or APRN - APRNs may obtain within one year of date of hire; Specific certification may be required depending on specialty within 1 Year
  • Basic Cardiac Life Support (BLS or BCLS) - American Heart Association (AHA)

Preferred Licensure and Certification
  • Family Nurse Practitioner Certification (FNP-BC) - American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC)
  • Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) - State Board of Healing Arts

title: Project Manager
description:
Mechanical Services Project Manager

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Services Project Manager to lead commercial mechanical service projects from planning through closeout. This role is responsible for coordinating customers, field teams, subcontractors, vendors, schedules, budgets, documentation, and project deliverables to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, on time, and within scope.

Reporting Structure: Reports to the Director of Operations.

Key Responsibilities

· Manage mechanical service projects from initial scope review through completion, commissioning, punch list, and closeout.

· Develop project schedules, coordinate labor needs, and communicate timelines with customers, field supervisors, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors.

· Review drawings, specifications, estimates, proposals, contracts, and change orders to confirm project requirements and expectations.

· Track project budgets, costs, procurement, material delivery, labor productivity, and cost-to-complete forecasts.

· Prepare and manage RFIs, submittals, permits, change orders, progress updates, closeout documents, warranty information, and other project documentation.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing clear and timely communication throughout the project lifecycle.

· Coordinate equipment procurement, delivery, staging, and installation activities to support efficient field execution.

· Support safety compliance by reinforcing company policies, OSHA requirements, and jobsite best practices.

· Identify project risks, resolve issues proactively, and escalate concerns when needed to protect quality, schedule, and profitability.

· Lead project kickoff, progress, and closeout meetings with internal and external teams.

Required Qualifications

· Five or more years of project management experience in mechanical services, HVAC, plumbing, piping, construction, or a related field.

· Strong understanding of mechanical systems, service operations, project coordination, and field execution.

· Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and contract documents.

· Experience managing project budgets, schedules, subcontractors, vendors, and customer expectations.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, technicians, supervisors, and leadership.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management or construction management software.

· Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to customer sites and project locations as needed.

· Commitment to safety, quality, accountability, and customer service.

Preferred Qualifications

· Seven or more years of experience managing HVAC, plumbing, piping, or mechanical construction/service projects.

· Experience with design-build, retrofit, industrial, commercial, or facility services projects.

· OSHA 10, OSHA 30, PMP, NATE, trade license, or other relevant certifications.

· Experience with Procore, Viewpoint, Sage, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, or similar systems.

· Background as a mechanical technician, foreman, estimator, project engineer, or assistant project manager.

What We Offer

· Competitive compensation based on experience.

· Health, dental, and vision benefits.

· Paid time off and paid holidays.

· Retirement plan options.

· Company vehicle or vehicle allowance, if applicable.

· Training, certification support, and professional development opportunities.

· Opportunity to manage meaningful mechanical service projects with a skilled and supportive team.

About the Role

The Mechanical Services Project Manager will play a key role in delivering high-quality mechanical solutions while maintaining strong customer relationships and supporting profitable project execution. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, technically knowledgeable, and comfortable balancing office coordination with field communication.

title: Azure DevOps Analyst
description:
WE ARE HIRING: Azure DevOps Analyst

Location: Sri Lanka
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: Information Technology

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Azure DevOps Analyst to take ownership of Azure DevOps as an enterprise delivery platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for platform administration, governance, security management, process configuration, reporting, user enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives across the Azure DevOps ecosystem. This role requires a strong understanding of Azure DevOps administration, Agile delivery practices, governance frameworks, access management, reporting structures, and enterprise-scale platform design. The ideal candidate will possess both technical expertise and stakeholder engagement skills to ensure the platform remains secure, scalable, auditable, and aligned with organizational delivery objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and manage Azure DevOps organizations, projects, and enterprise configurations.
  • Manage user accounts, access levels, permissions, security groups, and role-based access controls.
  • Implement and maintain least-privilege access frameworks and governance controls.
  • Manage project-level, team-level, repository, pipeline, and service connection permissions.
  • Create and administer Azure DevOps teams while supporting organizational delivery structures.
  • Configure team backlogs, boards, sprint settings, capacity planning, and team-level settings.
  • Design and manage area paths, ownership models, and cross-team reporting frameworks.
  • Configure iteration paths, sprint calendars, release structures, and multi-team delivery cadences.
  • Administer Azure Boards inherited processes and associated configurations.
  • Create and modify work item types, workflows, states, fields, business rules, and process customizations.
  • Configure work item templates, backlog hierarchies, dependencies, and relationship structures.
  • Develop and maintain shared queries, dashboards, reporting structures, and query governance models.
  • Support program, portfolio, PMO, backlog, sprint, defect, test, release, and executive reporting requirements.
  • Manage platform notifications, subscriptions, and communication settings.
  • Configure and govern Azure DevOps integrations through service hooks, webhooks, and other connected services.
  • Assess, install, manage, and govern Azure Marketplace extensions while ensuring security and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain Azure DevOps administration standards, governance procedures, support documentation, and operational runbooks.
  • Conduct platform audits and ensure compliance with governance, security, and operational requirements.
  • Provide training, guidance, and best practice recommendations to users, teams, and administrators.
  • Drive platform adoption, data quality improvements, and continuous process enhancement initiatives.
  • Support stakeholders by ensuring Azure DevOps is effectively optimized for delivery, collaboration, reporting, and governance.

Candidate Profile

  • Proven hands-on experience administering Azure DevOps within enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of Azure DevOps organization management, project administration, and platform governance.
  • Experience managing permissions, security groups, user roles, and access control frameworks.
  • Strong experience configuring Azure Boards, backlogs, sprint management, and Agile delivery workflows.
  • Experience customizing work item types, fields, states, workflows, and inherited processes.
  • Strong knowledge of governance, auditability, reporting, compliance, and operational controls.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, queries, and executive-level performance tracking.
  • Experience managing integrations, service hooks, webhooks, and platform extensions.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and enterprise delivery methodologies.
  • Ability to evaluate platform design decisions and explain their impact on security, usability, supportability, reporting, and compliance.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience training users, supporting adoption initiatives, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently while engaging effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to governance and operational excellence.

title: Scientist II
description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.

We are seeking an accomplished and independent Scientist II to lead pharmacology efforts across our muscle biology programs. While this role focuses primarily on cardiac and cardiovascular indications, Cytokinetics’ mission spans muscle biology broadly, and the successful candidate may also contribute to programs targeting skeletal or other muscle-related disease areas.

The ideal candidate is a creative, scientifically rigorous investigator who takes primary ownership of research projects, designs and executes complex lines of investigation, and drives compound progression through preclinical development. This individual will analyze complex problems to reach useful conclusions, propose new therapeutic directions, and serve as a technical leader and mentor within a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary scientific lead on one or more pharmacology projects—primarily in cardiac and cardiovascular indications, and potentially in other muscle biology areas—independently conceiving, designing, and executing complex series of in vivo experiments to evaluate the efficacy of different compounds.

  • Analyze complex scientific problems, develop and execute new lines of investigation, and propose novel experimental approaches and potential therapeutic programs based on expert knowledge of scientific principles and disease biology.

  • Direct the design and oversight of in vivo pharmacology studies and downstream biochemical and molecular assays, including cohort planning, dosing strategy, and endpoint selection, ensuring full compliance with IACUC and institutional guidelines.

  • Quantify and interpret biomarkers of disease progression and target engagement, integrating functional and molecular endpoints to assess compound performance and inform go/no-go decisions.

  • Interact directly across functions, collaborating with discovery, DMPK, translational, and G&A teams to advance compounds through preclinical development and to contribute to project goals, timelines, and budgets.

  • Present original work formally at internal project reviews and external scientific meetings; author scientific papers and contribute to patent applications.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to associates and scientists; may supervise direct reports and administer performance reviews; may serve as a team leader on a project or project phase.

  • Proactively seek out new data and technologies to incorporate into projects, maintaining rigorous documentation of experimental methods, datasets, and results.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Biology, Physiology, Pharmacology, or a related scientific discipline (or equivalent experience), generally with 5+ years of relevant experience, including postdoctoral training. Prior experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology setting is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, and interpret complex research programs and to propose new scientific and therapeutic directions.

  • Expert proficiency in rodent handling and dosing (mouse and rat), including multiple routes of administration and survival surgery.

  • Experience with cardiac functional assessments (e.g., echocardiography, ECG, tail-cuff blood pressure measurements, telemetry or related techniques) is required.

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in biochemical and molecular biology assays, such as Western blotting, qPCR, immunohistochemistry, and enzyme-based assays.

  • Experience with mammalian cell culture or primary cardiomyocytes is a plus.

  • Track record of scientific achievement, including authorship of peer-reviewed publications and/or patents, and the ability to present original work formally at internal and external meetings.

  • Excellent ability to analyze, interpret, and clearly communicate complex datasets in written reports and oral presentations, and to build effective cross-disciplinary working relationships.

#LI-ONSITE

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Garmin Italy Technologies is now boarding a DevOps Engineer.


You are self-motivated, goal-oriented, and a strong team player committed to fostering a culture of continuous integration and delivery, providing automated technical solutions that drive efficiency and infrastructure reliability in a dynamic, high-performance environment.

We offer you the chance to join a team of professionals who all work together to achieve the best results for our customers. You will work with people with a pioneering spirit and passion for challenges.


What you'll do:

  • Provision and manage resilient cloud environments in Azure and AWS, leveraging automation to maintain the highest standards of security, performance, and availability.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate the deployment of Garmin cloud products and services.
  • Architect and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines that empower engineering teams to deploy code with confidence, consistency, and minimal manual intervention.
  • Gain experience with SW engineering and DevOps tools (such as monitoring, alerting and orchestration) as part of the Garmin development process.
  • Collaborate and add value through participation in architectural reviews, providing suggestions for automation, performance optimization, and scalability.

  • Work collaboratively within cross-functional teams (Developers, QA, and Architects) to achieve common goals.
