  • Bachelor’s Degree in technical disciplines (Computer Science, Engineering, or similar) and 2 years relevant experience as a DevOps Engineer.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Cloud platform and cloud services scalability best practices.
  • Familiarity of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) development, specifically with Bicep.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (containers orchestration).
  • Proficiency with scripting languages (e.G. PowerShell, Python, Bash).
  • Understanding of CI/CD principles and automation workflows.
  • Thorough understanding of computing fundamentals: networking, security, and operating systems (Linux/Windows).
  • Must be team-oriented, possess a positive attitude, and work well with others.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot infrastructure issues.
  • Fluent in English.


Bonus points if you have:

  • Knowledge of AWS cloud platform and the usage of CloudFormation.
  • Experience with ADO (Azure DevOps) / Git.
  • Knowledge of automation tools such as Jenkins or Zuul.
  • Database administration skills (SQL/NoSQL) and experience in managing data persistence layers.
  • Familiarity with marine environment technology, navigation and devices.
  • A true "geek" mindset: if you believe that any task done more than twice deserves a script, you'll fit right in.


Pay Range: €34.000 – €42.000


In accordance with the Directive (EU) 2023/970 on Pay Transparency, our organization is committed to ensuring equal pay for men and women for equal work or work of equal value.


Collective Bargaining Agreement applied: Collective Bargaining Agreement Metalworking Industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria)


Contract Level: C3


Our home: you can find us in via Fondacci 269 in Massarosa (LU), Italy.


Workplace type: on-site


Company:

Garmin® Italy Technologies produces electronic charts for the leisure boating market. Our mission is to delight our customer by producing market leading intuitive and innovative marine cartography content and features through the use of creativity, engineering excellence through market knowledge and efficient production procedures.

Our cartography is available to boaters for use in GPS chartplotters, and within our app for Apple® and Android™ devices.

It’s not about the things we make. It’s about the things we make possible.

Our office is based in Massarosa, Tuscany, the perfect starting point for reaching nearby cities of art, beaches and mountains.

With over 23,000 associates in 37 countries around the world, the Garmin® group brings GPS navigation and wearable technology to the automotive, aviation, marine, outdoor and fitness markets. At Garmin®, we like to work hard and play hard. It comes easy when you work on cool products with hard-working individuals who share the same passion. We think every day is an opportunity to innovate and a chance to beat yesterday.

See more at www.Garmin.Com

title: *NIGHTSHIFT* Connectivity Engineer
description:
Connectivity Engineer (Night Shift)

Location: New Albany, OH

Schedule: Wednesday-Sunday | 6:00 PM - 6:00 AM

Duration: 12-Month Contract (Potential Extension)

Work Environment: 100% Onsite

Overview

We are seeking a Connectivity Engineer to support one of the world's largest hyperscale data center campuses in New Albany, Ohio. This role will serve as the technical field lead for structured cabling and network infrastructure deployments, partnering with construction, engineering, logistics, and installation teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards.

The ideal candidate will have experience supporting data center construction or network deployment projects, with a strong background in fiber optic infrastructure, structured cabling, QA/QC inspections, vendor management, and schedule coordination.

This is a hands-on field role supporting overnight construction and deployment activities within a mission-critical data center environment.

Responsibilities

Project Planning & Construction Coordination

  • Track project milestones, schedules, and deployment activities across active data center construction projects.
  • Coordinate with installation partners, engineers, logistics teams, and project stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
  • Support schedule forecasting, material planning, and project reporting activities.
  • Identify schedule risks, field conflicts, and scope gaps and facilitate timely resolution.

Connectivity Infrastructure Delivery

  • Oversee structured cabling installations including fiber optic and copper infrastructure.
  • Review cable schedules, routing plans, port maps, BOMs, and installation drawings.
  • Support rack-and-stack, rack integration, in-row cabling, and network infrastructure deployments.
  • Validate installations against design standards and construction specifications.

Quality Assurance & Field Inspections

  • Conduct field inspections to ensure vendor work meets quality, safety, and design requirements.
  • Review fiber test reports, certifications, build accuracy, and labeling standards.
  • Perform installation validation, commissioning readiness reviews, and punch-list management.
  • Support First-of-Kind (FOK) installations and acceptance testing activities.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships with contractors, trade partners, engineers, and operations teams.
  • Manage day-to-day communication regarding project progress, risks, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate turnover activities between construction and operations teams.
  • Support issue escalation and rapid resolution of field challenges.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Track project status, milestones, risks, and change requests.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, QA/QC records, and installation reports.
  • Participate in turnover, commissioning, and readiness reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, network infrastructure, telecommunications, or mission-critical construction projects.
  • Experience with structured cabling, fiber optic infrastructure, and connectivity deployments.
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to interpret installation drawings, cable schedules, routing diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, or installation teams.
  • Experience performing QA/QC inspections or installation validation.
  • Strong organizational and scheduling skills.
  • Ability to work onsite Wednesday-Sunday from 6:00 PM-6:00 AM.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hyperscale data center environments (Meta, AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle, etc.).
  • Experience leading structured cabling or network deployment projects.
  • Experience with ISP and OSP fiber infrastructure.
  • Experience reviewing OTDR, OLTS, or fiber certification results.
  • Experience with rack integration, rack-and-stack, and in-row cabling.
  • Experience using Primavera P6.
  • Experience supporting commissioning and turnover activities.
  • Experience with FIM tools, port mapping, and infrastructure management platforms.
  • OSHA 30 certification.

Ideal Backgrounds

Candidates may come from roles such as:

  • Connectivity Engineer
  • Structured Cabling Supervisor
  • Structured Cabling Superintendent
  • Lead Low Voltage Technician
  • Data Center Technician
  • Fiber Engineer
  • Network Deployment Engineer
  • Connectivity Superintendent
  • QA/QC Coordinator
  • Data Center Construction Coordinator
  • Telecommunications Project Lead

Why This Opportunity?

  • Support a high-profile hyperscale data center campus.
  • Work directly with cutting-edge network and connectivity infrastructure.
  • Gain exposure to large-scale commissioning, deployment, and construction operations.
  • Join a collaborative environment focused on safety, quality, and technical excellence.

title: Restructuring Director – Private Credit
description:
Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients.

There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Place to Work 2025 & 2026'.

If this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on…

The Function & Team

The Credit & Risk team sits within the Group Risk & Compliance function and provides independent oversight across the Private Credit platform. Partnering with lending and portfolio management teams throughout the lending lifecycle, the team establishes and maintains the governance, frameworks and oversight that support consistent lending decisions, effective portfolio management and effective restructuring across all of Private Credit's lending strategies.

Credit & Risk team members work collaboratively across credit underwriting, portfolio monitoring, restructuring, recoveries and assurance, providing specialist expertise across all of Private Credit's lending strategies.

The Role's Key Responsibilities

Reports to: Head of Credit

Restructuring & Portfolio Management

  • Primary management of a portfolio of distressed, underperforming and strategic exit relationships across the Private Credit platform.
  • Develop and execute restructuring, recovery and exit strategies that balance commercial outcomes with investor protection.
  • Lead negotiations with borrowers, sponsors and advisers during restructuring situations.
  • Monitor performance against agreed restructuring plans and adapt strategies where circumstances change.
  • Partner with portfolio management teams on higher-risk portfolio relationships, providing restructuring expertise through advisory support and joint management where appropriate.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Work closely with existing Restructuring Directors to ensure a consistent approach across the combined portfolio, share expertise, and provide mutual cover during absence or peak workload.
  • Support the management and development of the team's Associate Director, contributing to caseload prioritisation, technical guidance and professional development.
  • Coach and support junior members of the wider Credit & Risk team on restructuring principles and distressed debt management.

Credit Governance & Portfolio Oversight

  • Present restructuring strategy recommendations to Credit Committee and other governance forums.
  • Support monthly portfolio reviews, watchlist meetings and Portfolio Monitoring Group reporting.
  • Contribute to portfolio-wide identification of emerging credit deterioration and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Participate in provisioning reviews and impairment assessments across the portfolio.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build effective relationships with portfolio management teams, origination teams and credit colleagues to ensure early identification of deteriorating credits.
  • Manage relationships with insolvency and restructuring advisers and other external specialists.
  • Negotiate with borrowers and key stakeholders to deliver commercially effective restructuring outcomes.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead projects aimed at improving restructuring processes, portfolio oversight and recoveries capability.
  • Support the Head of Credit in developing restructuring policies, frameworks and best practice.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of portfolio monitoring and early warning frameworks.

Experience

Essential

  • Extensive experience managing distressed lending, restructuring or recoveries within private credit, commercial banking, direct lending or restructuring advisory.
  • Strong understanding of commercial lending structures, including senior secured, asset-backed and property-backed lending.
  • Proven experience developing and executing restructuring and recovery strategies.
  • Experience presenting complex restructuring cases to Credit Committees or equivalent governance forums.
  • Experience negotiating and executing loan documentation, ideally to LMA standard.
  • Strong commercial judgement and ability to balance recovery outcomes with ongoing customer relationships.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
  • Strong financial analysis capability including cashflow forecasting, business viability assessment and downside analysis.

Desirable

  • Experience across multiple lending products including leveraged finance, specialty finance, funds finance and development finance.
  • Knowledge of insolvency legislation and formal restructuring processes.
  • Experience managing external legal advisers and insolvency practitioners.
  • Previous line management or mentoring experience.
  • Professional qualification in accountancy, banking, restructuring or insolvency.

Personal Qualities:

  • Calm and measured under pressure.
  • Commercially minded with strong analytical judgement.
  • Confident making decisions in uncertain situations.
  • Excellent negotiator and communicator.
  • Collaborative, building strong relationships across teams while providing independent challenge.
  • Organised with the ability to manage multiple complex situations simultaneously.
  • Curious and committed to improving processes and outcomes.

Why Join us?

title: Program Lead, Sponsored and Series Events
description:
Job Description:

The Job/What You'll Do:

The Program Lead is responsible for managing AssetMark’s portfolio of series and key events. This role will emphasize trade show execution, timeline management, cross-functional coordination, budget accountability, and ROI analysis. It demands operational excellence, attention to detail, and an ability to drive outcomes through collaboration and project discipline.

This role ensures seamless execution of sponsored and hosted events while maximizing brand exposure and engagement. Additionally, this position will oversee the sponsorship outreach and fulfillment for AssetMark-hosted events, including Gold Forum, Platinum Summit, and Women’s Advisor Forum.

The ideal candidate is an experienced event professional with expertise in trade show logistics, sponsorship management, and vendor coordination. This person will act as a strategic partner across internal teams, aligning event execution with business objectives while ensuring a high return on investment for all sponsorship engagements.

We can consider candidates for this position who are able to accommodate a hybrid work schedule and are close to our office location in Charlotte, NC or Concord, CA

Responsibilities:

Third-Party Sponsored Events & Trade Show Management:

  • Develop and execute strategic plans for AssetMark’s presence at sponsored third-party events, ensuring alignment with brand and business goals
  • Manage end-to-end trade show participation, including booth design, exhibitor logistics, sponsorship activations, and attendee engagement
  • Optimize exhibit spaces for maximum brand visibility and lead generation
  • Coordinate all logistics, including venue contracts, shipping, setup, teardown, and vendor management
  • Partner with sales, marketing, and leadership to develop strategies that drive advisor engagement and business development opportunities at these events
  • Analyze event performance, collect stakeholder feedback, and provide post-event reports to measure success and optimize future participation

Sponsorship Outreach & Fulfillment for AssetMark Events:

  • Lead sponsorship outreach efforts for AssetMark-hosted events, managing relationships with sponsors to secure participation and maximize engagement.
  • Oversee the creation of sponsorship prospectuses and pitch materials in collaboration with marketing and sales teams
  • Act as the primary liaison for sponsors, ensuring contractual obligations are met, including branding, on-site activations, and speaking opportunities
  • Manage the sponsorship fulfillment process, ensuring seamless communication, deliverable execution, and post-event reporting
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure sponsored elements within AssetMark events are well-integrated and deliver value to both sponsors and attendees

General Event Operations & Strategic Collaboration:

  • Partner with marketing, creative, and finance teams to develop event strategies, budgets, and execution plans
  • Maintain vendor relationships, including exhibit design firms, event technology providers, and logistics partners
  • Ensure seamless integration of pre-event, during-event, and post-event marketing efforts to maximize impact
  • Track sponsorship and event ROI metrics, reporting key insights to leadership
  • Identify and implement efficiencies to enhance AssetMark’s event and sponsorship strategy

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong understanding of trade show logistics, sponsorship management, and event marketing
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and navigate fast-paced environments
  • Proven ability to track and manage budgets effectively.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills with internal stakeholders, sponsors, and vendors
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience in PowerPoint and Excel preferred
  • Highly detail-oriented with a problem-solving mindset
  • Working knowledge of campaign functions in Salesforce is preferred
  • Proficiency in event technology, including CRM platforms, event apps, and sponsorship tracking tools, is preferred
  • Ability to travel (30%) is required.

Education & Experience:

  • BA degree in marketing, business, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in event management, sponsorship marketing, or trade show planning

Compensation: The Base Salary range for this position is between $95,000-$105,000 for Charlotte and between $110,000-$120,000 for Concord.

This information reflects a base salary range that AssetMark reasonably expects to pay for the position based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, education, experience, and actual work location. This position will also be eligible for additional variable incentive compensation and competitive benefits.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US to be considered. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

title: Learning Success Coordinator, Hanoi Campus
description:
Overview:

RMIT is seeking a Learning Success Coordinator provides operational and administrative support to enable the effective delivery of services, projects, and events across the Student Academic Success

WHY JOIN RMIT VIETNAM?

At RMIT Vietnam, international exposure meets real-world impact through strong industry and government collaboration. Working at RMIT means building a meaningful career while creating impact in a high-performing environment.

Further insight into our mission, impact and global connections is available in the RMIT Vietnam Profile.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive remuneration VND package for candidates.
  • 13th month Tet bonus
  • Private Health insurance for you and your family, plus Personal Accident Insurance
  • Generous annual leave, sick leave, volunteer leave and public holidays (Christmas and Tet Holidays)
  • Professional development and career advancement
  • Access to state-of-the-art facilities and resources
  • A vibrant and diverse campus life and more!

POSITION SUMMARY

Student Academic Success (SAS) provides learning support services that promote academic achievement across RMIT Vietnam programs. The Learning Success Coordinator is responsible for the provision and delivery of learning advice through various study support services and resources offered by SAS including: individual and small group consultation sessions, workshop programs, peer-assisted learning and digital self-access materials through a range of media. In collaboration with the Manager and Learning Advisory team, the Learning Coordinator provides a variety of academic skills development experiences to RMIT students, developed in consultation with academic staff. The Coordinator will assist in maintaining the online presence of SAS and in addition, develop interactive digital resources. The position may involve supervision of project work by other SAS staff.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Facilitate face-to-face and online learning activities to support the development of academic literacies, English language, and academic skills across programs and Schools.
  • Adapt, contextualize, and deliver learning activities based on program and student needs, and report on student feedback and the effectiveness of these sessions to key stakeholders.
  • Undertake individual and group consultations with students to provide academic study support across undergraduate and postgraduate programs.
  • Work with relevant staff to support "At Risk" students in developing their academic literacy and language skills.
  • Facilitate individualized study planning sessions to help students identify and plan for the achievement of their personal learning goals.
  • Consult with academic staff to analyse student support needs and develop learning experiences and resources aligned with course and program learning outcomes.
  • Provide line management and professional development for direct reports within the Learning Advisory team.
  • Plan, manage, and evaluate strategic projects that develop learning support services and programs, including functional oversight of other Student Academic Success (SAS) staff where required.
  • Provide training, monitoring, and ongoing professional development opportunities for student leaders participating in SAS Peer Assisted Learning programs.
  • Design, develop, and deliver content-integrated digital self-access resources to support academic literacies and language development.
  • Provide project management oversight and reporting for strategic development initiatives aligned with SAS program goals.
  • Actively promote SAS services to the RMIT student body and contribute to ongoing communication and promotional strategies.
  • Provide feedback on student learning opportunities and challenges to SAS and academic teaching teams.
  • Conduct literature reviews and develop recommendations to improve assessment design, communication, and student learning outcomes.
  • Participate in the ongoing monitoring and evaluation of SAS study support services and initiatives.
  • Accurately collect, analyse, and report quantitative and qualitative data using established reporting systems.
  • Contribute to the analysis of service data and communicate findings to key stakeholders.
  • Participate in projects to further develop the resources and services of Student Academic Success.
  • Actively engage with the teaching and learning community within RMIT Vietnam and beyond. Engagement includes contribution to online and social media content produced, as well as special events such as those for prospective or current students, and relevant internal and external conferences and symposiums.
  • Other relevant duties requested by Manager

KEY SELECTION CRITERIA

  • A Bachelor’s Degree with major relevant to supporting RMIT Vietnam students such as Commerce, Management, Professional Communications, Education, TESOL/Applied Linguistics, Communications etc. Master’s Degree with Educational focus preferred.
  • At least five years of experience providing academic and study skills support within a secondary or tertiary education environment, or transferrable experience to the role.
  • Well-rounded skills in learning support, English language instruction, and academic literacies development in higher and/or further education institutions.
  • Proven ability to creatively design and engage students with activities that facilitate language and learning skills development in support of learners’ own study goals
  • Research experience using qualitative and quantitative methods for evaluation of service delivery is desirable.
  • Strong report-writing skills
  • Proven ability to accurately maintain complex operational systems and reporting (high attention to detail)
  • Demonstrated awareness of student obstacles in assessment design and constructive alignment.
  • Proven ability to manage projects that deliver successful outcomes.
  • Skilled in the use of technology as a teaching and learning tool with experience in use of educational software for creation of interactive digital resources for online access (e.g. Camtasia, Storyline, Captivate, etc.); experience in use of Learning Management Systems (e.g. Blackboard, Canvas) – especially with use of Learning Analytics tools.
  • Demonstrated commitment to a skills-based, student-centred approach to instruction.
  • Proven ability to creatively design and engage students in activities that facilitate language and learning skills development in support of learners’ own study goals.
  • Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills for interacting with diverse learners and colleagues in an international university context.
  • Classroom teaching experience (Preferred: Teaching Academic English to tertiary-level students or experience teaching in undergraduate programs)
  • Ability to display appropriate behaviours in line with the position, RMIT Values and RMIT Leadership Model.

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, it is mandatory to submit both a resume and a cover letter. Please click on the 'Apply' link provided in this Job Ads to initiate the application process.

Please note that we will be running a rolling recruitment process, so please apply as soon as possible.

COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS

All academic appointments at RMIT Vietnam must meet University and local regulatory requirements, including English proficiency, background checks, and (for international candidates) eligibility for a work permit.

English is the language of teaching and communication at RMIT Vietnam. For this role, the minimum requirement is IELTS (General) with a score of at least 7.0 (or equivalent, as outlined in the Recruitment, Selection and Onboarding Guidelines).

Further guidance will be provided during the recruitment process.

RMIT UNIVERSITY COMMITMENT

RMIT is committed to the rights of students and staff to be safe, respected, valued, and treated as an equal in their place of study and work. All staff are expected to share this commitment and contribute to a safer community. While carrying out their role, staff are in a position of trust with students. Staff have a duty of care to report wellbeing concerns about students through the designated channels and uphold the code of conduct. RMIT Vietnam expects all staff members to comply with its Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, which relate to legal and regulatory requirements and our ways of working.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:

  • Please ensure that your application is submitted through our Workday system on the RMIT Careers page. We do not accept applications through other means.
  • RMIT Vietnam will never request any fees or payments during the application process. Be vigilant about scams asking for payment to apply.
  • For any questions or support, feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at employment@rmit.edu.vn

title: Civil Project Engineer - Site
description:
The Wooten Company is seeking a team-focused, innovative Site Civil Project Engineer with strong storm water background to join our expanding Raleigh Civil Site Team working from our Winston Salem office.


Who are you?

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated civil engineer with a seasoned depth of experience successfully completing site development and minor roadway projects that include components of grading, drainage, storm water management and erosion control for both municipal and private clients. You are responsible, work well with a team and communicate well with people of varying backgrounds and experiences. You are eager to learn and grow professionally in your field.


What will you be doing?

Candidates can expect to work with a variety of stakeholders including land developers, owners, designers, and permitting agencies. The person in this role can make a significant community impact by supporting our clients as they work to create an exciting array of projects such as multi-family developments, downtown renovations, parks, and innovative storm water solutions for local municipalities. Candidates can expect to be continually challenged to independently design projects that develop solutions to meet our client’s needs, using the right mix of advanced technology and historically successful measures, while working within the financial boundaries of the project stakeholders.


Who will you be working with?

The Site Civil Project Engineer can expect cross functional collaboration across all teams and specialties, providing an opportunity to interact with The Wooten Company colleagues in both North and South Carolina. Additionally, this person will regularly work with municipal and private clients, as well as state and federal regulatory agencies. For the right person with a desire to grow professionally, this role is a good opportunity to obtain a depth and breadth of civil engineering ability and to contribute to the growing presence of Wooten, in both the North and South Carolina regions.


Where will you be working?

This position would be working in our Winston-Salem, NC office, but for our Raleigh Civil Site team. Winston-Salem is one of the three cities of the North Carolina Piedmont Triad with Greensboro and High Point completing the trio. The City is home to a unique and thriving downtown along with the historic Old Salem. Our office is located within walking distance of Old Salem, a historic Moravian Community turned historic district with charming cobblestone roads and freshly made Moravian cookies. Our office is also walking distance to downtown including a variety of restaurants and the City of Winston-Salem municipal buildings. With a thriving artist community, plenty of outdoor parks, historical architecture, and great cost of living, the triad region is not only a great place to work, but a great place to call home.

Summary

Provides professional administrative and operational support to the Human Resources Department, including executive-level and management support. Serves as the first point of contact at the HR front desk, providing professional and responsive customer service to employees, applicants, vendors, and visitors. Serves as the Department Purchasing Coordinator and assists with budget administration, procurement, technology, and special projects. Requires strong initiative, sound judgment, discretion, technological proficiency, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects. Handles sensitive matters with tact and diplomacy while proactively identifying needs, resolving issues, and supporting efficient departmental operations.

Schedule: 8am – 5pm, Monday - Friday

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Executive and Management Support: Provides professional administrative and operational support to executive-level and management staff, including coordinating meetings, preparing correspondence and documents, tracking assignments, maintaining records, and supporting departmental initiatives.

  • Budget and Procurement Administration: Assists with the development, monitoring, and administration of the Human Resources Department budget. Serves as the Department Purchasing Coordinator and coordinates purchasing and procurement activities, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, expenditures, and related documentation. Ensures compliance with City policies and procedures and assists with budget planning, forecasting, and reconciliation.

  • Vendor and Contract Coordination: Coordinates with vendors, Purchasing, and other internal partners regarding departmental purchases, contracts, service agreements, renewals, invoices, and related matters. Monitors deadlines, maintains documentation, and proactively follows up to ensure timely completion.

Provides day-to-day administrative and operational support to the department, responds to inquiries, researches issues, and assists with maintaining efficient departmental operations.

Develops timelines, tracks deliverables, coordinates stakeholders, identifies potential issues, and ensures projects and assignments are completed accurately and timely.

Maintains accurate records, files, budget and purchasing documentation, and other confidential or operational information in accordance with City policies and applicable retention requirements.

  • Ability to independently organize work, establish priorities, monitor deadlines, and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to research, analyze, and summarize information and prepare accurate reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and other documents.

  • Ability to work independently and make appropriate decisions within established guidelines.

  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, processes, technology, and organizational needs.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Valid Class C Texas driver's license

title: Product Manager
description:
Position Summary

The Product Manager – Platform owns Obzervr’s Platform Enablement domain – the platform and integration foundations every implementation depends on, from the Admin Console and APIs to ERP integrations and configuration. The role turns customer and company needs into a prioritised roadmap, partners with engineering to deliver it, and is accountable for making each implementation easier than the last.

Key Responsibilities

Roadmap & Discovery

  • Own a clear, ranked roadmap for the Platform Enablement area, tying customer needs to company goals.
  • Lead discovery: talk to customers, gather feedback, and test key assumptions before the team commits to build.
  • Weigh value, effort, and risk when you set what comes first, and explain your thinking to the business.

Delivery & Quality

  • Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria so engineering and QA can build with little rework.
  • Work day-to-day with Product Engineers, QA, and design to deliver high-quality, reliable releases.
  • Keep the backlog healthy and each sprint ready within the Obzervr delivery model.

Platform, Data & AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Build strong working knowledge of the Obzervr integrations (SAP, Pronto, MEX, AMT) and mining workflows.
  • Track product data after launch to measure outcomes, and feed what you learn into the next decision.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, requirements drafting and data analysis – and stay alert to how AI and automation could shape the platform and integration roadmap – applying judgement to validate outputs.
  • Share the roadmap, progress, and key decisions clearly with the team and the business.

Skills & Competencies

Essential

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a customer-first mindset and strong discovery and problem-framing ability.
  • Data-driven decision-making, including defining success metrics and evaluating outcomes.
  • Communication & influence – makes complex problems clear to any audience and drives alignment without authority.
  • Collaboration & listening – builds shared understanding and treats other functions as partners.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, requirements drafting and data analysis, with sound judgement to validate outputs.
  • Agility & quality – evolves the solution as understanding changes, without letting standards slip.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy (quality assurance too).

Desirable

  • Proficiency in product tooling (e.g., Jira, roadmap and discovery tools, analytics/BI).
  • Strong organisational and project-management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.
  • Willingness to adopt new tools and ways of working as the organisation evolves its technology stack.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of product management experience delivering software products (or a strong equivalent track record in a closely adjacent role).
  • Proven experience working with engineering and design teams in an agile delivery environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in the mining, resources, or heavy asset-intensive industries – desirable, not essential.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS and integration-heavy products.
  • Familiarity with ERP/CMMS systems (e.g., SAP, Pronto, MEX, AMT).

Working Conditions

  • Based at Obzervr’s Brisbane office. Hybrid working arrangements available after the probation period.
  • Travel may be required from time to time depending on business needs.
  • Standard business hours apply, with flexibility to accommodate team and project needs.

title: Production Technician I, Kiefel (7:00pm-7:00am)
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

This is where my hands make life-sustaining products

You are driven by the knowledge that the products you help make saves and sustain lives. You can move quickly, address questions, and encourage teammates, all while getting quality products out on time. You are calm, positive, and a key part of a fast-paced environment that emphasizes camaraderie and teamwork. As a Production Technician - Kiefel, you are happiest when you are moving, and we will not disappoint!

Baxter is known for its speed and high-quality product. Our manufacturing operations are around-the-clock to meet the needs of our customers. Our high-caliber talent works through the challenges at hand while pushing toward meeting client order needs. Different shift assignments allow for flexibility and safety.

Your team

Baxter is focused on saving and sustaining lives by manufacturing high-quality products. We strive to create quality products for our customers each day.

Delivering life-saving products is about getting them right, and attention to detail is how we make sure we meet that challenge. We are a team that supports each other throughout each shift. Working together in a supportive and open culture makes our processes evolve for the better and engages our workforce.

You'll be offered extensive training, and the tight-knit working environment within the Manufacturing team means employees get additional training from their direct manager and peers when needed.

What we offer from Day One:

  • Shift flexibility to trade shifts and leverage overtime opportunities

  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage

  • 160 hours of Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

  • 401K match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Tuition Reimbursement

What You'll Be Doing

The Kiefel Production Technician I is a Salaried Non-Exempt position which contributes to our mission of saving and sustaining lives by supplying, operating and maintaining a Kiefel Machine in addition to inspecting and performing quality checks on the finished bags.

  • Operate, monitor, and adjust as necessary a Kiefel machine using controls on an electrical control panel (HMI) or by making manual adjustments

  • Load and replenish production supplies (i.e. injection sites, tubing, PVC/Non-PVC roll stock and adhesive) at a rate consistent with production needs

  • Perform scheduled quality checks, disposition product, identify any deviations that may occur and take the appropriate action to include stopping production on the machine if necessary

  • Inspect finished product and ensure that the quality standards have been met

  • Load and secure finished product in mobile closets

  • Execute a machine changeover when assigned (material changeovers only).

  • Document required information on manufacturing logs and/or POMS system

  • Identify, correct or escalate any inefficiency in the machine’s performance

  • Test, inspect and package Inter-Plant Shipping Orders (IPSO)

  • Notify the supervisor and take appropriate action if any safety, quality, or mechanical issues occur

  • Learn, understand and apply rigorous quality standards, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)

  • Sustain a clean and safe work area using 6S principles including maintaining and securing provided tools.

What You'll Bring

  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent

  • At least 1-2 years Production Technician or manufacturing experience with duties including preventative maintenance, machine troubleshooting, etc.

  • Must have basic English written and oral communication skills adequate to communicate with other team members.

  • Understand verbal and written safety and quality instructions and read and comprehend written work instructions including words and drawings.

  • Must be able to perform basic mathematics

  • Proficient in how to use a calculator and measurement tools (calipers, snap gauges, rulers), as well as basic hand tools.

Physical Requirements

  • The ability to push/pull and lift/carry up to 50 pounds and stand/walk continuously throughout the shift.

  • Normal visual acuity required.

  • Ability to squat, climb, reach above shoulder level, reach at or below shoulder level, twist and bend at the neck, twist and bend at the waist and balance.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all our employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. To that end, this position has a pay rate of $48,048.00 annually.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are un-able to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

title: Guest Experience Event Day Associate – Accessibility
description:
About Mercedes-Benz Stadium
Mercedes-Benz Stadium is a world-class sports and entertainment venue located in downtown Atlanta and home to the NFL’s Atlanta Falcons and MLS’s Atlanta United. Since opening in 2017, the stadium has hosted some of the most significant events in sports and entertainment, including Super Bowl LIII, the College Football Playoff National Championship, MLS Cup, major concerts, and global sporting events.


Recognized as one of the most innovative venues in the world, Mercedes-Benz Stadium is the first professional sports stadium in North America to achieve LEED Platinum certification and the first stadium globally to achieve TRUE Platinum certification for zero waste.

Every event at Mercedes-Benz Stadium is powered by people. Our associates play a critical role in delivering the welcoming, energetic environment that fans expect when they walk through our doors.

Our Ideal Candidate
Guest Experience Associates are the lifeblood of the Mercedes-Benz Stadium experience. They set the tone for the building and play a defining role in how every guest remembers their visit. The individuals who thrive in this role share several defining qualities:


They Care Deeply About People
Hospitality is not a task — it is a mindset. Our associates genuinely enjoy helping others and take pride in making every guest feel welcomed, respected, and valued.
They Choose Positivity
Live events are fast-paced and dynamic. The best associates bring steady energy, maintain a positive outlook, and help create an environment where guests feel excited to be here.
They Find Solutions
Challenges are part of live events. Exceptional associates focus on what can be done. They take ownership, think creatively, and work to find solutions that help guests have a great experience.
They Stay Aware and Engaged
Great associates notice when someone needs help before being asked. They stay attentive to their surroundings and proactively step in to support guests.
They Work as One Team
Delivering a world-class experience requires teamwork. Our associates support one another and collaborate across departments to ensure every guest interaction reflects the best of Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
They Take Pride in Representing the Brand
Every interaction reflects the Mercedes-Benz Stadium experience. Our associates represent the stadium with professionalism, energy, and care.

About the Guest Experience Team
The Guest Experience Team serves as the frontline of the Mercedes-Benz Stadium experience. These associates are the welcoming faces, problem solvers, and energy setters who help transform events into memorable moments for our guests. From the moment guests arrive until the final whistle or encore, this team plays a critical role in delivering our “Welcome Home” philosophy and ensuring every fan feels valued and supported.

Position Summary
The Guest Experience Event Day Associate – Accessibility plays an essential role in ensuring every guest can comfortably and confidently enjoy their visit to Mercedes-Benz Stadium.


This role focuses on supporting guests who require mobility or accessibility assistance while navigating the stadium. Accessibility associates serve as ambassadors of inclusive hospitality by providing thoughtful assistance, guidance, and transportation support so every guest can fully participate in the excitement of live events.

This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy helping others, staying active throughout events, moving around the entire stadium, and creating meaningful moments for guests. Additionally, someone in this role is consistent, reliable, and completely comfortable working outside.

This is not a sitting position. You will be allotted breaks during your shifts and able to sit during breaks. However, during your shift the expectation is to be moving around and potentially pushing any person in a wheelchair throughout the stadium.

Key Responsibilities
Accessibility Guest Support

  • Assist guests who require mobility or accessibility support while navigating the stadium

  • Escort guests in wheelchairs safely to and from seating areas, gates, and other stadium locations

  • Provide wheelchair transportation assistance consistently through an event

  • Maintain strong knowledge of accessible routes, seating areas, elevators, and guest service resources throughout the stadium

  • Work outside, assisting guests with accessibility needs to and from the stadium.

Guest Hospitality

  • Greet guests warmly and represent Mercedes-Benz Stadium with professionalism and positivity

  • Proactively identify guests who may need assistance and offer support

  • Resolve guest questions or challenges with a calm, solutions-focused approach

  • Collaborate with stadium teams to ensure guests receive timely assistance

Event-Day Execution

  • Remain active throughout events while assisting guests across multiple stadium locations

  • Work effectively in both indoor and outdoor environments, especially in all weather conditions.

  • Maintain awareness of guest flow and event operations

  • Support other Guest Experience initiatives and responsibilities as assigned


Required Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age

  • Must be able and willing to work in indoor and outdoor environments

  • Ability to assist with wheelchair transportation throughout the stadium

  • Ability to stand, walk or walk up and down stairs for extended periods of time during an event.

  • Availability to work nights, weekends, and major stadium events

  • Must be available to work a minimum of 75% all major events consistently throughout the year held at Mercedes-Benz Stadium including Atlanta Falcons, Atlanta United, college football, concerts, etc.

  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment.

  • Proactive in seeking out positive interactions with both guests and coworkers and interested in maintaining those positive relationships.

  • Must enjoy speaking and interacting with others in a warm, friendly, and respectful manner.

  • Must be available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment and/or working events.

Required Skills

  • Displays strong communication, listening, and thoughtfulness.

  • Provide excellent customer service.

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new settings and situations.

  • Shows understanding and use of basic technology such as mobile devices and handhelds.

  • Possesses strong time management and team collaboration skills.

Why Join Mercedes-Benz Stadium?
Guest Experience Associates play a vital role in shaping how fans remember their time at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. This role offers the opportunity to be part of the energy of live sports and entertainment while helping create memorable experiences for thousands of guests at every event.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Payment Platform
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team

Roku Pay is one of Roku's core monetization streams and is well-positioned for significant growth. Roku Pay encompasses the Pricing, Billing, and Payments ecosystems, along with many other integrations that strive to deliver a great experience for our partners and consumers. We are rebuilding our platform to support our growth plans in both domestic and international markets. As part of this exercise, you will have an opportunity to build out a very scalable, performant, and available system that can influence Roku's growth path tremendously, while being on the bleeding edge of technologies, crafting microservices, scaling cloud deployments, etc.

For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $400,000 - $500,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

About the role

As Lead Engineer, you'll lead the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and designs, continually assessing emerging tools and seeking innovative solutions to both existing and new challenges. You'll engage in architectural discussions across multiple teams, influence the roadmap, and own key projects and initiatives, providing the technical leadership and expertise needed to drive highly available, scalable platform capabilities.

This role sets the standard for engineering excellence—establishing clear expectations and leading by hands-on example. You'll be an evangelist for best practices across every function, including development, QA, and infrastructure/ops, as well as a champion for platform innovation and reuse. While you'll stay actively involved in code and design reviews, this remains a deeply technical position: you're expected to be heavily hands-on with agentic coding.

What you'll be doing

  • Use agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as part of your daily workflow, delegating tasks to AI, reviewing and refining AI-generated code, and integrating it into production
  • Build and ship features using AI coding agents—delegating implementation, reviewing output, and owning the quality of what makes it to production
  • Own the building of platform features, driving work directly with product and other engineering teams
  • Own the design and implementation of shared architectural layers (e.g., queuing, event systems, shared memory clusters) and libraries that can be leveraged across teams.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead the adoption of new designs that address platform challenges
  • Participate in architectural discussions across teams, influence the technical roadmap, and take ownership of key initiatives
  • Review technical specification documents produced by the development team and mentor team members to raise the bar on quality
  • Stay hands-on with code and design reviews while spending the majority of your time (~70%) writing code
  • Champion best practices and a culture of innovation and reuse across development, QA, and infrastructure/ops

We're excited if you have

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) is required, including the ability to effectively delegate, review, and integrate AI-generated code within a production workflow
  • 15+ years of experience in large-scale backend services, specifically within payment system architecture and implementation, or related professional industry experience
  • A good understanding of various payment flows is required, such as payment processing, card tokenization, payment gateway integration, token vault management, etc.
  • Good understanding of different payment processing flows, such as sync vs async, and online vs offline
  • Familiar with different compliance standards, such as SOX, PCI, 3DS, etc.
  • Experience with the RFP (Request for Proposal) Process, proven ability to translate business needs to vendor requirements, performance of deep technical evaluation on 3rd parties vendors, and helping business selecting the right vendor to scale with the company
  • Strong architectural design experience, and a great track record of building a highly available and scalable payment platform
  • Experience with multi-cloud solutions is a plus; ability to offer technical guidance to design, deploy, and scale applications across multiple cloud environments
  • Strong expertise with cloud solutions/systems across the cloud with AWS or GCP is a must
  • Strong experience in designing and leading highly complex transactional systems
  • Strong passion for technology and adding value to the bottom line through technology
  • Strong expertise in Payments and billing systems is required
  • Strong passion & expertise in building and adopting CI/CD pipelines
#LI-DH2

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Community Analyst
description:
About Democratic National Committee

We’re hiring! Are you fired up to elect Democrats up and down the ticket?

Position Summary:

The Democratic National Committee Tech Team is hiring a Community Analyst to provide frontline support for DNC Tech data and tech products, and offer strategic support to members of the Democratic data ecosystem including state parties, sister committees, and campaigns.

The Community Analyst will report to the Community Director. In addition to external support, the Community Team provides valuable expertise and insights into the user experience to the rest of the DNC Tech Team, working closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams.

Who we are:

We are a fully remote, distributed team living in 19 states and from a variety of backgrounds. Some of us have worked in political campaigns, others in public sector tech, and others in industry. We value diversity in perspective, lived experience, and the many paths one may take into working in political technology. We believe deeply in the promise of breaking the boom-bust cycle of political tech work and building technology infrastructure that will support campaigns from cycle to cycle and will improve with every iteration.

Responsibilities:

  • Best in class user support. Answer and troubleshoot technical questions from users (Presidential and down ballot campaigns, state parties, sister committees) about our tools, products and datasets, via a customer support queue in Zendesk. Participate in a Community on call rotation to support users and stakeholders outside of business hours, as needed, and more regularly in even years.
  • Training & skills development. Partner with our product team on training, communication, and rollout of new features and datasets for our data warehouse and tech products. Facilitate virtual (and occasional in-person) training on complex technical concepts and tools to a wide range of technical expertise.
  • Ensure documentation and usability of products. Maintain up-to-date and relevant documentation of DNC tech and data products and processes, including creating new content as necessary.
  • State Party relationship management. Build collaborative relationships with state party data staff, including holding regular 1:1s, troubleshooting voter file issues, and responding to and advocating for state party needs.
  • Intake and share user feedback and insights. Be a partner to our community of users, proactively gathering feedback and identifying common problems that we can solve through automation or iteration. This team is responsible for facilitating a profound feedback loop between us and our community of users, in addition to ensuring our tools and products are well documented and utilized.
  • Other duties as assigned to support the department and the DNC's mission.

Skills:

  • User support: Passion for training, documentation, and 1:1 user support, and the ability to tailor communication style to a variety of audiences and levels of technical expertise.
  • Resourcefulness & problem-solving: Tenacity in troubleshooting complex data and technical issues with an investigative mindset, naturally digging into documentation, logs, and previous tickets to hunt down answers before escalating.
  • Organization & prioritization: Highly structured and self-driven with a keen attention to detail. Self-sufficient task management, the ability to juggle competing priorities, and ability to adhere and contribute to team processes.
  • Curiosity: An eagerness to learn and willingness to take initiative in asking questions. Views mistakes as key feedback loops for improvement. Humble enough to recognize the vast depth of the ecosystem and patient with the long journey of mastering DNC data and tools.
  • Relationship management: Ability to build trusting relationships with key stakeholders and users.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to change course and priorities quickly within a rapidly changing ecosystem with urgent deadlines and high stakes.

Qualifications:

  • Experience working on a political campaign or at a state party or political tech organization, working with the voter file is a bonus!
  • Experience in an externally-facing role (i.e. user, customer, or volunteer-facing roles).
  • Experience using VoteBuilder, bonus for other types of organizing tools.
  • Proven track record of thriving in a fully remote environment with strong asynchronous habits (over-communicating status updates, asking questions in open channels, maintaining personal workflows).
  • A basic understanding of SQL, or any other language efficient for analyzing large datasets.
  • A desire to change politics for the better, support the Democratic Party, and secure the future of our country.

Salary: The starting salary for the Community Analyst position is $87,550, on an annualized basis, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time, exempt position, that occasionally requires work on weekends. This position is in the bargaining unit represented by SEIU Local-500.

The Democratic National Committee (DNC), is committed to diversity among its staff, and recognizes that its continued success requires the highest commitment to obtaining and retaining a diverse staff that provides the best quality services to supporters and constituents. The DNC is an equal opportunity employer and it is our policy to recruit, hire, train, promote and administer any and all personnel actions without regard to sex, race, age, color, creed, national origin, religion, economic status, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression, ethnic identity or physical disability, or any other legally protected basis. The DNC will not tolerate any unlawful discrimination and any such conduct is strictly prohibited.

Benefits:

The DNC offers a generous benefit package, including:

  • Generous paid time off, including federal holidays and open leave
  • Health and dental insurance for employee and dependents; 90% paid by the DNC, 10% paid by employee
  • Supplementary vision plans available to employees for purchase
  • Up to a 5% employer match DNC 401(k) plan

title: Cybersecurity Engineer (PKI And Security Operations)
description:
Cybersecurity Engineer (PKI & Security Operations)

Location: Irving, TX (Hybrid - 3 days onsite Tuesday-Thursday)

Employment Type: Long-Term Contract with Conversion Potential

Work Authorization: U.S. Citizens only

Candidates will required to complete an online cybersecurity assessment that will take 60-90 minutes to complete.

Top Skills

  • 5+ years of Cybersecurity Engineering experience
  • Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, and Detection Engineering
  • Security Investigations and Threat Analysis
  • Vulnerability Remediation and Risk Reduction
  • Exposure to PKI, Certificates, or Identity-Based Security Technologies

Note: Candidates do not need to be dedicated PKI engineers. The hiring team is open to strong cybersecurity engineers with some exposure to PKI concepts who can learn quickly, work independently, and contribute as a key member of the team.

Overview Our airline industry client is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer to join a highly visible security engineering team responsible for protecting critical enterprise and operational environments. This role is ideal for a security professional who enjoys solving complex security challenges, working independently, and contributing as a key technical resource across multiple security initiatives.

While exposure to Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) technologies is valuable, this is not a dedicated PKI engineering role. Candidates with strong cybersecurity engineering experience who understand foundational PKI concepts and can quickly learn new technologies are encouraged to apply.

This position offers the opportunity to work on large-scale security initiatives while contributing to the protection of systems that support a major airline's operations and future technology programs.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and improve cybersecurity controls and processes across enterprise environments.
  • Investigate security events and perform end-to-end analysis to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and root causes.
  • Build and maintain detections, dashboards, and analytics within Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Develop and refine security monitoring use cases using KQL and other security engineering tools.
  • Manage remediation efforts for security findings and vulnerabilities from discovery through validated closure.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to strengthen overall security posture.
  • Write, test, automate, and document security processes, scripts, and technical solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging security technologies and recommend practical improvements.
  • Contribute to PKI-related initiatives including certificate-based authentication, certificate lifecycle management, and related security controls when needed.
  • Operate independently while supporting larger security initiatives and strategic projects.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of cybersecurity or security engineering experience.
  • Experience owning and delivering security projects independently.
  • Strong understanding of security operations, threat detection, investigation, and incident analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including:
    • KQL query development
    • Detection rule creation
    • Dashboard development
    • Security investigations
  • Experience managing vulnerability remediation and security findings through resolution.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex security issues and drive solutions with minimal oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to understand the broader security picture and work as a trusted engineering partner.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to PKI concepts and certificate-based security technologies, such as:
    • Certificate lifecycle management
    • Certificate-based authentication
    • Software/code signing
    • SCEP, EST, or related enrollment protocols
    • NIST identity and authentication frameworks
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python or PowerShell.
  • Experience with security tooling APIs and integrations.
  • Familiarity with endpoint security technologies.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted security workflows, LLM-enabled security analysis, or security automation.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated, operational technology (OT), embedded systems, manufacturing, transportation, or aviation environments.
  • Experience with HSMs, key management, or code-signing platforms.

What We're Looking For

The hiring team is seeking a strong, well-rounded cybersecurity engineer who can work independently, think strategically, and contribute as a core member of the team. A deep PKI background is not required. Candidates who have strong security engineering experience and some exposure to PKI concepts will be considered.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Long-term contract with potential for permanent conversion.
  • Opportunity to support a major airline's security initiatives.
  • Work on high-visibility security programs with broad organizational impact.
  • Hybrid work environment with a collaborative engineering team.
  • Exposure to cloud security, detection engineering, PKI, security operations, and emerging security technologies.

This role will primarily oversee domestic import operations, including shipment prioritization, delivery coordination, freight partner performance, exception management, and support for coordinator development.

As our supply chain continues to grow in both volume and complexity, this role will help strengthen day-to-day decision-making, improve operational consistency, and provide more focused leadership support to the Imports team. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and problem-solver who can balance hands-on operational oversight with people leadership, coaching, and process improvement.

Success in this role requires strong prioritization skills, sound judgment, emotional intelligence, and the ability to lead through ambiguity in a fast-paced supply chain environment.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage and develop a team of Imports Operations Coordinators.
  • Provide consistent coaching, feedback, and support to help team members grow in their roles.
  • Help coordinators prioritize daily work and make timely decisions on shipment issues and escalations.
  • Support individual development plans, performance conversations, and ongoing team accountability.
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented team environment.
  • Partner closely with the International Imports Operations Supervisor to ensure consistency across the broader Imports team.

Domestic Import Operations Oversight

  • Oversee day-to-day domestic import operations once shipments arrive in the U.S.
  • Support prioritization of containers and inbound shipments based on customer promise dates, inventory needs, MABD, and business impact.
  • Ensure containers and inbound shipments are processed accurately and efficiently through internal systems.
  • Monitor domestic shipment milestones and help resolve delays, routing issues, delivery exceptions, and other disruptions.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to communicate delays, delivery updates, and shipment priorities.

Freight Partner Management

  • Help manage relationships with domestic freight partners, drayage providers, warehouses, and other logistics partners.
  • Monitor freight partner performance against agreed timelines, service expectations, and cost targets.
  • Support regular business reviews, KPI tracking, and performance feedback for freight partners.
  • Escalate and resolve recurring service issues, billing concerns, or performance gaps.
  • Partner with the broader Imports team to identify opportunities for improved service, cost control, and accountability.

Cost Control & Operational Decision-Making

  • Help reduce unnecessary expedited freight spend through strong planning and prioritization.
  • Support freight rate benchmarking and cost comparison efforts.
  • Review exceptions and identify root causes behind delays, added costs, or operational errors.
  • Make timely, informed decisions while knowing when to escalate higher-risk issues.

Process Improvement & Scalability

  • Identify process gaps and implement improvements to strengthen consistency and efficiency.
  • Build and maintain SOPs for domestic import operations.
  • Improve reporting and visibility into shipment status, freight partner performance, and key operational metrics.
  • Help build scalable workflows that reduce dependency on individual knowledge and improve team coverage.

Key Performance Indicators

  • On-time and in-full delivery performance against customer commitments.
  • Reduction in unnecessary expedited freight spend.
  • High freight partner performance and accountability.
  • Accuracy and consistency of shipment processing.
  • Timely resolution of shipment exceptions and escalations.
  • Coordinator development, support, and performance.
  • Progress on SOPs, process improvements, and system adoption.

Qualifications & Skills

Required

  • Prior experience leading, supervising, or managing a team.
  • Experience in supply chain operations, logistics, transportation, imports, or a related field.
  • Strong prioritization and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to navigate team dynamics professionally.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Ability to remain organized and calm in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners.
  • Experience building SOPs, improving processes, or implementing operational controls.
  • Experience managing freight partners, warehouses, forwarders, or transportation providers.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with ERP, TMS, or logistics systems.
  • Familiarity with Acumatica, RateLinx, DOMO, ClickUp, MaxLoad/TOPS, or similar tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field is a plus.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

A successful Domestic Imports Operations Supervisor will bring structure and consistency to domestic import operations while helping the team operate more effectively as the business scales. This person will make timely decisions, support and develop coordinators, improve freight partner accountability, and help strengthen day-to-day leadership coverage.

The right candidate will be able to balance operational urgency with strong judgment, clear communication, and a steady leadership style.

title: Senior Strategic Advisor
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior Strategic Advisor - Defense & Intelligence to join our team in Washington, D.C. (On-site).


This role supports the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Intelligence and Security (OUSW[I&S]) by delivering high-level guidance on critical geopolitical priorities. You will help shape defense strategy, interface with senior leadership, and accelerate data-driven decision-making across multiple mission stakeholders.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Provide high-level strategic counsel to senior executives within the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Intelligence and Security (OUSW[I&S]) regarding the oversight of sensitive operations, autonomous architectures, and geopolitical defense priorities.

  • Formulate and coordinate complex legislative proposals, strategy documents, and congressional inquiries, ensuring complete alignment with statutory mandates and departmental objectives.

  • Assess emerging commercial technologies and counter-unmanned systems (C-UXS) across air, ground, and maritime domains, offering data-backed recommendations to enhance the Joint Force's operational lethality and intelligence posture.

  • Prepare comprehensive briefing materials and staff senior-level engagements to accelerate data-driven decision-making for Under Secretary-equivalent leadership.

  • Facilitate interagency coordination and policy execution to streamline intelligence sharing, reduce technical stovepipes, and optimize capability development across multiple mission stakeholders.

  • Lead organizational evaluations and workflow analyses to design improved operational procedures, fostering a unified and efficient support environment for the counter-unmanned systems (C-UXS) Acquisition and Maritime Portfolio.

  • Function as a strategic expert across multiple high-impact assignments, evaluating program performance and recommending major shifts to align with emerging intelligence collection requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or 6+ years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree).

  • 6+ years of experience in defense policy analysis, strategic planning, operations research, or management consulting within the Intelligence Community or Department of War.

Northrop Grumman’s Space Systems Sector is seeking a Systems Engineer – Level 3 to join our team in Redondo Beach, CA.

Continued employment thereafter will be subject to maintenance of the level of clearance and program access required for the position in the future.

In this role, the Systems Engineer – Level 3 will work in tandem with a scrum team of other software and systems engineers responsible for defining the product vision, managing the product backlog, and ensuring that all features align with business objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to prioritize tasks and facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality mission focused software systems solutions. Development is done within the Agile paradigm using the Atlassian tool suite, so you will need to be able to work within an Agile environment.

You will be supporting a program through full life-cycle milestones in Agile sprints to achieve the mission, you will have strong verbal and written communication skills, and you are expected to operate independently with little oversight in a dynamic environment. You will have experience with MBSE (Model Based Systems Engineering), CAMEO, SysML diagramming, requirements & verification, domain and mission knowledge, and work with or as software system engineering. You are highly self-motivated, reporting information to leads and the customer. You are expected to handle diverse assignments with efficiency, find unique solutions, and work in a very collaborative and fast-paced environment that continues to grow.

-Drive development and execution of features for the satellite ground systems domain with familiarity in reading CAMEO/MBSE models
