title: (Creative / Senior / Lead) Exterior Designer
description:
Job Description

Work Arrangement

This role is categorized as on-site. Successful candidates are expected to work full time from the GM China Advanced Technical Center in Shanghai, China.

About GM China Design Studio

GM China Design Studio is both a production design studio and an advanced design studio. We shape meaningful vehicle experiences for GM brands serving customers in China and global markets, connecting near-term production programs with forward-looking exploration.

We are committed to creating an exceptional design environment where creativity, beauty, craftsmanship, and storytelling can thrive. Our designers work across disciplines and cultures to translate customer understanding, brand identity, emerging technologies, and new forms of mobility into compelling exterior design proposals.

About This Evergreen Requisition

This evergreen requisition is established for talent pipelining purposes. GM China Design Studio is building a long-term pipeline of exceptional Exterior Designers across multiple levels, including Creative Designer, Senior Exterior Designer, and Lead Exterior Designer, in support of current and anticipated business needs.

We welcome applications from outstanding designers around the world who are interested in contributing to exciting production programs and advanced design work in our China studio. Depending on business needs and the candidate’s experience, future opportunities may involve different levels of responsibility, program scope, and creative leadership.

When submitting your application, please include:

  • An updated resume or CV.
  • An updated portfolio that clearly demonstrates your design thinking, creative process, visual communication, and relevant exterior design capabilities.
  • Please ensure that your portfolio does not contain undisclosed, confidential, proprietary, or otherwise sensitive information, projects, or materials belonging to current or previous employers or clients.

After your application is submitted, our recruiting and design teams will review your materials. If there is alignment with a current or future opportunity, a recruiter will contact you to discuss potential next steps. Because this is an evergreen requisition, the timing of contact may vary according to business needs and the fit between your experience and upcoming opportunities.

If you do not meet every element listed below but are interested in exploring an opportunity with GM China Design Studio, we still encourage you to apply. We value distinctive creative perspectives, strong design potential, and the ability to contribute to a collaborative studio environment.

The Role -

Exterior Designers in GM China Design Studio help define the visual identity, proportion, stance, and emotional character of future vehicles and mobility products for China and global markets. Depending on level and experience, you may contribute to or lead exterior themes and component design from early advanced exploration through production execution, creating proposals that are distinctive, customer-relevant, brand-expressive, and technically achievable.

You will collaborate with designers and partners across exterior design, sculpting, engineering, fabrication, modeling, product planning, customer research, and global design studios. The scope of your contribution may range from developing sketches and digital or physical design proposals to directing programs, presenting to senior leadership, and mentoring other designers.

What You May Do

Your responsibilities may include the following, depending on your level, experience, and assigned program:

Creative Designer-level contribution

  • Develop exterior design concepts, component ideas, sketches, renderings, and visual narratives under the guidance of more experienced designers.
  • Explore alternative design themes, proportions, surfaces, details, and graphic treatments that respond to brand direction, customer needs, technology opportunities, and program objectives.
  • Communicate exterior design intent through traditional sketching, digital 2D visualization, digital 3D tools, scale models, physical mock-ups, and other appropriate design media.
  • Support the development of exterior proposals from early ideation toward digital models, scale models, clay, full-size representations, or other design deliverables.
  • Participate in design reviews and cross-functional discussions; incorporate feedback into refined design solutions while continuing to develop a clear and distinctive point of view.
  • Build understanding of design feasibility, proportions, surface development, aerodynamics, lighting, manufacturing processes, craftsmanship, and quality expectations.

Senior Designer-level contribution

  • Independently develop and advance exterior themes and component proposals for assigned advanced or production programs, from initial sketches through refined digital, scale, or full-size design representations.
  • Translate brand strategy, customer understanding, competitive references, future mobility trends, and technology opportunities into distinctive exterior concepts and cohesive vehicle design proposals.
  • Create and communicate high-quality sketches, renderings, digital 3D models, physical mock-ups, and presentations that clearly explain design intent, proportion, stance, surface language, details, and overall vehicle character.
  • Collaborate closely with the design team, sculpting organization, engineering, fabrication, modeling, and other cross-functional partners to develop designs that balance creative ambition with technical and manufacturing realities.
  • Provide design insight and recommendations, respond constructively to general direction, and make clear design decisions within a deadline-driven environment.
  • Present design ideas and proposals in studio reviews and leadership forums, explaining the thinking behind the work and incorporating feedback into stronger solutions.
  • Contribute to advanced and exploratory projects by taking a broad view of customer needs, future transportation, emerging technologies, and new forms of mobility.
  • Share knowledge and provide informal guidance to less experienced designers when appropriate, contributing to a positive and collaborative studio culture.

Lead Designer-level contribution

  • Define and drive the creative direction of assigned exterior programs across advanced and production design phases, from early exploration through final model development and release.
  • Create new and distinctive exterior designs for complete vehicles, mobility products, and key exterior components, demonstrating a strong point of view across proportion, stance, surface, graphics, and detail.
  • Independently lead the development of design proposals using traditional sketching, digital 2D and 3D technology, digital modeling, physical scale models, and full-size clay or other physical representations.
  • Establish design strategies that express GM brand DNA while responding to China-specific customer needs, market dynamics, future transportation, and innovation opportunities.
  • Lead design alignment with the design team, sculpting, engineering, fabrication, modeling, product planning, customer research, and global design studios to deliver solutions that are compelling, feasible, and program-ready.
  • Represent GM China Design in key studio reviews and leadership forums, presenting creative ideas and design recommendations clearly to management and senior leadership.
  • Provide creative direction, review work, offer constructive feedback, and mentor designers across different experience levels.
  • Drive design deliverables and decision-making according to program timing and applicable design processes, maintaining alignment on quality, craftsmanship, feasibility, and leadership expectations.
  • Demonstrate design courage by challenging assumptions, exploring provocative opportunities, and raising the creative ambition of the work while remaining responsive to program objectives.

Contributions shared across levels

  • Follow the design process from initial ideation and sketches through digital development, physical modeling, design refinement, and, where applicable, final model release.
  • Maintain awareness of current and emerging exterior design trends, automotive technology, materials, manufacturing processes, customer preferences, and developments in future transportation.
  • Apply sound design perception, taste, judgment, creativity, skill, and accuracy to develop clear and compelling design solutions.
  • Consider the complete vehicle and customer experience, including proportion, stance, package, aerodynamics, lighting, graphics, interaction points, craftsmanship, and perceived quality.
  • Work effectively with design, sculpting, engineering, fabrication, modeling, and other cross-functional partners to communicate design intent and negotiate design criteria.
  • Manage priorities and deliverables in a deadline-driven environment, adapting to changing program needs while maintaining design quality.
  • Engage constructively in a diverse, collaborative, and internationally connected studio environment.
  • Demonstrate discretion and respect for intellectual property and confidential information throughout the design process.

What You May Bring

We welcome designers with different career paths, backgrounds, and levels of experience. The following qualifications are intended to describe the capabilities that may be relevant to these opportunities rather than serve as a checklist that every applicant must fully satisfy.

  • A degree in Transportation Design, Automotive Design, Industrial Design, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience and a compelling portfolio may also be considered.
  • Experience in automotive, transportation, mobility, industrial, product, or another closely related design field. The depth of experience expected will vary by level, from emerging design talent to experienced program and team leaders.
  • The ability to develop relevant, distinctive, and visually compelling exterior design concepts, themes, proposals, and component ideas.
  • Strong 2D visual communication skills, including sketching, rendering, storytelling, presentation, and the ability to communicate design thinking clearly.
  • Experience with digital design tools, digital 3D modeling, 3D visualization, CAS, physical scale models, full-size clay, physical mock-ups, or other methods used to develop and communicate exterior design concepts. The specific toolset is less important than the quality of the design thinking and the ability to learn and adapt.
  • A clear understanding of proportion, stance, surface development, form, detail, graphics, craftsmanship, and the relationship between design intent and physical execution.
  • The ability to approach projects from both a creative and strategic point of view, exploring multiple solutions while making clear design decisions.
  • An understanding of how exterior design interacts with sculpting, engineering, fabrication, modeling, packaging, aerodynamics, manufacturing, quality, safety, regulation, and customer expectations.
  • A genuine interest in contributing to a holistic design process, from early concept development through later-stage design refinement and execution.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to present ideas, respond to feedback, and work effectively in a multicultural and cross-functional environment.
  • For more experienced opportunities: the ability to independently drive design development, lead program direction, influence stakeholders, present to senior audiences, mentor designers, and connect creative ambition with business and technical realities.
  • For emerging opportunities: demonstrated design potential, curiosity, willingness to learn, and the ability to develop ideas through a thoughtful and visually compelling process.
  • Experience with production programs may be beneficial for some opportunities, but it is not required for every position in this talent pipeline.

Why Join GM China Design Studio

You will have the opportunity to work in a studio that connects advanced design exploration with real production impact. You will collaborate with colleagues across China and the global GM Design network, contribute to vehicles and mobility products for diverse customers, and help shape the next generation of exterior design through creativity, beauty, technology, and storytelling.

We are interested in meeting exceptional designers at different stages of their careers. Your portfolio, perspective, and potential may align with an opportunity even if your experience does not map perfectly to every item in this description.







About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

title: Utility Coordinator
description:
The Wooten Company’s Raleigh, NC office is seeking a Utility Coordinator who will work within the Engineering Services Team. This position is an excellent opportunity for someone with CAD design, civil engineering, or field experience who is looking to grow their career in project coordination and utility management. Working alongside experienced engineers and utility professionals, you'll learn how to coordinate utility relocations, build relationships with utility owners, and play an important role in delivering transportation and infrastructure projects across North Carolina.


Who are you?

You enjoy working with people just as much as solving problems. You're organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Whether you're reviewing plans, coordinating with utility companies, or communicating project updates, you know how to keep projects moving forward. You have experience working with engineering plans or CAD software and are excited to continue learning. You're comfortable asking questions, learning new processes, and explaining technical information in a way that others can understand. You're equally comfortable having difficult conversations when necessary while maintaining professionalism and building positive working relationships. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are looking for a long-term career where you can continue developing your technical knowledge and project management skills.


What will you be doing?

The Utility Coordinator works closely with engineers, utility companies, contractors, and NCDOT to coordinate utility relocation efforts for transportation projects. In this role, you'll review engineering plans, identify potential utility conflicts, communicate project updates, coordinate schedules, and help move projects through each stage of the utility coordination process. You'll gain experience reviewing relocation packages, preparing project documentation, attending meetings with utility owners, and learning NCDOT policies and procedures while working alongside experienced team members.


Where will you be working?

This position is preferably based in our Raleigh headquarters, located in the highly desirable Glenwood South district of downtown Raleigh. However, we are willing to consider candidates who would like to work out of one of our five other regional office locations including Winston-Salem, Hickory, Greenville, and Wilmington, NC or Columbia, SC.

Design and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to improve efficiency and coverage, and integrate automated testing into CI/CD deployment workflows. Analyze system requirements and technical documentation to create detailed test plans and test cases. Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution. Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Validate system performance, reliability, security, and scalability against mission requirements.   • Planning, developing, executing, and documenting test strategies for complex software systems
  • Functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing
  • Developing and executing automated test solutions using modern frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent
  • Testing distributed, cloud-based, or enterprise applications
  • Creating and executing manual and automated test plans
  • API testing using tools such as Postman or REST Assured
  • CI/CD tools including Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
  • Defect management using tools such as Jira

The MOS Process Excellence Coach is a senior individual contributor responsible for driving enterprise-wide process improvement and operational excellence across non-manufacturing functions such as Supply Chain, HR, Finance, Customer Service, Product Management, IT, and Commercial/Marketing. This role leads complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, quality, cost, and customer experience. Indianapolis, IN is the preferred location for this role; however, qualified candidates in other locations will be considered. Candidates located outside of Indianapolis must be willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time.

Responsibilities

  • Lead large, complex, cross-functional and enterprise-wide process improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and sustainment.

  • Embed continuous improvement practices and governance to increase organizational maturity.

Qualifications

Preferred

Job Description

The Marketplace Director reports to the Executive Director, West Cellular Therapy Team and is accountable for the overall business performance of a defined regional marketplace. This role serves as the single point of accountability for regional demand generation, account engagement, and execution of territory strategies, partnering closely with cross functional field and headquarters stakeholders to drive sustainable growth and patient access across the portfolio of Kite CAR-T cell therapies.

The Marketplace Director operates with an ownership mindset, leads through influence in a matrix environment, and ensures teams are enabled, aligned, and accountable to deliver results.

Preferred that candidates live in the metropolitan area of Denver, Phoenix, or Salt Lake City.

Key Responsibilities:

Marketplace & Strategy Leadership

  • Own regional business results by leading the development, execution, and monitoring of integrated territory strategies aligned to brand and organizational goals.

  • Establish regional priorities and align cross functional partners (e.g., medical, market access, marketing, payer, logistics ) to drive coordinated execution.

  • Deliver insights on current and future marketplace dynamics, including evaluation and recommendations for ATC expansion.

  • Lead team to identify Drivers and Barriers in complex marketplace settings that lead to the development of tailored, strategic account plans by the Cell Therapy Account Manager.

Account & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead the regional approach to Key Account Management across ATC and Community in partnership with Market Access, Medical, Marketing, and other stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and influencers across ATC and key community accounts, including KOLs, C suite leaders, and Cell Therapy Service Line stakeholders.

  • Remove barriers to access and execution by engaging stakeholders at appropriate levels across the territory.

People Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop managers and field teams to strengthen selling skills, clinical and operational acumen, and customer focus.

  • Drive performance management by clearly communicating expectations, conducting timely mid year and annual reviews, and providing ongoing feedback.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s and field engagement to assess account progress, close gaps, and reinforce best practices.

  • Develop a World Class Culture within your Marketplace, establish trust and support Kite Culture initiatives. Attract, retain, and develop top talent, including individualized development and succession planning.

  • Foster a speak up culture grounded in trust, accountability, and organizational values. (Consider moving under People Leadership Section)

Demand Generation & Marketplace Execution

  • Oversee regional demand generation through coordinated customer engagement across ATC and community targets.

  • Partner with sales training, operations, and marketing to improve field effectiveness, efficiency, and execution quality.

  • Establish mechanisms to track account activity against goals and ensure consistent follow through.

ATC Expansion

  • Support market access account teams in evaluating and developing strategic ATC footprint expansion plans.

  • Collaborate with Market Access partners to share insights, priorities, and updates related to expansion opportunities.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies, including protection of patient data.

Basic Qualifications

  • PhD with 8+ years of experience, or

  • Master’s degree with 10+ years of experience, or

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 12+ years in pharmaceutical or biotechnology industries, Hematology/Rare Disease

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience

  • Deep hematology/oncology clinical, operational, and account management expertise (academic and community)

  • Strong performance management, coaching, and talent development capabilities

  • Demonstrated success achieving business targets and leading in matrix environments

  • Excellent strategic thinking, negotiation, communication, and influencing skills

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, regulatory requirements, and good business conduct

title: Autonomous Driving Data Analysis Intern
description:
A world empowered by autonomy. We build robotic vehicles to improve logistics safety, forge a greener Earth, and enhance human lives.

We are a closely-knit team aspiring to change the world through disruptive technology. We are innovators. We are tinkerers. We are problem-solvers. And we have a fair amount of magic dust up our sleeves. We have a plan for fleet-level deployment of autonomous vehicles, and we are looking for the best-of-the-best to join us in making this a reality.


About Venti Technologies

Based in the U.S. and Asia, Venti Technologies is the leader in safe-speed autonomous logistics systems, developing the future of goods transportation. Using rigorous mathematics, deep learning, and theoretically-grounded algorithms, Venti has a proprietary collection of autonomy technologies including a suite of powerful logistics algorithms. Venti’s proven value proposition of saving costs, increasing vehicle utilization, and improving safety is recognized by customers and driving growth. Launched in 2018, Venti brings together an unsurpassed team internationally. The company has autonomous systems deployed in Asia for industrial and logistics sites and a growing pipeline. Venti has offices in Cambridge (Massachusetts, USA), Suzhou (China), and Singapore – our Asian headquarters.

Role Overview

We are seeking a passionate and driven Data & AI Engineering Intern to join our autonomous driving team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our data loop/flywheel, solving complex data-governance challenges for massive fleet test data using cutting-edge AI technologies (such as LLMs and AI Agents). You will play a key role in building highly efficient automated data pipelines and full-stack internal platforms, directly empowering the rapid iteration and validation of our autonomous driving systems.

Role responsibilities

• AV Scenario Data Mining: Assist in analyzing and extracting critical driving scenarios and edge cases from vehicle log data (e.g., sensor feeds, speed, trajectories).

• Data Pipeline Support: Help build and maintain automated scripts (ETL) to parse, clean, and organize massive amounts of test data.

• Internal Tool Development: Assist in maintaining and developing basic features for our internal web dashboards (e.g., visualizing test metrics or scenario statistics).

• AI Agent Exploration: Under the guidance of your mentor, explore using AI agents/bots to perform automated data analysis and assist in scenario generalization.

Required Experience

• students studying BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

• Solid Python programming skills and comfort working in a Linux/Ubuntu environment.

• Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts.

• Strong logical thinking, a passion for autonomous driving, and a fast learner.

Bonus experience

• Basic experience with backend web development (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Django).

• Basic understanding of frontend development (e.g., React, Vue.js) or visualization tools.

• Curiosity about or basic experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) or AI Agents.

• Familiarity with Git and Docker.


We are looking for students with ability to commit to 4-6 months internship with us!

We also offer world-class benefits, fantastic culture, flexible working arrangements, and a great international working environment. Come and join us! Come change the world!

title: Investigator I - SME
description:
About the role and team

Community Operations at Uber is where real people solve real problems in real time. As a Safety Investigations Specialist II, you are a critical first responder for our community, providing fast and empathetic support during the moments that matter most. This isn't a standard support role; you will investigate urgent, sensitive, and critical safety incidents, enforcing safety standards and taking decisive action to secure accounts and protect our users.

The environment is intense, high-stakes, and often emotionally charged. You’ll need to balance deep empathy for individuals in distress with the analytical neutrality required to conduct a thorough investigation. We are looking for people who stay steady under pressure, possess high emotional intelligence, and are motivated by the challenge of making the real world safer for millions of riders, drivers, and couriers.

What you’ll do

  • Support riders, drivers, and couriers during critical moments—helping turn uncertainty into clarity through empathy, speed, and sound judgment.
  • Master multiple complex knowledge bases and contact management systems to document evidence and ensure every incident is categorized with precision.
  • Communicate with care and professionalism, even in emotionally charged situations, ensuring all reporting parties feel heard while maintaining investigative integrity.
  • Identify patterns and escalate issues that impact safety at scale—contributing to how our Special Investigations Unit and global teams improve over time.
  • Triage Focus: Manage a high-volume, live queue of sensitive and urgent incidents, performing initial interviews to gather case info and efficiently assigning cases to the right investigators.
  • Investigation Focus: Attend to the most critical and urgent incidents (L3-L4), analyzing evidence across multiple platforms to develop case details and take decisive actions on accounts.
  • SME Focus: Act as a multiplier for the team by providing real-time technical support to agents, monitoring queue health, and delivering training updates to ensure the team stays sharp.

Basic Qualifications

  • At least 6 months of customer support experience specifically handling sensitive issues.
  • Experience operating in multiple digital modalities and software tools with general computer proficiency.
  • Strong EQ, emotional regulation, communication, problem-solving, critical thinking.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in crisis centers, law enforcement, or social work where establishing trust with individuals in distress is required.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with a willingness to figure out the best path forward when answers aren't immediate.
  • Experience navigating high-volume, complex databases or contact management systems under tight SLAs.
  • A resilient and adaptable mindset that thrives in a collaborative, fast-changing, and high-intensity environment.

title: Senior Solution Engineer, Retail & Consumer Goods
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately close business.

Field related context

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the database space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 7-8 years of industry experience with a minimum of 5 years within a pre-sales environment

  • Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning and generative AI solutions in the cloud.

  • Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies. For example, Data Lake, Data Mesh, Data Fabric

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL,SQL analytics, and Python.

  • Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solutions

  • Ability to do deep discovery of customer’s architecture framework and connect those with Snowflake Data Architecture.

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred. Masters in DataScience or Business Administration is a plus.

  • Experience with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, etc), would be beneficial, but not required

  • Expect approximately 30% travel

About Our Team:

Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone.

About Snowflake:

Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future. And as a Snowflake employee, you will be accountable for supporting and enabling diversity and belonging.

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Because traditional on-premises and cloud solutions struggle with this, Snowflake developed an innovative product with a new built-for-the-cloud architecture that combines the power of data warehousing, the flexibility of big data platforms, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of the cost of traditional solutions.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

title: Consulting Director (South Australia)
description:
Consulting Director – Datacom Australia (South Australia)

At Datacom, we help organisations navigate change and unlock the full potential of digital in an AI-changing world. In Australia, our Consulting practice is growing and we’re building a team that can shape markets, shape thinking, and shape what “good consulting” looks like, shifting the dial from a technology-led environment to a consulting-led one.

We’re looking for a Consulting Director who is equally comfortable engaging at executive and senior leadership level, leading complex client conversations, and working alongside teams in delivery to bring structure to ambiguity. This is a senior consulting practitioner role, where leadership comes through thought leadership, client impact, and the ability to model and elevate consulting craft in others.

You’ll support the Head of Consulting Australia and the AU Markets team in growing our presence in market, shaping early-stage opportunities and strengthening Datacom’s position as a consulting-led technology partner. A key part of this role is how you show up in the front end of work: framing problems, shaping thinking with clients and turning ambiguity into clear, valuable pathways forward.

You will also play a critical role in lifting consulting capability across the broader team through coaching in practice, demonstrating strong methods, and setting the standard for how we operate as consultants in market.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and shape complex client engagements across strategy, transformation and technology domains.
  • Engage with customers to frame problems, challenge assumptions and shape thinking before solutions are defined.
  • Support presales activity including value framing, solution shaping, proposal development and client presentations.
  • Partner with sales, delivery, and platform teams to build compelling value propositions and win strategies.
  • Model strong consulting craft by bringing structure, methods, and approaches to ambiguous client challenges in real time.
  • Coach and uplift consulting capability across the team through direct engagement and on the job coaching.
  • Contribute to the development of new consulting offerings and repeatable approaches aligned to market demand, including AI and digital transformation opportunities.
  • Support growth of the AU consulting practice through opportunity shaping, relationship development and hands-on engagement leadership.
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement.
What We’re Looking For
  • Deep consulting experience with strong hands-on delivery in complex or transformations at scale within client environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to create structure and clarity around client outcomes and value and shape early-stage client thinking.
  • Strong presales and consulting origination capability (not just responding to defined requirements).
  • Proven ability to influence without authority and uplift others through modelling and coaching.
  • Comfortable operating across strategy, technology, and transformation conversations with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to identify and shape growth opportunities.
  • 10+ years’ experience in the Australian consulting or advisory market is highly desirable.
Why Datacom

Datacom is one of Australia and New Zealand’s largest providers of IT and professional services, with a strong heritage in infrastructure and managed services and an experienced and growing Professional Services and Systems Integrator capability. We have managed to maintain a dynamic, agile, small business feel that is often diluted in larger organisations of our size. It's our people that give Datacom its unique culture and energy that you can feel from the moment you meet with us.

We care about our people and provide a range of perks such as social events, chill-out spaces, remote working, flexi-hours and professional development courses to name a few. You’ll have the opportunity to learn, develop your career, connect and bring your true self to work. You will be recognised and valued for your contributions and be able to do your work in a collegial, flat-structured environment.

We operate at the forefront of technology to help Australia and New Zealand’s largest enterprise organisations explore possibilities and solve their greatest challenges, so you will never run out of interesting new challenges and opportunities.

We want Datacom to be an inclusive and welcoming workplace for everyone and take pride in the steps we have taken and continue to take to make our environment fun and friendly, and our people feel supported.

title: IT Solution Architect - PCHP
description:
The IT Solution Architect oversees the design, build, configuration, and operation of core Parkland Community HealthPlan (“PCHP”) business / clinical solutions. This role works with stakeholders, vendors, and other IT professionals to ensure successful implementation of planned solutions, while guiding Systems Analysts and Configuration Analysts on build and configuration options.

Minimum Specifications

Education

•Associate Degree in Information Systems / Computer Science or related discipline, or in healthcare related field is required.

•Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems / Computer Science or related discipline, or in healthcare related field preferred.

Experience

•Five (5) years of experience implementing and supporting healthcare IT solutions, utilizing open protocols and standards, such as HTTP, XML, JSON, and .Net across both SOAP and REST web services.

•Three (3) years of Solution Architect or equivalent experience.

Preferred Experience

•Experience working in Cognizant QNXT/CAE environments, specifically designing, developing, integrating, and deploying solutions utilizing QNXT/CAE Technical Foundations and supporting tools.

•Experience utilizing SQL and working with relational, OLTP databases in support of healthcare payer application integration.

•Experience architecting multi-layer solutions in cloud-based environments, such as Microsoft Azure, utilizing middleware/integration solutions such as BizTalk.

Skills or Special Abilities

•Strong systems development and integration skills, utilizing REST and SOAP web services.

•Strong skills with programming languages such as C++, C#, and Java /JavaScript.

•In-depth skills across Cognizant’s QNXT/CAE operating environments, such as QNXT Open Access, QNXT Connect, CareAdvance Web Services and Analytics Engine, and TCS integration.

•Strong knowledge of modern, cloud-based SaaS / PaaS solution architectures.

•Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability rules and how they influence the solutions that are implemented across healthcare organizations.

•Understands best practices and system controls surrounding the use of APIs to integrate across healthcare applications, including internal integration as well as B2B and B2C.

•Strong understanding of Managed-care Operational functions, including member enrollment, claims adjudication, provider data management, utilization management, and care management.

•Ability to perform deep research across application and infrastructure options leading to sound recommendations for new or enhanced IT enterprise solutions.

•Ability to optimize IT system solution designs based on business drivers, technology options, implementation timelines, and budgets.

•Ability to lead and collaborate across multiple teams, including vendors, internal IT, and business units.

•Ability to design systems that meet security, privacy, performance, and throughput requirements.

•Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical processes clearly and professionally across disciplines. Ability to communicate complex information in understandable terms.

•Strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across and beyond the organization.

•Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with great attention to detail across all layers of technology.

•Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple demands and respond to rapidly changing priorities.

•Ability to write clearly and succinctly with a high level of attention to detail.

•Proficient computer and Microsoft Office skills. Ability to learn new software programs.

•Knowledge of Texas Medicaid, National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), the Uniformed Managed Care Contract, and the Uniform Managed Care Manual.

Responsibilities

Operations

  • Designs, develops, and deploys system solutions and integrations across solutions leveraging both open and proprietary tools across PCHP’s QNXT and CAE system platform.
  • Performs technical research and analysis across existing and proposed vendor solutions and enabling technologies to ensure PCHP is optimizing IT system solutions to create efficiencies and generate high-quality outcomes.
  • Works with PCHP stakeholders, vendors, technology partners, and other PCHP IT-BI professionals to formulate optimal plans for leveraging capabilities across all PCHP IT solutions.
  • Produces design specifications and guides Systems Analysts, Configuration Analysts, and other IT professionals through the steps required to build, test, and deploy planned solutions.
  • Leads efforts to develop and maintain testing methods / plans for Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User-acceptance Testing across lower environments.
  • Works with vendors to establish and maintain a proper state across all lower environments, including scheduled refreshes as required.
  • Mentor other IT professionals in understanding IT application components, underlying technologies, and methods for integrating across IT system applications, inside and outside of PCHP.
  • Assists PCHP leadership in the development of cost estimates and budgets to implement and maintain required IT system solutions.
  • Develops and maintains architecture documents describing both at a high-level and in detail the data flows and functional integration across applications, both inside and outside of PCHP.
  • Assists in building enterprise architecture blueprints and data models that illustrate how information is stored, processed, and accessed across the PCHP enterprise.
  • Designs, builds, and tests end-to-end technology solutions in support of health plan clinical and business operations.

Quality

  • Integrate health literacy principles into all communication including Members and Providers.
  • Support strategies that meet clinical, quality and network improvement goals.
  • Promote the use of Health Information Technology to support and monitor the effectiveness of health and social interventions and make data-driven recommendations as needed.
  • For staff in clinical roles, foster collaborative relationships with members and/or providers to promote and support evidence-based practices and care coordination.

Regulatory

  • Ensures work is carried out in compliance with regulatory and/or accreditation standards as well as contractual requirements.

Professional Accountability

  • Promotes and supports a culturally welcoming and inclusive work environment.
  • Acts with the highest integrity and ethical standards while adhering to Parkland's Mission, Vision, and Values.
  • Adheres to organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Completes assigned training, self-appraisal, and annual health requirements timely.
  • Adheres to hybrid work schedule requirements.
  • Attends required meetings and town halls.
  • Recognizes and communicates ethical and legal concerns through the established channels of communication.
  • Demonstrates accountability and responsibility by independently completing work, including projects and assignments on time, and providing timely responses to requests for information.
  • Maintains confidentiality at all times.
  • Performs other work as requested that is reasonably related to the employee’s position, qualifications, and competencies.

title: Automation & Controls Technician, Infrastructure & Utility (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

AUTOMATION AND CONTROLS TECHNICIAN, INFRASTRUCTURE & UTILITY (STARSHIP)

Join the Infrastructure Engineering team at SpaceX to pioneer the design, build, operation, and maintenance of critical power, HVAC, utility and fluids systems systems for Starship's launch, production, propellant generation, and the city of Starbase, TX. As a technician, you'll work with a team to scale high-capacity infrastructure for the world's most powerful rocket, ensuring seamless energy and commodity for groundbreaking missions. The position is based at Starbase, TX, with potential travel to other SpaceX facilities.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Install, configure, operate, and maintain various automation, control and SCADA systems for the infrastructure and utility systems that run Starbase, TX.
  • Support cross-functional teams on projects and contribute to rapid, continuous improvements at Starbase.
  • Assist with control and automation upgrades to scale systems for Starship's production rate targets.
  • Deploy and troubleshoot standardized automation for critical power and utility systems.
  • Maintain organized documentation for all Starbase SCADA systems.
  • Support ground-up automation and controls projects, including commissioning, testing, hand-off, and training.
  • Configure and commission PLC, HMI, and SCADA applications in a high-reliability production/launch environment.
  • Update, redline, and troubleshoot electrical and pneumatic schematics using in-house and 3rd-party tools (EPLAN, Schematics, etc.).
  • Assemble and wire industrial electrical control panels that are NFPA 79/NEC/UL 508A compliant.
  • Install and maintain power systems controls and hardware in compliance with NFPA 70, 70B, 70E, NESC, and IEEE standards, prioritizing safety.
  • Create and update concise written and visual work instructions based on technical drawings and requirements.
  • Audit manufacturing processes, identifying inefficiencies, safety improvements, and automation opportunities.
  • Support development of SOWs and coordination of contractor work to enable the in-house build team to keep pace with production needs.
  • Train and mentor junior technicians in automation and controls tasks.
  • Proactively plan, prioritize, and execute weekly tasks to meet team objectives.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience installing, troubleshooting, and maintaining automation and controls systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in industrial automation or controls.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ISA CCST, NICET, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens).
  • Experience designing/developing HMI applications with Ignition.
  • Familiar with SEL, Allen Bradley and Siemens suite of control devices.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting server/client SCADA applications.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical one-line drawings, DC/AC schematics, and bills of materials.
  • Experience implementing control logic schemes (e.g., ladder logic) and basic network configurations.
  • Experience with IEC-61131 programming (ladder logic, structured text).
  • Experience with IT/OT network troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with industrial communications protocols: Modbus, IEEE C37.115, IEEE C37.111, DNP3, etc.
  • Experience with electrical schematic CAD tools (EPLAN, AutoCAD, etc.).
  • Experience with C#, .NET, Python, and/or SQL for scripting and automation tasks.
  • Demonstrated initiative, creative problem-solving, and strong hands-on troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to prioritize, schedule, and implement solutions with minimal operational impact.
  • Proven ability to work independently or in teams in dynamic, high-stress environments with tight deadlines.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.
  • Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support launch operations.
  • Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. unassisted.
  • Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

title: PPP Program Manager (Positive Parenting Program) - Biltmore Campus
description:
PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITY:

The Triple P Program Manager will oversee the implementation and contract execution of Triple P and supporting activities in Cherokee, Graham, Clay, Macon, Swain, Jackson, Haywood, Transylvania, Henderson, Polk, Rutherford, Buncombe, Madison, Yancey, Mitchel, McDowell, and Burke Counties.

The overall purpose of the Positive Parenting Program (Triple P) is to provide access to evidence-based parenting support and resources to caregivers through successful program adoption and delivery of Triple P within mental health agencies, non-profit family services, courts systems, and private and public health systems.

The Triple P Program Manager will work with and build community systems to strengthen the Triple P initiative, coverage, and support activities, to serve families of children 0-17 as well as parents of children with developmental and/or intellectual disabilities. The Triple P Program Manager will monitor regional outcomes related to child maltreatment, child injury, and parent stress.

The Triple P Program Manager will plan and manage the development, implementation, training and execution of sub-programs, special projects, and other initiatives designed to achieve the overall mission, goals, and objectives of the program.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

Supervision

  • Manage schedules

  • Meet regularly with staff for supervisory coaching and check-ins

  • Provide feedback for employee improvements

  • Review employee performance

  • Develop Strategic Implementation plan for Triple P

  • Collaborate with Rural Health Initiative Team to expand rural relationships

  • Partner with local, regional and state agencies to ensure workforce development needs are met

  • Implement the Stay Positive media-based parent campaign, develop relationships with local media outlets, and serve as spokesperson in close collaboration with program director

  • Participate in the North Carolina Triple P State Learning Collaborative to share best practices

  • Lead sustainability efforts, including the development of a Sustainability Manual

  • Use feedback data from Triple P Trainers to hone new trainees Triple P skills

  • Coordinate access to provider website and on-line access to tools and evaluation reporting system

  • Provide support to Agencies and Providers to turn in quarterly data

Resource Development

  • Plan, develop, and implement strategies for identifying and generating funding and/or resource opportunities for program activities, to include development of grant and other fundraising proposals

Provides daily guidance, supervision and direction on tasks within agencies with Triple P Trained practitioners

Integrity and Accountability

Establishes clear expectations for self and others to achieve stated goals and objectives. Exemplifies conduct congruent with MAHEC values and professional guidelines.

title: Practice Architect AI/ML
description:
Practice Architect AI/ML ( Full-time, Remote)

Think of TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) as the growth solution for enterprises today. We unleash growth through technology, strategy, design, execution and operations with a customer-first mindset for bold business leaders. We deliver cloud, data and customer experience solutions. Our partnerships with leading cloud, design and business intelligence platforms fuel our expertise. We value deep relationships, dedication to serving others and inclusion. We drive positive outcomes for our people and our business, and we stay true to our commitments and act in harmony with our words. We exist to create significant opportunity for people to achieve fulfillment through career success.

Ready to join us?

Here’s what the opportunity supported through our TGS Talent Acquisition Team requires:

The Practice Architect, Level 1 is a hands-on technical leader who translates enterprise business problems into governed, production-ready AI solutions. You will architect and build agentic systems on the Claude platform, spanning multi-agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and retrieval pipelines, while partnering with client stakeholders to ensure every solution is secure, scalable, and compliant.

This is a builder-architect role: roughly half your time is spent designing solution architectures and the other half writing the code, patterns, and reusable assets that bring them to life. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering discipline, cloud architecture, and applied AI.

Key responsibilities

• Solution architecture: design end-to-end AI/ML solution architectures for client engagements, from requirements through deployment, with clear trade-off documentation.

• Agentic system development: build and productionize agentic workflows using Claude, MCP servers, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or Strands).

• AI-assisted engineering: lead adoption of AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor AI, establishing patterns and guardrails that raise engineering velocity and quality.

• Cloud architecture: architect and deploy solutions across GCP, AWS, or Azure, applying well-architected principles for reliability, cost, and security.

• AI FinOps & cost governance: establish cost visibility and spend governance for AI workloads across multi-cloud estates (GCP, Azure, WCNP); model token economics and build guardrails that keep agentic systems economically sustainable at scale.

• Security & guardrails: design security into every solution: secure-by-default architectures, least-privilege agent and tool permissions, input/output mediation, and defenses against prompt injection and excessive agency, anchored to the OWASP LLM Top 10.

• Governance & compliance: embed responsible-AI controls aligned to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act; define human-in-the-loop review gates, audit logging, and output provenance so systems are defensible to auditors and clients.

• Reusable assets: contribute to the shared CoE library of skills, MCP servers, and reference architectures so patterns are reused across the client portfolio.

• Client partnership: engage directly with client architects and stakeholders; present designs, run technical workshops, and mentor engineers on the account.

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in Python and modern software design practices.

• 3+ years working in applied AI, including hands-on experience with LLM platforms (Claude strongly preferred) and AI development tools such as Cursor AI or Claude Code.

• Demonstrated experience building AI applications: prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration, or MCP / tool-calling integrations.

• Cloud architecture experience on at least one major platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including compute, storage, networking, and IAM fundamentals.

• Proven ability to design and document solution architectures and communicate technical trade-offs to both engineers and business stakeholders.

• Working knowledge of application and AI security: secure design principles, least privilege, and guardrails against common LLM risks (e.g. prompt injection, insecure output handling).

description:
Description

The IT Field Services Technician provides advanced onsite and field-based technical support for multiple practice and headquarters locations. This role serves as an escalation point for the Service Desk, performs comprehensive onsite IT assessments, and supports server and virtual machine environments. The position requires frequent travel, after-hours support availability, and strong hands-on technical expertise across Windows, macOS, and enterprise infrastructure technologies. This role is ideal for a highly motivated IT professional who thrives in a dynamic, multi-site environment and enjoys combining technical depth with customer-facing support. Key Responsibilities Field Services & Deployment • Deploy, configure, and support IT equipment at practice locations and headquarters, including servers, desktops, laptops, peripherals, and network-connected devices • Perform onsite installations and refreshes of PC and Mac systems, ensuring compliance with company standards • Coordinate IT equipment rollouts, relocations, and decommissions across multiple sites Onsite IT Assessments • Conduct comprehensive onsite IT practice assessments to evaluate infrastructure, hardware, software, and security posture • Identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities; document findings and recommend remediation plans • Partner with IT leadership to standardize and improve onsite IT environments Onsite Support & Field Coverage • Provide onsite IT support for local DFW practices and remote sites as needed • Travel frequently to support multi-site operations, including potential out-of-state locations • Serve as a trusted technical resource for end users, vendors, and leadership at supported locations Advanced & Tier 3 Support • Act as Tier 3 escalation support for the Service Desk, resolving complex hardware, software, and infrastructure issues • Diagnose and resolve advanced Windows, macOS, and networking issues • Provide root cause analysis and contribute to long-term resolution strategies Server & Virtual Infrastructure Support • Support Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP • Assist with server and virtual machine provisioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and patching • Collaborate with infrastructure and security teams on system reliability and performance Documentation & Process Improvement • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles • Track work, changes, and assets using IT service management and documentation tools • Provide suggestions to improve processes based on support experience. On-Call & After-Hours Support • Provide after-hours and weekend support as required to maintain business continuity Required Qualifications • 5+ years of experience in IT Support, Field Services, or Infrastructure roles • Intermediate to strong experience with: o Windows Server environments o Active Directory administration o Windows OS and macOS support o PC and workstation installations and troubleshooting • Demonstrated experience supporting users onsite across multiple locations • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a field-based role • Willingness and ability to travel frequently, including occasional out-of-state travel, up to 80% travel • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record Preferred Qualifications • Industry certifications such as: o CompTIA A+ o CompTIA Network+ o ITIL Foundation • Experience supporting dental, clinical, or multi-practice environments (preferred) • Familiarity with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or similar) • Experience working in hybrid or enterprise IT environments Physical & Work Requirements • Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 75 lbs • Ability to work in office, clinical, and field environments • Availability for after-hours and weekend support (minimal)

title: Event Monitoring Specialist
description:
Life @ AP+:

We are one connected team in pursuit of one inspiring purpose – to unite people and technology to power better experiences.

At AP+, you’ll work on technology that matters. We operate payments and identity infrastructure connecting banks, financial institutions, retailers, businesses, government agencies and fintechs – helping Australians pay, get paid and prove who they are every day.

That means knowing what’s happening across our technology environment – and spotting when something isn’t right – is critical.

You’ll be part of an environment where observability, automation and actionable insights help keep important services running securely and reliably. You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, challenge alert noise and improve how we detect and respond to issues.

And while the work we do is important, we still make room for fun, friendships and flexibility in our daily lives.

The Purpose

See the signal. Cut through the noise. Help us spot issues before our customers do.

As our Event Monitoring Specialist, you’ll help shape how AP+ detects, understands and responds to events across our critical technology services.

This isn’t a role where you simply watch dashboards and react to alerts.

You’ll help to re-design, evolve and continuously improve our Event Management capability – connecting monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace with ServiceNow to create cleaner, better correlated and more actionable events.

You’ll help to configure observability tools to use alerts, logs, performance metrics and service data to identify anomalies, degradation and emerging risks. Just as importantly, you’ll help turn that technical data into a clear picture of service health and business impact.

The goal? Less noise. Better signals. Faster detection. Smarter response.

Key Responsibilities the Role Owns:

  • Own and optimise Event Management – design and continuously improve event rules, correlation, severity mapping, prioritisation, suppression, routing and automated workflows.
  • Make monitoring smarter – integrate and optimise Dynatrace and ServiceNow to deliver accurate event ingestion and meaningful mapping to applications and business services.
  • Turn noise into actionable signals – analyse alerts, logs, metrics and service data to identify anomalies, recurring issues, service degradation and emerging operational risks.
  • Get ahead of incidents – validate, correlate, prioritise and escalate events so the right teams have the right diagnostic information when it matters most.
  • Build visibility that drives action – create dashboards, health reporting and operational insights that give teams a clear view of service performance and support major incident detection and response.
  • Automate wherever it makes sense – help advance auto-ticketing, event enrichment, correlation and remediation while working across infrastructure, application and monitoring teams to continually improve how Event Management works.

You’ll likely be a strong fit for this role if:

You’re someone who gets satisfaction from finding the signal hidden in the noise.

You’re naturally curious about what’s happening underneath the surface of a technology environment. You can look across events, alerts, logs and performance data, connect the dots and translate what you’re seeing into something teams can act on.

You’ll bring:

  • Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow Event Management, including event rules, alert correlation and MID Server configuration.
  • Strong experience with Dynatrace or similar monitoring and observability platforms, using monitoring data to identify issues and understand service performance.
  • Experience working with CMDB, CI classes and service mapping relationships, and an understanding of how infrastructure and applications connect to business services.
  • Strong analytical capability across alerts, logs, operational data and performance metrics, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies and emerging risks.
  • Experience within service operations, network operations, application support or service management, ideally supporting complex and business-critical technology environments.
  • A continuous improvement mindset – you’re interested in automation, better correlation, cleaner data and reducing alert noise, and you can communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    A relevant qualification or industry certification across technology, data analytics, service management, observability or monitoring is valuable, but equivalent practical experience matters too.

What happens next:

At AP+, we believe in the power of passion, pride and purpose. Our team is driven by a shared mission to make a difference in the world of payments, and we're proud to work together towards this common goal.

If you’re an Event Monitoring specialist who loves turning complex technology signals into clear, actionable insight, we’d love to hear from you.

If you’re ready to be a game changer, please submit your application. The Talent Acquisition team will endeavour to review your application and notify you of the outcome within the next two weeks.

We want to remove all barriers to inclusion, so if you need advice or support with your application, we’re here to help. Please reach out to recruitment@auspayplus.com.au. We also encourage you to let us know your pronouns at any point during the recruitment process.

AP+ are not partnering with Recruitment agencies for this role.

title: Copilot, Cowork & Copilot Studio Governance Engineer
description:
Job Title: Copilot & Copilot Studio Governance EngineerJob Description

This contract role focuses on designing, implementing, and operationalising robust governance for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Copilot agents across the tenant. You will establish agent sharing and exemption controls, build and maintain an agent inventory and risk baseline, remediate high‑exposure agents, implement data‑protection controls, and enable safe, scalable adoption. A key outcome of the engagement is a self‑sustaining governance framework supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and effective knowledge transfer.

Responsibilities
  • Configure and maintain agent access, sharing, publishing, and lifecycle governance across the tenant, including an approved‑publisher model and exemption workflow in collaboration with Information Security.
  • Design and operate agent sharing governance, including tenant‑wide restrictions and an exemption request and approval workflow, fully operational in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Control System.
  • Govern Copilot Studio declarative and custom‑engine agents by configuring Managed Environments, environment routing, connector and data loss prevention (DLP) policies, and least‑privilege access controls.
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive tenant‑wide agent registry and inventory, ensuring it remains complete and up to date.
  • Develop and apply a transparent, repeatable risk‑scoring model for agents, assessing custom actions, data‑source scope, embedded files, sharing breadth, and labelling gaps.
  • Baseline, prioritise, and remediate high‑exposure agents, including action‑taking and connector‑based agents and agents with embedded sensitivity labels, and ensure DLP is applied consistently across agents and their grounding data.
  • Identify and close gaps in sensitivity labelling and DLP coverage across agents and associated data sources.
  • Monitor pay‑as‑you‑go usage and Copilot Credits, define billing‑policy guardrails, and establish maker enablement guardrails to support safe and cost‑effective adoption.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, standards, guardrails, and documentation that support ongoing governance operations and knowledge transfer.
  • Align agent controls with organisational confidentiality requirements and client or matter obligations, including considerations related to ethical walls and matter security.
  • Report governance status, risk posture, and remediation progress to IT leadership in a clear and timely manner.
  • Produce maker guidance and best‑practice materials to support Desktop Experience and AI Solutions teams on agent access, configuration, and adoption.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, security, and business teams to ensure governance policies are practical, well‑understood, and consistently applied.
  • Contribute to the safe adoption of new Microsoft AI capabilities by embedding governance into day‑to‑day processes and tools.
Essential Skills
  • At least 5 years of hands‑on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra, with recent, demonstrable focus on Copilot and/or Power Platform governance.
  • Proven experience administering Microsoft 365 Copilot, including the Copilot Control System, and building and governing agents in Copilot Studio and Copilot Agent Builder.
  • Strong proficiency with the Power Platform admin centre, including Managed Environments, DLP and connector policies, and environment strategy.
  • In‑depth knowledge of Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and data loss prevention, with experience operationalising controls and lifecycle processes at scale.
  • Ability to automate administrative and governance tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
  • Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear runbooks, standards, and guidance for technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to explain complex governance concepts and influence adoption of best practices.
  • Demonstrated capability in effective knowledge transfer, enabling teams to own and sustain governance processes after the engagement.
  • Solid communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as a team player.
Additional Skills & Qualifications
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot for security or related Copilot solutions and/or Microsoft Agent 365.
  • Familiarity with ethical walls, matter security, and confidentiality‑sensitive access controls.
  • Understanding of pay‑as‑you‑go metering models and Copilot Credits, including how to implement appropriate guardrails.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications, such as AI Administrator Associate, Power Platform, Security/Identity, or Information Protection/Purview certifications.
  • Prior experience working in a law firm, professional services organisation, or another regulated, confidentiality‑sensitive environment.
  • Comfort operating in high‑pressure, deadline‑driven settings where risk management and precision are critical.
Why Work Here?

You will work with cutting‑edge Microsoft AI technologies in a global, forward‑thinking environment that is actively investing in modern digital capabilities. The organisation values expertise, encourages innovation, and offers the opportunity to shape how advanced AI tools are governed and adopted at scale. You will gain deep exposure to complex, real‑world governance challenges and have the chance to leave a lasting impact through frameworks, standards, and practices that will continue beyond the contract.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote, full‑time role based in the United States, operating on standard US business hours with required overlap with Eastern Time. The engagement is a 6‑month fixed‑term contract, with the possibility of extension by mutual agreement. You will work within a high‑pressure legal and professional services context where confidentiality, regulatory compliance, and matter security are central to daily operations. The environment is highly technical, leveraging Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Agent Builder, Power Platform, Microsoft Purview, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph as core tools. Work is primarily conducted using standard remote collaboration technologies, with an expectation of professional, business‑appropriate presentation in virtual interactions.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of New York, NY.

Pay and Benefits

The pay range for this position is $90.00 - $105.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following: • Medical, dental & vision • Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available • Life Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents) • Short and long-term disability • Health Spending Account (HSA) • Transportation benefits • Employee Assistance Program • Time Off/Leave (PTO, Vacation or Sick Leave)

CARD treats autistic individuals using the principles of applied behavior analysis (ABA), which is empirically proven to be the most effective method addressing the behaviors and deficits commonly associated with autism. With locations throughout the US, CARD’s mission is to provide top-quality services that help every patient fulfill their potential and live joyful lives. title: Case Administrator
description:
Description

**Parking is not included and costs about $400/month to park in the building. There is a lot a couple blocks away that is closer to $200/month

Our client's Dispute Resolution Services team handles the arbitration and mediation of disputes involving investors, brokerage firms, and their registered representatives. This is crucial to upholding the integrity of our stock markets. This person will be assigned a docket of cases, with responsibility to ensure that all case activities proceed timely and accurately.

Essential Job Functions:

• Manages assigned docket of cases, with responsibility to ensure that all case activities proceed timely and accurately. Utilizes the ODR Portal and internal docket management programs.

• Analyzes assigned cases for accuracy and completeness, and anticipates and resolves issues that may arise during the course of the case.

• Acts as liaison between parties and arbitrators to facilitate resolution of pre-hearing motions and requests.

• Ensures that motions for the panel are addressed in a timely manner and monitors case-related reports to ensure compliance with deadlines and expectations.

• Analyzes, summarizes and makes recommendations on administrative motions for decision by the Director, with limited assistance.

• Advises panel as to procedural matters and provides guidance on FINRA's arbitration rules and procedures, with limited assistance.

• Answers parties’ pre and post award inquiries orally and in writing.

• Provides excellent customer service, and responds to customer complaints orally and in writing.

• Attends hearings when necessary to observe arbitrators and fairness of the proceedings.

• Drafts and serves awards in a timely manner, disposing of all issues submitted for resolution with limited assistance.

• Closes cases by award in a timely manner and ensures that they are closed with financial accuracy.

• Evaluates arbitrator performance.

• Monitors post-award litigation.

• Initiates disciplinary referrals.

- will be responsible for leading a team of 3

- Responsible for drafting arbitration awards.

- Requires strong writing skills with a high level of accuracy—published work must be error-free.

• Expertise using a desktop computer with the full suite of electronic office applications and other office equipment.

• Strong knowledge of electronic docket management programs and web-based Portal systems a plus.

• Excellent customer service, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills required.

• Must be highly organized and able to perform multiple tasks efficiently and accurately, in a fast-paced environment and under tight time constraints.

• Must function effectively in a team environment and work with others to meet deadlines.

• Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and professional demeanor.

• Strong communication, time management, organizational and attention to detail skills.

• Candidate must demonstrate discretion and sound judgment, due to the confidential nature of the work.

• Strong leadership skills required.

Must be able to go on site to LA office 3x per week. There may be times when they will need to be in 5x per week but it would be planned out months in advance.

Seeking a candidate with experience and demonstrated interest in arbitration or alternative dispute resolution (ADR), including arbitration, mediation, negotiation, or the security industry.

Candidates should show a genuine focus on ADR—this is not suited for someone who has only practiced law without specific interest or exposure to these areas.
