title: (Creative / Senior / Lead) CMF Designer
description:
Job Description

Work Arrangement

This role is categorized as on-site. Successful candidates are expected to work full time from the GM China Advanced Technical Center in Shanghai, China.

About GM China Design Studio

GM China Design Studio is both a production design studio and an advanced design studio. We shape meaningful vehicle experiences for GM brands serving customers in China and global markets, connecting near-term production programs with forward-looking exploration.

We are committed to creating an exceptional design environment where creativity, beauty, craftsmanship, and storytelling can thrive. Our designers work across disciplines and cultures to translate customer understanding, brand identity, emerging technologies, and new forms of mobility into compelling color, material, finish, and sensory experiences.

About This Evergreen Requisition

This evergreen requisition is established for talent pipelining purposes. GM China Design Studio is building a long-term pipeline of exceptional CMF Designers in support of current and anticipated business needs.

We welcome applications from outstanding designers around the world who are interested in contributing to exciting production programs and advanced design work in our China studio. Depending on business needs and the candidate’s experience, future opportunities may involve different levels of project ownership, creative responsibility, technical depth, and collaboration with global teams.

When submitting your application, please include:

  • An updated resume or CV.
  • An updated portfolio that clearly demonstrates your CMF design thinking, research, concept development, visual communication, material exploration, and relevant design work.
  • Please ensure that your portfolio does not contain undisclosed, confidential, proprietary, or otherwise sensitive information, projects, or materials belonging to current or previous employers or clients.

After your application is submitted, our recruiting and design teams will review your materials. If there is alignment with a current or future opportunity, a recruiter will contact you to discuss potential next steps. Because this is an evergreen requisition, the timing of contact may vary according to business needs and the fit between your experience and upcoming opportunities.

If you do not meet every element listed below but are interested in exploring an opportunity with GM China Design Studio, we still encourage you to apply. We value distinctive creative perspectives, strong design potential, and the ability to contribute to a collaborative studio environment.

The Role -

CMF Designers in GM China Design Studio help shape the emotional, visual, and tactile experience of GM vehicles and advanced products for China and global markets. You may contribute across color, material, finish, graphics, trim, components, products, and other experiential or environmental design applications.

The role may span the complete CMF design process, from cultural and trend research, material innovation, and concept story creation through design development, supplier collaboration, color and material validation, production implementation, and final execution. You will work closely with interior, exterior, advanced design, UX/HMI, engineering, manufacturing, marketing, purchasing, suppliers, and global design studios to ensure that CMF solutions are distinctive, feasible, high quality, and aligned with design intent, cost, and timing.

Some opportunities may also involve customer-facing customization or dealership support, where you would help understand customer requirements and translate them into thoughtful and personalized CMF recommendations.

What You May Do

Your responsibilities may include the following, depending on your experience, assigned program, and business needs:

  • Participate in CMF design for current and future GM vehicles, advanced products, mobility concepts, and related experiences across interiors, exteriors, and other design applications.
  • Research global and regional cultural influences, consumer behavior, lifestyle developments, automotive trends, fashion, architecture, technology, art, materials, and manufacturing innovation.
  • Analyze current design and material trends, anticipate emerging directions, and translate insights into relevant CMF strategies for future product development.
  • Develop CMF concept stories, color and material directions, finish proposals, trim strategies, graphic applications, and cohesive design narratives that express brand identity and create emotional customer experiences.
  • Explore innovative materials, finishes, processes, and technologies, balancing creativity, sustainability, sensory quality, durability, manufacturability, and program requirements.
  • Communicate CMF ideas through physical samples, material boards, color chips, sketches, digital 2D and 3D visualization, animation, renderings, VR, presentations, and other appropriate design media.
  • Use industry-standard or comparable tools to visualize and communicate concepts, which may include VRED, Blender, Photoshop, Illustrator, KeyShot, Unreal Engine, Premiere, After Effects, AI-enabled design tools, or other evolving technologies.
  • Collaborate with interior, exterior, advanced design, UX/HMI, engineering, manufacturing, marketing, purchasing, and other cross-functional partners to integrate CMF solutions into complete vehicle and product experiences.
  • Manage or support the CMF development process from early concept and material research through color and material development, supplier engagement, validation, production implementation, and final execution.
  • Work with suppliers and vendors to identify new resources, develop materials and finishes, resolve technical or quality issues, and ensure that design intent is maintained through implementation.
  • Build, organize, and maintain a comprehensive internal library of innovative materials, finishes, colors, samples, references, and supplier resources.
  • Balance design ambition with cost, timing, quality, durability, manufacturing, sustainability, regulatory, and other program considerations.
  • Present CMF concepts, trend research, material proposals, and project recommendations to design leadership, management, cross-functional teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear communication across global teams, regions, time zones, suppliers, and partners, building strong and productive working relationships.
  • Support multiple projects and manage personal workflows effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
  • Depending on the assignment, support customer-facing customization work at dealerships or other locations by understanding customer requirements and providing informed recommendations on color, material, finish, trim, and related design choices.
  • Contribute to a collaborative studio culture by sharing knowledge, supporting other designers, and, for more experienced designers, mentoring or guiding colleagues when appropriate.
  • Travel domestically or internationally when needed for design reviews, supplier development, material research, customer engagement, production support, or collaboration with global design teams.

What You May Bring

We welcome CMF designers with different career paths, backgrounds, and levels of experience. The following qualifications are intended to describe capabilities that may be relevant to these opportunities rather than serve as a checklist that every applicant must fully satisfy.

  • A degree in Color and Materials Design, CMF Design, Textile Design, Fashion Design, Industrial Design, Transportation Design, Automotive Design, Product Design, Fine Arts, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience and a compelling portfolio may also be considered.
  • Experience in automotive CMF, transportation, mobility, industrial design, product design, materials, fashion, textiles, architecture, interiors, graphics, experiential design, or another closely related field.
  • The ability to develop thoughtful and distinctive CMF concepts, strategies, stories, color palettes, material directions, finish proposals, and design recommendations.
  • A strong sense of color, material, texture, finish, pattern, proportion, detail, craftsmanship, and overall aesthetics.
  • The ability to connect CMF decisions with brand identity, customer needs, cultural context, user experience, technology, and the broader design vision.
  • Experience with material research, trend analysis, concept storytelling, sample development, supplier collaboration, color and material validation, or production implementation. The depth of experience expected will vary according to the opportunity.
  • Familiarity with automotive or product development and manufacturing processes is valuable, while experience from adjacent design fields is also welcome.
  • The ability to communicate design intent through physical samples, material boards, sketches, 2D and 3D visualization, digital rendering, presentations, or other effective visual and tactile methods.
  • Proficiency in relevant design and visualization software is welcome. Tools may include VRED, Blender, Photoshop, Illustrator, KeyShot, Unreal Engine, Premiere, After Effects, AI-enabled design tools, or comparable software. The specific toolset is less important than the quality of the design thinking and the ability to learn and adapt.
  • An understanding of material performance, manufacturing constraints, supplier capabilities, durability, quality, sustainability, cost, timing, and the relationship between creative intent and production execution.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to clearly articulate a design vision and collaborate across functions, regions, cultures, and time zones.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and workflows independently, while also contributing effectively within a team.
  • A curious, proactive, and adaptable approach to new materials, technologies, cultural influences, customer expectations, and emerging design opportunities.
  • Good English communication skills are beneficial for collaboration with global design studios and cross-functional partners. Additional language skills may be advantageous for some opportunities.
  • For more experienced opportunities: the ability to independently drive CMF development, establish design direction, manage complex stakeholder and supplier relationships, influence cross-functional decisions, support production implementation, and mentor other designers.
  • For emerging opportunities: demonstrated design potential, curiosity, willingness to learn, and the ability to develop thoughtful CMF concepts through a strong research, material, and visual communication process.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing customization, dealership engagement, or high-end client needs may be beneficial for some opportunities, but it is not required for every position in this talent pipeline.

Why Join GM China Design Studio

You will have the opportunity to work in a studio that connects advanced design exploration with real production impact. You will collaborate with colleagues across China and the global GM Design network, explore the future of materials and sensory experience, contribute to vehicles and advanced products for diverse customers, and help shape the next generation of automotive design through color, material, finish, creativity, beauty, technology, and storytelling.

We are interested in meeting exceptional CMF designers at different stages of their careers and from a range of related design disciplines. Your portfolio, perspective, and potential may align with an opportunity even if your experience does not map perfectly to every item in this description.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Put your skills to the test by pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. From global defense to sustainment and modernization to mission readiness, your experience and ability will make it a reality. Our programs are built on equal parts of curiosity and collaboration. Our combined effort means our customers can connect and defend millions of people around the world. With Northrop Grumman, you’ll have the opportunity to be an essential part of projects that will define your career, now and in the future.

In this position, you will join our Manufacturing Operations Organization within our Aeronautics Systems sector as a Manufacturing Technician – Level 2 supporting our Clearfield, UT site. We’re seeking a hands-on professional with exceptional attention to detail, a strong commitment to quality, and outstanding interpersonal skills.

This position may be filled at varying shift times including weekdays, nights, and weekends (shift differential paid during eligible shifts).

Please note: Only external candidates and NG employees who are not currently Manufacturing Techs at the Clearfield site may be considered under this requisition.


Essential Functions:

  • Read and understand blueprints

  • Translate blueprints into fabrications of structural assemblies to include precision drilling, countersinking, and the use of calibrated tools

  • Aligning parts on jigs using templates and fixtures

  • Performing part-fitting operations: filing sawing, burring, crimping, trimming, framing, riveting, drilling, and reaming

  • Measures parts with precision tools such as micrometers and calipers to verify dimensions

  • May modify incomplete and complete assemblies to incorporate changes to structure and verify quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedure

  • Daily usage of manufacturing shop controls and systems

  • Use of appropriate PPE when working on the shop floor

  • Recommend and implement continuous improvement activities in production methods, equipment performance, and team effectiveness

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED and a minimum of 2 years of experience in an aerospace, automotive, military, manufacturing and/or maintenance environment

  • This position requires the ability to perform moderate strenuous physical and repetitious work to include: bending, stooping, kneeling, carrying tools, lifting up to 35 pounds, working overhead or at heights, and accessing small, confined spaces

  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Secret level clearance and Special Program Access within a reasonable period, as defined by the company to meet its business needs. U.S. Citizenship required for clearance.

  • Must successfully complete and pass the “ASTAR New Hire Training / Compliance” within a reasonable time period, as defined by the company to meet its business need

  • Must have the ability to work any shift

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Current/active U.S. Government Secret level clearance

  • Experience in aerospace manufacturing

Job Description

About the role:

The Digital Product, Senior Manager leads a product initiative within the Takeda portfolio, focusing on customer needs and strategic product roadmap for Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) solution across Takeda labs. This role ensures the product aligns with business objectives and delivers value across the organization.

How you will contribute:

  • Establish and evolve a globally standardized ELN ecosystem across Takeda QC laboratories.
  • Define and execute the ELN product strategy, roadmap, governance, and investment priorities.
  • Enable consistent, compliant, and scalable laboratory processes through harmonized ELN capabilities and data standards.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in laboratory efficiency, data integrity, user experience, and operational visibility.
  • Drive successful adoption and sustained use of ELN solutions across Takeda sites and regions.
  • Provide strategic technical direction for complex, multi-component, and multi-regional ELN initiatives.
  • Ensure ELN solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned with Takeda’s digital and laboratory strategies.
  • Strengthen collaboration among Global DD&T, QC, laboratory, and business stakeholders to align ELN capabilities with evolving business needs.
  • Advance the ELN portfolio to support connected, integrated, and digitally enabled laboratory operations.
  • Build a high-performing ELN capability that delivers sustainable value through effective governance, knowledge management, and continuous improvement.


Skills and qualifications:

Technical and Functional Expertise

  • Strong technical expertise in ELN, LIMS, laboratory instruments, instrument integration, and laboratory data systems.
  • Experience with laboratory technologies.
  • Strong understanding of laboratory processes, workflows, data integrity, and GxP requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into scalable, compliant, and user-focused technology solutions.
  • Experience implementing, configuring, integrating, testing, validating, and supporting ELN solutions.
  • Ability to manage complex technical issues, dependencies, risks, and system lifecycle activities.
  • Strong business acumen in laboratory informatics and the ability to align technology investments with business outcomes.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum, project delivery, change management, and continuous improvement practices.

Leadership and Delivery

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, multi-project, and multi-regional teams.
  • Own and maintain the ELN product strategy, roadmap, governance, priorities, and delivery plans.
  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to lead organizational change, build stakeholder commitment, and support users through adoption.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for outcomes, decisions, commitments, and deliverables.
  • Able to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple initiatives, and deliver high-quality results under tight timelines.
  • Self-directed, resourceful, resilient, and comfortable operating in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to address ambiguity and make sound risk-based decisions.
  • Ability to develop team capabilities through coaching, knowledge sharing, and effective delegation.
  • Commitment to operational excellence, compliance, continuous improvement, and customer-focused delivery.
  • Understanding of financial management, including resource planning, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.

Stakeholder and Vendor Interaction

  • Ability to understand diverse stakeholder needs and achieve alignment across sites, regions, and functions.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Pre-Op/Post-Op/Intra-Operative RN
description:
Provide patient-centered nursing care in accordance with professional and regulatory standards. Assess and monitor patients, administer treatments, document care, operate equipment, and communicate changes to the healthcare team. Promote patient safety, education, advocacy, and continuity of care through effective collaboration.


Essential Functions


Assess patients’ conditions and record their medical histories and symptoms


Observe patients and record the observations and assessments in patient’s electronic health record (EHR)


Administer patients’ medications and treatments


Set up plans for patients’ care and contribute information to existing plans


Consult and collaborate with doctors and other healthcare professionals


Operate and monitor medical equipment and assist with diagnostic testing and analysis of results


Educate patients and their families on managing illnesses or injuries and following care instructions at home after treatment


May perform department tasks including one or more of the following:


Pre-Op:

· Check all charts (doctor’s orders) for the surgery day

· Check surgery schedule for surgery add-ons or cancellations

· Check all equipment including glucometer, O2 tanks, and suction

· Check Crash-cart to ensure all medications are in the appropriate place and stocked. Defibrillator and monitor tested and noted in log

· Count narcotics and document them

· Greet patients and properly identify patients per policy/procedure

· Orient and familiarize the patient with the surroundings

· Recheck charts to ensure all operative consents are signed and witnessed

· Take vitals and start IV’s


Operating Room:

· Assist with preparation of the operating room, including checking functionality of equipment and all necessary supplies are available

· Competently operate equipment in the operating room (OR)

· Be the patient advocate during surgery

· Ensure safety measures are carried out by the OR team (e.g., timeouts, counts, positioning, infection control)

· Document all pertinent information in patient EHR, and report information to team members, the surgeon, and anesthesia personnel


Post-Op:

· Receive handoff of patient from OR with reports from circulating nurse and anesthesia

· Assess patient’s respiratory function; take vitals, including pain score, and record all information, looking for any signs of post-op/anesthetic adverse reactions. Notify surgeon and anesthesia if applicable

· Record all care/assessment of patient in EHR including patient belongings

· Provide supportive reassurance to patients and caregivers

· Follow post-op orders requested from each surgeon

· Provide detailed post-op instructions to patients and caregivers about care after discharge

title: IAM Automation Engineer
description:
This is a long-term contract with potential to convert FTE if the candidate does not need any type of work sponsorship. This is a remote position although candidate that are able to come on site would be preferred.

Top Skills' Details

• 3–7+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, with a focus on automation and integration

• Experience working in enterprise environments with complex identity ecosystems

• Demonstrated experience delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency and reduce manual effort. This would include any spearheading, implementing, or leading IAM automation for a company.

  • Communication skills will be highly important. The client wants someone who can explain their experience in good detail as that will display their ability to be articulate in meetings with other teams and showcase their skills in explaining technical IAM initiatives to people of different lines of business.

Description

The IAM Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automation solutions across Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms to improve efficiency, security, and scalability. This role focuses on streamlining identity lifecycle processes, enhancing governance controls, and reducing manual operational overhead through automation, integration, and orchestration. The engineer partners closely with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, and Application teams to enable secure, scalable access management aligned with enterprise standards.

Job Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain automation solutions for IAM processes, including provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews

• Develop and enhance workflows within IAM platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk) to support identity lifecycle management

• Integrate IAM systems with enterprise applications, directories, and cloud services using APIs and connectors

• Automate role-based and attribute-based access controls (RBAC/ABAC) to improve governance and compliance

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement access policies and automation strategies

• Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes and drive operational efficiency through scripting and orchestration

• Support audit and compliance initiatives by ensuring automated controls, logging, and reporting are in place

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IAM automation workflows, integrations, and data accuracy

• Contribute to the development of IAM standards, best practices, and reusable automation frameworks

• Monitor and optimize automation performance, reliability, and scalability

Skills

Automation, scripting, Python/Powershell/Java or similar scripting languages, directory services

Top Skills Details

Automation,scripting,Python/Powershell/Java or similar scripting languages,directory services

Additional Skills & Qualifications

• Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management concepts, including provisioning, authentication, authorization, and governance

• Hands-on experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint (IIQ/ISC), Okta, CyberArk, or similar tools

• Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Java, or similar)

• Experience working with APIs, web services (REST/SOAP), and system integration

• Knowledge of directory services (Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD)

• Familiarity with access control models (RBAC, ABAC) and identity lifecycle processes (Joiner/Mover/Leaver)

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues

• Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders

title: AI Full Stack Developer – 12 months contract
description:
Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end web applications spanning frontend, backend services, APIs, and data layers
  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into well-architected, maintainable software components using established design patterns
  • Build and maintain microservices and RESTful / GraphQL APIs using modern stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Python, or Node.js
  • Develop responsive, accessible user interfaces using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue)
  • Model data and work with both SQL and NoSQL databases; design efficient queries, schemas, and integration patterns
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and trade-off analyses for performance, scalability, security, and cost

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

  • Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI Assistant, or equivalent) as a daily part of the development workflow
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, code review, unit test generation, test data creation, and documentation
  • Apply prompt engineering and context-design techniques to get high-quality, trustworthy outputs from AI coding assistants
  • Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, licensing, and alignment with project and NCS coding standards before committing
  • Measure and communicate the productivity and quality impact of AI-assisted workflows on project delivery

AI Solution Integration & Delivery

  • Integrate AI and Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications - including LLM-powered features, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), chatbots and virtual assistants, intelligent document processing, recommendations, and agentic workflows
  • Build against foundation model APIs and managed AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI
  • Work with vector databases and AI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel; pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) to deliver context-aware experiences
  • Design AI features with clear evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
  • Partner with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and solution architects to take AI capabilities from prototype to production
  • Contribute to pre-sales and client engagements by prototyping AI-enabled features and shaping practical, value-driven solution designs

Quality Engineering & Secure Coding

  • Follow secure coding principles and NCS security guidelines to prevent common vulnerabilities across frontend, backend, and AI integrations
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; meet project and organisation test coverage targets
  • Perform static code analysis, code reviews, and threat-aware reviews of AI-generated code and AI-integrated features
  • Address defects, performance issues, and production incidents through disciplined root-cause analysis

DevOps & Continuous Delivery

  • Adopt Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices to deliver software iteratively and reliably
  • Build and maintain pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) for automated build, test, and deployment
  • Containerise applications and deploy to container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Instrument applications for observability - logs, metrics, traces, and, where applicable, AI-feature evaluation telemetry

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Partner with business analysts, designers, data scientists, and product owners to translate user needs into working software
  • Participate in and lead peer reviews, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Mentor junior developers on full stack engineering fundamentals and effective, responsible use of AI tools
  • Document designs, APIs, and AI-integration patterns in a clear and reusable way

Responsible AI & Engineering Excellence

  • Champion responsible use of AI tools, including IP protection, client data handling, confidentiality, and licence-compliance considerations
  • Help define and uphold team guardrails and standards for AI-assisted development and AI-integrated products
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling, model, and framework landscape, and bring relevant advances back to the team
  • Contribute to NCS assets, reusable components, and reference implementations that accelerate future AI-enabled delivery

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant coding certifications are also welcome
  • 2 to 6 years of professional experience building and delivering production web applications as a full stack developer
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in at least one backend stack: Node.js (Express, NestJS), Golang, Python.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in at least one modern frontend framework: React (Next.js a plus), Angular, or Vue.js, with solid fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS/CSS3
  • Solid understanding of API design (REST, JSON; GraphQL a plus), microservices, event-driven patterns, and integration with third-party systems
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Experience with Git-based source control, Agile delivery, test-driven development, and CI/CD toolchains
  • Working experience with containers and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes; AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Demonstrated day-to-day use of AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI Assistant, Tabnine, Windsurf, or equivalent) and ability to articulate how these tools have improved your delivery quality and speed
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and how to structure effective context and instructions for AI coding assistants
  • Familiarity with Large Language Models and Generative AI concepts - tokens, context windows, embeddings, vector search, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Exposure to at least one LLM / GenAI platform or SDK (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI / Gemini, Hugging Face)
  • Involvement in at least one project that delivered an AI solution capability - such as a GenAI / LLM-powered application, RAG system, chatbot or virtual assistant, intelligent document processing, ML-powered feature, or AI agent - is a strong plus
  • Exposure to AI application frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, FAISS), agentic patterns, tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI evaluation or guardrail practices is a plus
  • Awareness of responsible AI principles, data privacy, IP considerations, and security implications of using AI tools on client engagements

title: Security Architect
description:
Senior Security Architect

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Security Architect to help design and embed security into technology solutions across a complex enterprise environment.

Working closely with architects, engineers, delivery teams, and business stakeholders, you will provide security expertise throughout the solution lifecycle, ensuring security requirements are effectively incorporated into new and existing platforms. This role is ideal for a hands-on security professional who enjoys solving technical challenges and influencing secure design outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide security architecture guidance for business and technology initiatives.
  • Review solution designs and recommend appropriate security controls.
  • Conduct threat modelling, security assessments, and risk reviews.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, product teams, and delivery stakeholders to build secure solutions.
  • Contribute to the development of security standards, patterns, and best practices.
  • Support the evaluation of emerging technologies and security capabilities.
  • Assist in identifying and communicating security risks and remediation options.

You are a collaborative security professional with experience designing secure enterprise solutions and balancing business needs with effective risk management.

  • Understanding of threat modelling, risk assessment, and security design principles.
  • Experience working with cloud, infrastructure, applications, or network security technologies.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.
  • Exposure to Agile and DevOps delivery environments.
  • Experience developing secure cloud-native or API-based solutions.
  • Knowledge of emerging technologies, including AI security considerations.

What You'll Bring

  • A pragmatic approach to cyber security and risk management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A collaborative mindset and a passion for helping teams deliver secure solutions.
  • Curiosity about emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful technology initiatives, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to improving security outcomes across a large and evolving environment, while continuing to develop your architecture and cyber security expertise.

title: Data Center Technician - Germany - Essen - On-site
description:
Reboot Monkey is a global leader in IT solutions, specializing in data center management that simplifies your IT operations. We provide hosting space, future-proof upgrades, and 24/7 support through our smart or remote hands, ensuring seamless, secure, and sustainable service. Our fully remote, round-the-clock management frees businesses from supervision hassles, setting new benchmarks in data center solutions. We’re seeking skilled Freelance Data Center Technicians to join our growing team. If you have expertise in data center operations and want flexible work, we’d love to hear from you.


Job Overview:

As a Freelance Data Center Technician, you will play a key role in delivering on-demand support to our global data centers. Your responsibilities will include hardware installation, troubleshooting complex issues, and managing network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in data center equipment and software who can work independently while collaborating with remote teams. In this role, you’ll be essential to maintaining smooth, secure, and efficient data center operations, contributing to our high standards of service excellence.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, and maintain servers, networking equipment, and other hardware to ensure optimal performance and maximum uptime, facilitating seamless operations within the data center.

  • Monitor data center operations both remotely and on-site, quickly diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues to minimize downtime and maintain service reliability.

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot networking devices, including Cisco and Juniper routers, switches, and firewalls, to ensure secure and efficient network operations that align with organizational standards.

  • Manage and troubleshoot both Linux and Windows-based systems, performing essential updates, patches, and security enhancements to keep systems secure and up-to-date.

  • Document all installations, repairs, maintenance tasks, and system performance, providing comprehensive reports to the remote management team to ensure transparency and accountability in operations.

  • Implement and maintain security protocols to protect the integrity of the data center infrastructure, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for data security.

  • Collaborate with remote IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to enhance data center operations, actively participating in the planning and execution of projects that drive efficiency and innovation.


What We Offer:

  • Flexibility: Work around your existing freelance or permanent job. You choose the tickets you want to pick up, with no minimum hour commitment.

  • Professional Environment: Join a professional work environment where you can reconnect with the practical side of IT.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive rewards for your compensation and efforts.

  • Growth Opportunities: Work with compelling clients and seize opportunities to grow in your field.

  • Education:

    • Associate or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred but not required.

  • Experience:

    • 3+ years of experience in data center operations, with a strong focus on independent or freelance projects.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Extensive hands-on experience with Cisco and Juniper networking devices.

    • Strong proficiency in managing and troubleshooting Windows and Linux-based systems.

    • Solid understanding of networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, VLANs).

    • Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V is a plus.

  • Certifications:

    • Valid certifications like Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, or CompTIA Linux+ are highly desirable.

  • General Requirements:

    • Ability to travel to various data center locations on short notice.

    • Flexibility to work outside regular hours, including nights and weekends if required.

    • Must have access to necessary tools and equipment to perform data center tasks.

    • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and remotely.

    • Excellent communication skills for collaboration with remote teams.

title: Associate Data Scientist

We are seeking a talented Associate Data Scientist to join the Marketing Technology team within GSSO. In this role, you will build AI-powered solutions that accelerate Sales and Marketing productivity. You will partner with Product Owners, engineers, and data scientists to transform prospecting for Gartner's 7,000+ sales associates. Beyond model development, you will help shape Gartner's next generation of AI solutions through experimentation, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and intelligent recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Design, test, and optimize prompts, retrieval strategies, and agent workflows to improve AI performance and scalability.

  • Build recommendation solutions, such as prospect interest prediction and personalized outreach recommendations, to enhance prospecting effectiveness.

  • Rapidly prototype AI capabilities, evaluate business impact, and help transition successful pilots into production.

  • Partner with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and engineers to translate business needs into scalable solutions.

  • Stay current on advancements in machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic systems, bringing new ideas and best practices to the team.

  • 1+ years of experience applying data science and machine learning techniques through professional work, internships, or research.

  • Experience with Python, SQL, statistical analysis, and databases.

  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, with a strong interest in Generative AI and machine learning.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Is there a Zenika in you?

Let’s talk skills and passion first.

We are looking for passionate technophiles who believe in craftsmanship, open-source tech, and modern solutions. We aren't just looking for an engineer to "maintain" infrastructure; we are looking for a DevOps Consultant who thrives on helping our global client base navigate complex cloud ecosystems, build scalable systems, and promote a culture of DevOps excellence.

Your Role as a Zenika Consultant:

In this role, you will bring your deep expertise to client projects, acting as a technical advisor and architect. You won't just be a "gatekeeper"; you will be a partner, empowering client teams to own their infrastructure while you elevate their development practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and implement robust, production-grade infrastructure on AWS EKS, utilizing Kubernetes for container orchestration to ensure high availability.

  • Modernize Delivery: Help clients transform their workflows by developing and maintaining advanced CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and ArgoCD.

  • Champion Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Standardize environments and reduce drift by implementing automation with Terraform and Terragrunt.

  • Secure & Optimize: Implement service mesh technologies like LinkerD to secure service-to-service communication and proactively manage cloud costs and performance.

  • Enable Observability: Set up and maintain monitoring and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) to ensure system reliability.

  • Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with client development and QA teams to facilitate seamless integration. You will be an advocate for continuous learning, contributing to a culture of technical excellence.

What You Bring

  • Proven AWS Expertise: Strong experience with AWS services, particularly EKS, RDS, and networking components.

  • We value deep hands-on expertise combined with a consultant's mindset.

  • Containerization Mastery: Deep understanding of Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Go for custom automation tasks.

  • CI/CD & IaC Proficiency: Hands-on experience with GitLab/ArgoCD pipelines and Terraform/Terragrunt.

  • Soft Skills: You are a problem-solver who communicates clearly, acts as a team player, and remains detail-oriented even in fast-paced, agile environments.

  • Nice-to-Have: Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or CKA. Familiarity with E2E tools like Cypress or Playwright and microservices architecture is highly valued.

About Zenika

Founded by developer Carl Azoury, Zenika is a consultancy built around community, transparency, and craftsmanship. We are passionate technophiles advising clients with deep expertise in open-source tech and modern solutions.

Why Join Zenika?

  • Work with a global client base across 11 locations, benefiting from over 28,000 Zenika-led training sessions

  • Partner with tech giants like Google Cloud and Scrum.org, and engage in research, open-source contributions, and conferences outside client projects

  • Participate in Zenika tech conferences (TechnoZaures) to learn, share, and grow together

  • Hybrid work arrangement

  • 20 days of annual leave + up to 5 LEAP(Learning, Education, Advancement, Progress) days

  • Dedicated Learning & Development (L&D) budget to support your growth

  • Comprehensive international medical insurance package

Position Title:

Child Protective Services Worker (Social Service Specialist 1)

Job Description:

The Oregon Department of Human Services is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are guided by our Equity North Star and our vision for a positive RiSE organizational culture that advances equity and diversity. We encourage applications from members of historically underrepresented racial/ethnic groups, women, individuals with disabilities, veterans, LGBTQIA2S+ community members, and others to help us achieve our vision of a diverse and inclusive community.

Opportunity awaits!

Every day, Child Protective Services Workers step into moments that matter most. In this role you will ensure the safety and well-being of Oregon's children, navigating difficult situations with dignity, respect, and support. If you’re seeking meaningful work that blends critical thinking, collaboration, and human connection, this work may be exactly what you’re looking for.

Summary of Duties

As a Child Protective Services Worker, you will:

  • Gather information through interviews and home observations to evaluate safety and risk in child abuse or neglect cases, taking protective action when necessary.

  • Create safety and service plans that reflect each family's needs and connect them with medical, mental health, parenting, and community resources.

  • Prepare accurate case documentation, including reports, assessments, safety plans, and notes.

  • Engage in child‑safety meetings and collaborate effectively with families, professionals, and community partners.

  • Testify in court hearings and initiate court action when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

A valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record are required for this position.

  • A bachelor’s degree in human services or a field related to human service. Or

  • A bachelor’s degree unrelated to Human Services and either:

    • One year of Human Services related experience. Or

    • Completion of coursework equivalent to certification consistent with Oregon Caseworker Competency, or

  • An associate degree and either:

    • Two years of Human Services related experience. Or

    • One year of Human Services related experience and related training, coursework, or certification consistent with Oregon Caseworker Competency.

Pursuant to ORS 419B.021, states that any position engaged in child protective investigations and/or custody determinations must meet the educational requirements. Experience alone will not meet the minimum qualifications for those positions. *Degree must be completed, not in progress.

Essential Attributes

We are looking for candidates with:

  • Experience working independently and in a team to complete tasks and projects.

  • Experience organizing work, managing time, and prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines.

  • Experience writing clear, complete, and concise documents with minimal errors.

  • Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel to create, edit, and maintain documents or spreadsheets.

  • Experience working with people from varied backgrounds using culturally responsive practices.

  • Experience using sound judgment when making observations and asking focused questions to identify and determine child safety concerns and threats.

Working Conditions

  • Work will take place in offices, participants’ homes, and various community locations.

  • Frequent travel is required for transporting children or families and completing case‑related activities.

  • The work schedule is Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm PT, with possible fluctuations based on service needs.

  • There may be occasional requirements for compensated overtime, including evening and weekend hours.

  • The employee will participate in a rotating on‑call schedule that includes evening and weekend work.

  • You may interact with individuals experiencing trauma or emotional distress, and there may be times when individuals have difficulty managing their emotional responses.

  • You may encounter situations requiring quick decision‑making to ensure your safety or the safety of others.

  • Activities may include traversing stairs, move across uneven terrain, and assisting children (up to 50 pounds) in and out of car seats.

title: Network Engineer - Network Provisioning
description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2014, and listed on the ASX since 2015, Superloop’s purpose is to enable better internet for Australian homes and businesses. We enable challenger retail brands (including Superloop and Exetel brands) to take a larger share of the market, leveraging Superloop’s Infrastructure-on-Demand platform. Superloop provides connectivity and services to customers in three segments of the market: Consumer, Business and Wholesale. Our offerings leverage Superloop’s investments in physical infrastructure assets that include fibre, subsea cables and fixed wireless, as well as Superloop’s software platforms. Hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses rely on Superloop and Exetel every day for their connectivity needs.

Visit to learn more.


Business Unit Overview

Our Operations unit is the engine room of Superloop - responsible for maintaining and supporting all of our products and internal technical infrastructure to ensure the best possible service to both our customers and our very own business. Our Operations unit is responsible for ensuring that the business has the technical capability and capacity to deliver services to all Superloop customers ranging from Home Broadband to International Wholesale. Our Service Delivery area is a group of teams responsible for the coordination and delivery of all Business and Wholesale connectivity for Superloop customers. This team supports multiple business units, managing all services through both connection and disconnection, liaising with both internal teams and third parties to ensure services are delivered on time, providing large scale project management and provisioning Superloop products.

Role Purpose

The Network Engineer in the Network Provisioning team is responsible for leading the design, configuration, and implementation of complex network solutions to support customer and internal service requirements. This role ensures timely and accurate provisioning of network services while maintaining high performance, reliability, and compliance with company and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, the end-to-end provisioning of network services including MPLS, IP VPN, Internet, SD-WAN, and Cloud connectivity.

  • Perform network design, configuration, testing, and deployment in line with customer requirements and SLA commitments.

  • Review and validate customer requirements, translating them into high-quality technical solutions.

  • Conduct network audits and pre-deployment checks to ensure readiness and compliance.

  • Collaborate with Service Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and Solution Architects to support timely delivery.

  • Maintain and update network documentation, design templates, and provisioning standards.

  • Work closely with operations/support teams to ensure smooth handover of services post-provisioning.

  • Contribute to process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency.

  • Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and vendor certifications to support continuous improvement.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Networking, Telecommunications, or related field.

  • 04+ years of experience in network engineering, with at least 2 years in service provisioning for

  • ISP/Telecom/Enterprise environments.

  • Professional certifications preferred: CCNP, JNCIP, NSE4+, PCNSE, or equivalent.

  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale network deployment.

  • Strong expertise in routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, ISIS, EIGRP).

  • Hands-on experience with service provider networks and multi-vendor environments (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, etc.).

  • Solid understanding of SD-WAN, VPN, QoS, and network security principles.

  • Experience with network provisioning tools, and automation scripts (Python/Ansible preferred).

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-team collaboration and customer interactions.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.

  • The attitude to win collaboratively.

Key Deliverables

  • Ensure services meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), KPIs, and operational targets.

  • Maintain accurate data updates within Superloop systems.

  • Deploy network configuration.

  • Testing and quality assurance.

  • Documentation and handoff.

On Offer

  • Flexibility – 3 days/week in the office

  • Diverse and inclusive culture

title: Director of Cloud SRE
description:
We are looking for a Director of Cloud SRE to lead a team of engineering leaders and engineers responsible for federating core SRE principles across a global, hybrid technology organization. This role drives the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for our internal observability and reliability tooling — spanning telemetry standards, developer pipeline integration, and application team SRE maturity — and works in close partnership with peer SRE leaders to extend that strategy consistently across cloud-native and on-premise environments alike.

This is a builder's role as much as a leader's role. You will guide a team that develops internally-owned tooling built intentionally to remain vendor-agnostic so the organization is never architecturally locked to a single observability provider and drives Agentic AI deeper into our SRE ecosystem. While our primary application runtime is GCP, this leader must be equally comfortable partnering across the SRE organization to extend reliability and observability standards into data center, manufacturing, distribution, and global campus environments — meeting engineering and operations teams where they are, not just where the platform lives.

The ideal candidate blends technical depth with organizational fluency: someone who can sit in an architecture review and a roadmap planning session with equal credibility, who has personally built and operated production systems, and who can partner effectively across a broader SRE leadership team to advance a long-term, unified observability strategy.

  • Partner with fellow SRE leaders to define and drive a multi-year, holistic strategy for unified observability and SRE platform offerings, spanning cloud-native (GCP) and on-premise (data center, manufacturing, distribution, campus) environments.

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of engineering managers/leads and individual contributor engineers, building organizational depth in SRE practice and platform engineering.

  • Drive the roadmap for internally-built observability tooling, ensuring architecture remains vendor-agnostic and portable across telemetry backends (OpenTelemetry-first design, current integration with Dynatrace) with a focus on Agentic AI platforms to simplify correlation data.

  • Help federate core SRE principles — SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident management, toil reduction, capacity and reliability engineering — across application and platform teams enterprise-wide, working alongside peer SRE leaders rather than centralizing reliability as a bottleneck.

  • Partner with developer experience and platform engineering teams to embed observability and reliability tooling directly into CI/CD pipelines and source repositories, shifting reliability left in the development lifecycle.

  • Contribute to an SRE maturity model, providing application teams a clear, staged path to deepen their own reliability practice with SRE org support and self-service tooling.

  • Build cross-domain relationships with manufacturing, plant, and OT engineering leadership, in partnership with other SRE leaders, to extend reliability and observability discipline into environments with materially different constraints (legacy protocols, air-gapped or constrained networks, safety-critical operations).

  • Represent SRE platform direction to senior technology leadership, including architecture governance bodies, and act as an escalation point for major reliability and observability initiatives within your team's scope.

  • Contribute to vendor relationship and technology decisions related to observability tooling, balancing build-vs-buy tradeoffs against long-term platform and cost strategy.

  • Ensure the team maintains hands-on technical currency — reviewing designs, contributing to architecture decisions, and staying credible as a technical leader.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering

  • 4+ years in a people leadership role managing engineering leaders and/or engineers.

  • Demonstrated experience building and operating observability platforms at scale, with hands-on depth in OpenTelemetry and at least one enterprise observability platform (Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, or similar).

  • Proven track record designing and delivering internally-built developer tooling, including integration with CI/CD pipelines, source control platforms, and developer workflows.

  • Strong working knowledge of public cloud architecture (GCP strongly preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable) and demonstrated ability to extend reliability practices into hybrid or on-premise environments.

  • Deep understanding of core SRE principles: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident management and postmortem practice, toil reduction, capacity planning, and reliability-by-design.

  • Experience operating in environments with heterogeneous infrastructure — cloud, data center, and OT/manufacturing or industrial environments a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to build a long-term technical strategy and translate it into an executable roadmap, balancing tactical remediation against multi-year platform investment.

  • Strong executive communication skills — able to represent technical strategy to senior leadership and align cross-functional stakeholders around a unified direction.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent) and modern software delivery practices (agile/PI planning experience a plus).

Preferred:

  • Experience building or scaling an SRE function within a large, matrixed enterprise.

  • Familiarity with emerging AI/agentic observability standards (OTel GenAI semantic conventions) and their application to platform tooling.

  • Experience establishing SRE maturity models or capability frameworks used to guide staged team adoption.

This role requires up to 10% travel.

title: Brent Spence Bridge Corridor - Senior Program Manager
description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can build a career that is meaningful to you while helping deliver one of the nation's most significant transportation infrastructure programs.

The Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project is a transformational $4+ billion bi-state infrastructure investment led by the Ohio Department of Transportation (ODOT) and Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC). The program includes the construction of a new companion bridge over the Ohio River, rehabilitation of the existing Brent Spence Bridge, reconstruction of approximately 7.8 miles of interstate corridor, major interchange improvements, environmental stewardship initiatives, and extensive stakeholder and community engagement efforts.

HNTB serves as the Consultant Contract Oversight Manager (CCOM) supporting ODOT and KYTC throughout delivery of the Progressive Design-Build program, providing oversight of contract administration, environmental compliance, project controls, financial planning, grant administration, stakeholder engagement, public involvement, and risk management.

This opportunity entails serving as the Senior Program Manager responsible for leading HNTB's Program Management Consultant team and delivering industry-leading program management services throughout design and construction. The successful candidate will serve as an advisor to ODOT, KYTC, FHWA, and executive stakeholders while overseeing a multidisciplinary team supporting one of the largest transportation projects in the United States.

What You’ll Do:

  • Acts as the client’s agent in delivering complex PMC services for key clients in the areas of strategic planning, alternative delivery, innovative financing, procurement/contract management, risk management, project controls, quality management, construction management, project closeout and acceptance, and operations/maintenance.
  • Routinely resolves difficult issues of significant financial impact, assessing and managing risk on behalf of the client.
  • Identifies opportunities to advance HNTB’s presence and revenue opportunity in the PMC space, leveraging nationally acknowledged reputation to pursue and land those opportunities.
  • Nationally well-known expert in their respective industry with well-established strong client connections. Represents HNTB with state and national industry organizations.
  • Interacts with executive level government or public officials and/or executive level clients on advanced program matters often requiring coordination between organizations.
  • Responsible for defining staffing needs for the delivery of services, providing direction and oversight to Project Managers, other staff, client staff and subcontractors.
  • Has an awareness and understanding of the political environment and sensitivities in which a program is being delivered.
  • Able to lead HNTB team in understanding client perspectives and vision of success while keeping staff connected to firm culture and organization.
  • Develops a deep understanding of full range of HNTB services and firm-wide resources.
  • Leads the development of client service action plans and client project reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management or related discipline
  • 15 years relevant experience

Program Details

Program Leadership

  • Lead and oversee all Contract Oversight services for the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Program.
  • Serve as HNTB's primary executive representative to ODOT, KYTC, FHWA, and major project stakeholders.
  • Direct multidisciplinary teams responsible for project management, environmental compliance, communications, financial management, project controls, small business enterprise compliance, and contract administration.
  • Establish strategic priorities and ensure alignment with program goals, schedule commitments, and performance objectives.

Project Delivery and Oversight

  • Oversee Progressive Design-Build delivery and support owner oversight activities throughout design and construction.
  • Develop multiple change orders and meet expected dates of completion and engage with stakeholders on a regular basis regarding potential contract changes and risk items
  • Providing timely analysis of changes and claims and recommending appropriate negotiating strategies
  • Develop change and claim avoidance and prevention strategies
  • Provide high level change summary and assist client in negotiations with the Contractor
  • Lead program-level risk management, issue resolution, and decision-making processes.
  • Monitor design development, construction progress, schedule performance, and budget management.
  • Provide executive guidance on contract administration, change management, and governance processes.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and grant funding requirements.

Financial and Commercial Management

  • Manage financial performance of the CCOM contract, including staffing, budgets, forecasting, and profitability.
  • Oversee grant administration, reporting requirements, and funding compliance activities.
  • Evaluate program risks related to cost, schedule, scope, and commercial matters.
  • Support executive-level reporting and performance monitoring.

Stakeholder and Public Engagement

  • Maintain strong relationships with agency leadership, elected officials, community organizations, industry groups, and project stakeholders.
  • Support strategic communications, public involvement activities, media coordination, and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
  • Facilitate executive meetings, advisory committees, and governance boards.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of program managers, project control specialists, and support staff.
  • Coordinate resources across multiple disciplines and offices.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and client service excellence.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience serving in a Program Manager, Senior Project Manager, Program Management Consultant, or equivalent leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success managing large multidisciplinary teams and complex stakeholder environments.
  • Must be used to fast-paced dynamic environments with many stakeholders. Must be prompt and responsive.
  • Be proficient in the contract change process and enable knowledge sharing with wider project management team.

title: Guest Experience Event Day Associate - Express Entry
description:
About Mercedes-Benz Stadium
Mercedes-Benz Stadium is a world-class sports and entertainment venue located in downtown Atlanta and home to the NFL’s Atlanta Falcons and MLS’s Atlanta United. Since opening in 2017, the stadium has hosted some of the most significant events in sports and entertainment, including Super Bowl LIII, the College Football Playoff National Championship, MLS Cup, major concerts, and global sporting events.


Recognized as one of the most innovative venues in the world, Mercedes-Benz Stadium is the first professional sports stadium in North America to achieve LEED Platinum certification and the first stadium globally to achieve TRUE Platinum certification for zero waste.

Every event at Mercedes-Benz Stadium is powered by people. Our associates play a critical role in delivering the welcoming, energetic environment that fans expect when they walk through our doors.

Our Ideal Candidate
Guest Experience Associates are the lifeblood of the Mercedes-Benz Stadium experience. They set the tone for the building and play a defining role in how every guest remembers their visit. The individuals who thrive in this role share several defining qualities:


They Care Deeply About People
Hospitality is not a task — it is a mindset. Our associates genuinely enjoy helping others and take pride in making every guest feel welcomed, respected, and valued.
They Choose Positivity
Live events are fast-paced and dynamic. The best associates bring steady energy, maintain a positive outlook, and help create an environment where guests feel excited to be here.
They Find Solutions
Challenges are part of live events. Exceptional associates focus on what can be done. They take ownership, think creatively, and work to find solutions that help guests have a great experience.
They Stay Aware and Engaged
Great associates notice when someone needs help before being asked. They stay attentive to their surroundings and proactively step in to support guests.
They Work as One Team
Delivering a world-class experience requires teamwork. Our associates support one another and collaborate across departments to ensure every guest interaction reflects the best of Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
They Take Pride in Representing the Brand
Every interaction reflects the Mercedes-Benz Stadium experience. Our associates represent the stadium with professionalism, energy, and care.

About the Guest Experience Team
The Guest Experience Team serves as the frontline of the Mercedes-Benz Stadium experience. These associates are the welcoming faces, problem solvers, and energy setters who help transform events into memorable moments for our guests. From the moment guests arrive until the final whistle or encore, this team plays a critical role in delivering our “Welcome Home” philosophy and ensuring every fan feels valued and supported.

Position Summary

The Guest Experience Event Day Associate – Express Entry helps create a fast, welcoming, and seamless arrival experience for guests entering Mercedes-Benz Stadium.

This role supports the stadium’s Delta Fly-Through Lanes, helping guests take advantage of one of the most innovative entry experiences in sports. Associates greet guests, assist with enrollment when needed, answer questions about the process, and help ensure fans move quickly and confidently into the stadium.

This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy interacting with people, using technology with ease, staying energized in busy environments, and helping guests start their event experience on a positive note. Additionally, someone in this role is consistent, reliable, and completely comfortable working outside.

This is not a sitting position. You will be allotted breaks during your shifts and able to sit during breaks. However, during your shift the expectation is to be moving around and assisting guests while standing or walking.

Key Responsibilities

Express Entry Guest Support

  • Welcome guests arriving at Express Entry locations throughout the stadium

  • Assist guests utilizing Delta Fly-Through Lanes for stadium entry

  • Help guide guests through the enrollment process when needed

  • Answer questions related to Express Entry and stadium access

  • Assist guests outside on a regular basis, at the gates, in all types of weather conditions

Technology Support

  • Assist guests with enrollment through QR code registration

  • Help troubleshoot common entry or enrollment questions on an iPad or phone

  • Maintain working knowledge of Express Entry technology and procedures

Guest Hospitality

  • Provide directions and support for guests entering the stadium

  • Maintain a welcoming and approachable presence during high-traffic arrival periods

  • Assist guests with general questions related to the stadium experience

Event Day Execution

  • Work in outdoor entry environments during events

  • Maintain awareness of guest flow and entry operations

  • Support other Guest Experience initiatives and responsibilities as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age

  • Must be able and willing to work in indoor and outdoor environments

  • Ability to stand, walk or walk up and down stairs for extended periods of time during an event.

  • Availability to work nights, weekends, and major stadium events

  • Must be available to work a minimum of 75% all major events consistently throughout the year held at Mercedes-Benz Stadium including Atlanta Falcons, Atlanta United, college football, concerts, etc.

  • Must enjoy helping others and working within a team environment.

  • Proactive in seeking out positive interactions with both guests and coworkers and interested in maintaining those positive relationships.

  • Must enjoy speaking and interacting with others in a warm, friendly, and respectful manner.

  • Must be available to attend all necessary in-person and virtual training as a prerequisite for employment and/or working events.

Required Skills:

  • Displays strong communication, listening, and thoughtfulness.

  • Provide excellent customer service.

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new settings and situations.

  • Comfortable assisting guests with smartphone technology

  • Possesses strong time management and team collaboration skills.

Why Join Mercedes-Benz Stadium?
Guest Experience Associates play a vital role in shaping how fans remember their time at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. This role offers the opportunity to be part of the energy of live sports and entertainment while helping create memorable experiences for thousands of guests at every event.

title: Scientist I
description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.

We are seeking a highly motivated Preformulation Pharmaceutical Scientist to join our Preclinical Research Sciences team. In this role, you will work closely with biologists, chemists, and pharmacokinetic scientists at the forefront of drug discovery.

You will be responsible for the preformulation assessment of small molecules and for the design and evaluation of formulations that enable non-clinical pharmacokinetic, pharmacology, and toxicology studies. You will also contribute directly to the design and selection of candidate drugs with the potential to become life-changing medicines, collaborating with other small-molecule formulation groups across the organization.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the preformulation representative on drug discovery and early development project teams, communicating strategy, risks, and data to cross-functional partners.

  • Design and evaluate formulations for non-clinical PK, PK/PD, pharmacology, and toxicology studies, selecting vehicles and excipients that deliver the required exposure and stability.

  • Lead preformulation assessment of new chemical entities (NCEs), including solubility, solid-state stability, particle size and morphology, bio-relevant dissolution, and polymorphism.

  • Conduct salt, co-crystal, and solid-form screening to support solid-form selection and de-risk downstream development.

  • Apply solubility-enabling technologies, such as amorphous solid dispersions, lipid-based systems, nanosuspensions, and complexation, to poorly water-soluble compounds.

  • Develop and qualify HPLC/UPLC methods supporting formulation characterization, stability assessment, and dose formulation analysis, including concentration and homogeneity verification for GLP toxicology studies.

  • Plan and lead laboratory work in accordance with project timelines, and oversee formulation or analytical work placed with contract research organizations.

  • Contribute preformulation and formulation data to candidate selection decisions and to documentation supporting first-in-human studies.

  • Author technical reports and correspondence to a standard suitable for internal review, CMC handoff, and regulatory filings.

  • Monitor the scientific literature and proactively apply established and emerging approaches to project challenges.

  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with CMC Formulation Development to enable robust and reliable advancement of compounds from preclinical to clinical phases of development

Education and Experience

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related discipline.

  • M.S. with 7 or more years, or Ph.D. with 4 or more years, of relevant industry experience in preformulation and preclinical formulation development.

  • Hands-on experience formulating poorly water-soluble compounds in a discovery research setting to maximize exposure in animal studies.

  • Hands-on experience with HPLC/UPLC analysis and method development.

  • Hands-on experience with dose verification and with solubility assays in simulated gastric fluid (SGF) and biorelevant media (FaSSIF and FeSSIF), performed in accordance with USP methods.

Required Skills

  • Strong technical knowledge of physicochemical and solid-state properties and their relationship to drug product design and performance.

  • Practical experience selecting and developing solubility-enabling formulations.

  • Practical experience with analytical method development across chromatographic techniques, with working familiarity with mass spectrometry.

  • Ability to manage several projects concurrently, using initiative and creativity to meet agreed objectives and timelines.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present technical results to research and CMC audiences.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of biopharmaceutics and pharmacokinetic principles.

  • Experience supporting GLP toxicology studies, including dose formulation analysis.

  • Experience overseeing formulation or analytical work at contract research organizations.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and excellent practical laboratory skills.

  • Strong collaboration and networking skills, with the ability to engage colleagues in new initiatives.

  • Ability to deliver reliably under competing priorities and timelines.

Base salary is just one component of our competitive total compensation package, which includes equity in the form of stock options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off.
