title: Business Intelligence Engineer - 100% Remote
description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Business Intelligence Engineer to join the BI Engineering team supporting Robotic programs. In this role, you will serve as the BI owner for portfolio of robotic solutions — designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and other analytics artifacts that enable data-driven decisions across the program lifecycle. You will also establish the standards and operating procedures that ensure our BI solutions remain scalable, reliable, and maintainable as RST's technology portfolio grows. Beyond dashboards, you bring a strong foundation in statistics — including hypothesis testing, design of experiments, and exploratory data analysis — to support engineering and program teams in evaluating robotic system performance. You are a collaborative problem-solver who thinks holistically about how systems work together and uses data to identify improvements to architecture, design, and operational readiness.

Key job responsibilities

• BI Ownership for RST: Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that serve all robotic solutions through their Alpha, Beta, and General Availability phases.

• Governance & Maintainability: Develop and document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for dashboard lifecycle management — including version control practices, data validation standards, refresh monitoring, stakeholder access management, and deprecation workflows — to ensure long-term health and scalability of the team's BI portfolio.

• Data Source Development: Identify and onboard new data sources, define metrics, and build data pipelines that feed BI solutions and enable cross-program comparisons.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Program Managers, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and automated reporting.

• Statistical Analysis: Execute foundational statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, design of experiments (DOE), and regression analysis to support engineering evaluations and program decisions.

A day in the life

You will own major components of the team's analytics infrastructure, including contributing to data architecture decisions and delivering reports that drive the development and deployment of new robotic storage systems. On any given day, you might be building a new operational dashboard for a robotic solution entering Beta, writing an SOP that defines how the team documents data lineage and refresh schedules, or running a designed experiment to evaluate a system configuration change. You will maintain a deep understanding of data lineage across your BI solutions — from the technical systems generating the data, through metric aggregation processes, to how insights are consumed and acted upon by stakeholders. You will create and optimize scripts (Python, R, Shell) to streamline BI processes and select appropriate analytics and visualization tools to meet diverse business needs. Your work will directly influence technology development decisions across RST's portfolio and shape the future of robotic storage technology landscape.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of BI Engineering Experience

-3+ years of python scripting

- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

- Experience writing complex SQL queries

- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab

- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift

- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

This is a Contract position based out of Atlanta, GA.

title: Senior Lead Generation Specialist – Construction  Project Intelligence
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Senior Lead Generation Specialist – Construction Project Intelligence supports the client by transforming Dodge Construction Network data into a curated pipeline of actionable construction opportunities. The role reviews project records, identifies warehouses and other facilities that fit client's evaporative-cooling technology, assesses whether the company can influence or protect a project specification, and identifies the architects, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders relevant to each opportunity.

This is not a conventional scripted list-building or outbound sales role. The work requires investigative research, sound judgment, data analysis, and the ability to recognize stale or contradictory project information. Limited outreach may be performed to verify project status or obtain preliminary facts; sales conversations and specification influence remain with the client's internal team or manufacturer representatives.

Because the process is new, the role will also help refine qualification rules, document the operating process, and support future migration to the client's planned CRM.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

A. Construction Project Research & Qualification

  • Review Dodge Construction Network searches and exported datasets for target construction projects.
  • Apply agreed geography, building-type, project-value, timing, and project-stage criteria to screen opportunities.
  • Distinguish early-stage specification opportunities from later-stage protect-spec or break spec opportunities.
  • Review project details, dates, documents, and team information rather than relying only on summary labels.
  • Identify and exclude pre-design, completed, stale, low-value, or otherwise non-viable projects using documented rules.

B. Contact & Stakeholder Intelligence

  • Review project details, dates, documents, and team information rather than relying only on summary labels.
  • Identify and exclude pre-design, completed, stale, low-value, or otherwise non-viable projects using documented rules.
  • Identify relevant organizations and named contacts based on project stage.
  • For earlier-stage projects, prioritize architects and mechanical engineers.
  • For later-stage projects, prioritize mechanical engineers, general contractors, and mechanical/HVAC contractors.
  • Drill into company and contact records to enrich generic, incomplete, or missing contact information.
  • Prepare clear handoff information for Phoenix stakeholders and, where directed, manufacturer representatives.

C. Project Status Validation

  • Investigate contradictions between project stage, published date, start date, completion date, and available documentation.
  • Conduct professional, limited email or phone outreach when required to confirm whether a project is active, delayed, started, or completed.
  • Record the source, date, result, and next action for each validation attempt. Records should be kept in any spreadsheets used to track progress as well as the comments section of the Dodge record.
  • Maintain a strict boundary between fact-finding/status validation and sales or specification influence activity.
  • Escalate ambiguous or sensitive interactions rather than representing unapproved commercial positions.

D. Data Management & Reporting

  • Export, filter, sort, reconcile, and maintain large Dodge datasets in Microsoft Excel or other approved data storage and analysis system.
  • Maintain an operational project tracker with qualification, contact, evidence, disposition, ownership, and next-action fields.
  • Produce recurring activity, funnel, exception, and handoff summaries for client and company stakeholders.
  • Monitor newly published projects and material changes to tracked projects during the maintenance phase.
  • Maintain data quality, version control, and traceability across Dodge, shared files, and future systems.
  • Document findings that contradict published data in the comments section of the Dodge records.

E. Process Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in an iterative pilot, beginning with a controlled project segment and expanding as criteria stabilize.
  • Test qualification assumptions against actual project data and professionally challenge ineffective parameters.
  • Document SOPs, decision rules, examples, exception handling, handoff criteria, and outreach boundaries.
  • Recommend improvements to the Excel tracker, reporting workflow, automation, and future CRM upload structure.
  • Support future expansion into additional U.S. geographies, construction types, and related Riverbend businesses as approved.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:

Work Experience

  1. At least 3 years of experience in lead research, sales operations, market intelligence, prospect research, data analysis, construction research, or a related B2B function.
  2. Experience evaluating large datasets and converting raw records into prioritized, actionable outputs.
  3. Experience performing investigative research, data validation, exception handling, and contact enrichment.
  4. Experience supporting U.S.-based stakeholders or construction/HVAC/manufacturing environments is preferred.
  5. Engineering or manufacturing experience is not required; demonstrated analytical judgment is more important.

Technical & Process Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including filtering, sorting, tables, lookups, data cleaning, and large-dataset management.
  • Ability to learn and navigate web-based research and construction-information platforms such as Dodge Construction Network.
  • Ability to interpret project stages, dates, documents, organizational roles, and incomplete or conflicting records.
  • Strong internet and company/contact research capability.
  • Ability to maintain auditable trackers, activity reports, and process documentation.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint and CRM systems is advantageous; experience preparing structured data for CRM upload is preferred.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Critical thinking and investigative curiosity
  • Exceptional attention to detail and data discipline
  • Professional English communication by email and phone
  • Sound judgment and appropriate escalation
  • Confidence working with incomplete information and evolving rules
  • Ownership, accountability, and continuous-improvement mindset
  • Collaboration, coachability, and willingness to challenge assumptions constructively

Work Schedule & Setup

  • Work arrangement: Origo standard arrangement, subject to technical readiness and security approval.
  • Some overlap with Arizona business hours is required for stakeholder calibration and project-status outreach; final schedule is to be confirmed.
  • Arizona local time must be used as the scheduling reference because Arizona does not observe daylight saving time.
  • System access is expected to be web-based; approved Dodge, SharePoint, email, and phone access will be required.
  • Initial work is expected to be a structured pilot/build phase, followed by expanded coverage and ongoing maintenance. Long-term full-time scope remains subject to client confirmation.

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely review of assigned Dodge project records.
  • High completeness and accuracy of required project, company, contact, evidence, and next action fields.
  • Consistent application of approved qualification and disposition rules, with low avoidable rework.
  • Useful, well-supported qualified-project handoffs accepted by client stakeholders.
  • Timely escalation and resolution of contradictory, stale, or incomplete records.
  • Professional and compliant status-validation outreach within the approved role boundary.
  • Successful documentation and stabilization of the operating process and qualification framework.
  • Increasing independence and contribution to reporting, automation, CRM readiness, and future-state scalability.

Job Description:

Job Title: Floral Clerk

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

At Hy-Vee, our floral department helps customers find the perfect arrangement for every occasion, and our Floral Clerks are a vital part of making those moments special. In this role, you'll assist customers with placing orders, create beginning-level floral designs, keep the department stocked and looking beautiful, and deliver the kind of warm, attentive service that keeps our customers coming back.

Whether you're building a balloon bouquet, sending an FTD order, or helping someone choose the perfect bouquet, your work brings joy to people every single day. If you have a creative spirit, enjoy working with people, and take pride in a job well done, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting every customer with a smile and assisting them with placing floral orders in person or over the phone, including completing all required order paperwork

  • Prepare, finish, and replenish product including small floral and greenery arrangements, corsages and boutonnieres, roses, carnations, balloon bouquets, bows, and other floral items

  • Send and retrieve FTD, Teleflora, and computer orders; maintain confidentiality on all orders placed including sender, recipient, order details, and cost

  • Prepare the daily delivery list and deliver orders as needed

  • Unload trucks, place product in appropriate storage areas, check in product, put product away, and process invoices as needed

  • Run the department register, receive payment, and make change as applicable

  • Remove trash in a timely manner and assist with general department upkeep

  • Answer the phone promptly and provide friendly, helpful service to customers who call

  • Follow Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all department and company guidelines

  • Pitch in with other tasks or special projects as they come up

Your Skills

You don't need extensive experience for this role; we'll provide the training you need to succeed. To hit the ground running, you'll need to be able to:

  • Bring commitment to Hy-Vee's mission and a genuine passion for helping customers

  • Solve practical problems and follow instructions carefully in a fast-paced environment

  • Apply math skills including fractions, decimals, and percentages in day-to-day tasks

  • Communicate clearly with customers and co-workers and contribute positively to the team

  • Maintain confidentiality on customer order details including who sent, who received, and order contents

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

​

This is a fast-moving role with significant pressure to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. title: Head of Compliance and Risk (UK)
description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.

Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

title: Senior Strategic Advisor
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior Strategic Advisor - Defense & Intelligence to join our team in Washington, D.C. (On-site).


This role supports the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Intelligence and Security (OUSW[I&S]) by delivering high-level guidance on critical geopolitical priorities. You will help shape defense strategy, interface with senior leadership, and accelerate data-driven decision-making across multiple mission stakeholders.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Provide high-level strategic counsel to senior executives within the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Intelligence and Security (OUSW[I&S]) regarding the oversight of sensitive operations, autonomous architectures, and geopolitical defense priorities.

  • Formulate and coordinate complex legislative proposals, strategy documents, and congressional inquiries, ensuring complete alignment with statutory mandates and departmental objectives.

  • Assess emerging commercial technologies and counter-unmanned systems (C-UXS) across air, ground, and maritime domains, offering data-backed recommendations to enhance the Joint Force's operational lethality and intelligence posture.

  • Prepare comprehensive briefing materials and staff senior-level engagements to accelerate data-driven decision-making for Under Secretary-equivalent leadership.

  • Facilitate interagency coordination and policy execution to streamline intelligence sharing, reduce technical stovepipes, and optimize capability development across multiple mission stakeholders.

  • Lead organizational evaluations and workflow analyses to design improved operational procedures, fostering a unified and efficient support environment for the counter-unmanned systems (C-UXS) Acquisition and Maritime Portfolio.

  • Function as a strategic expert across multiple high-impact assignments, evaluating program performance and recommending major shifts to align with emerging intelligence collection requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or 6+ years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree).

  • 6+ years of experience in defense policy analysis, strategic planning, operations research, or management consulting within the Intelligence Community or Department of War.

  • Experience advising senior military or civilian leadership (e.g., Flag Officers, Senior Executive Service) on intelligence priorities, sensitive activities, and policy development.

  • Demonstrated understanding of interagency coordination, legislative analysis, and the strategic integration of emerging technologies or autonomous platforms.

  • Proven ability to independently plan, lead, and execute major analytical assignments while functioning as a subject matter expert.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to navigate complex interagency dynamics and reduce technical stovepipes across multiple mission stakeholders.

  • Experience with strategic oversight of autonomous architectures and counter-unmanned systems (C-UXS) across multi-domain operations.

  • Advanced knowledge of congressional inquiries and legislative proposals within the Department of War.

  • Proven ability to navigate complex interagency dynamics and reduce technical stovepipes across stakeholders.

  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with a track record of producing high-level reports and briefings for senior decision-makers.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Active TS/SCI.


Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

title: Network Engineer

looking for a strong Network Engineer to join their team to provide needed capacity while their primary network resource is out on leave. This person will be doing a lot of backlog/operational work in addition to the strategy side.

Nice to have technologies include public cloud networking (primarily Azure, including remote access, Prisma connectivity, AVD networking), and High Availability Network Architecture.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform operational analysis of new technologies and recommend necessary changes for architecture and infrastructure design.

• Design, plan, and implement projects, as needed, to support day-to-day production requirements.

• Build foundational capabilities and processes to address network needs in tactical and strategic terms.

• Evaluate existing internal environments and make recommendations for improving the environment.

• Develop, initiate, maintain, and revise policies and procedures for networking solutions, including routers, switches, firewalls, and other networking equipment.

• Experience with overall network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, load balancing, and monitoring.

• Strong understanding of network security, including firewalls, proxies, and VPN.

• Experience configuring and deploying Palo Alto firewalls, routers, and Cisco Meraki switches and access points.

• Configuration of port security.

• Layer 2/3 switching.

• Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) fundamentals.

• Network and application security device configuration and management (e.g., Cisco, Barracuda, Palo Alto, SonicWall).

title: Digital Media Strategist
description:
Overview
The Digital Media Strategist develops, executes, and optimizes digital media strategies that help clients achieve their business objectives. This role combines strategic thinking, analytical decision-making, and hands-on campaign management across multiple digital channels. The Digital Media Strategist works closely with internal teams and clients to deliver high-performing campaigns, uncover growth opportunities, and ensure media investments generate measurable results.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute day-to-day media buying activities, including campaign setup, audience targeting, keyword research, budget management, bid adjustments, testing, and optimization across digital advertising platforms
  • Create and implement strategies for digital media campaigns across search (SEM), display advertising, social media, and video marketing channels
  • Allocate and manage budgets for various campaigns, optimizing spend to maximize ROI
  • Apply financial acumen to budgeting, projections, revenue metrics, and assist with media billing
  • Analyze market data to identify target audiences, ensuring campaigns are tailored to reach the right people
  • Monitor, evaluate, and report on campaign performance using platform metrics and analytics tools, making data-driven decisions to improve results and drive strategy forward
  • Identify opportunities for innovation, experimentation, and growth within digital campaigns
  • Manage internal and external client expectations while ensuring deliverables and deadlines are met
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align media strategy with broader marketing and business goals
  • Stay current on digital media trends, platform updates, industry developments, and best practices
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes and systems

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, business, or related field
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in digital marketing strategy across digital media
  • Agency or client-side digital marketing experience required; agency experience preferred
  • Experience managing digital campaigns across multiple media channels
  • Strong understanding of campaign budgeting, projections, and revenue metrics
  • Hands-on experience managing campaigns within platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, DV360, The Trade Desk, or similar digital advertising platforms
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms like monday.com or similar tools
  • Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills
  • Curious and creative mindset with a passion for marketing, culture, and emerging trends
  • Ability to think strategically across the full marketing spectrum, with a strong understanding of full-funnel marketing and the role paid media plays throughout the customer journey
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and a willingness to take initiative
  • Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Co-op experience is a plus
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, demonstrating strong self-management, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote work

What Success Looks Like

  • Digital media campaigns consistently achieve performance goals and deliver measurable business impact
  • Budgets are managed effectively and optimized to maximize return on investment
  • Campaign recommendations are informed by data, audience insights, and industry best practices
  • Client and internal stakeholders have confidence in media strategy, execution, and reporting
  • Opportunities for innovation, testing, and growth are regularly identified and implemented
  • Projects are delivered on time, with strong attention to quality and detail
  • Clients understand the story behind campaign performance and have confidence in the recommendations provided
  • The Digital Media Strategist contributes positively to team culture and embodies Root+Beta’s values

Growth Opportunities
This role offers long-term growth opportunities within the Digital Media team, including progression to Senior Digital Media Strategist and increased responsibility for strategic planning, client leadership, campaign oversight, mentoring team members, and contributing to the continued growth of Root+Beta's media offerings.

title: Clinical Supervisor - CalAIM Program
description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.

With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.

The Clinical Supervisor is responsible for the clinical supervision, training and evaluation of the Care Management staff participating in the Community Living Services program in collaboration with partner agencies.

Key duties and responsibilities of the position include, but may not be limited to:

  • Participating in the hiring and management of CLS Care Management staff

  • Facilitating day-to-day operations, ensuring appropriate systems are in place

  • Ensuring program and staff compliance with all regulatory requirements

  • Ensuring the delivery of quality care and services.

  • Implementing and monitoring multiple systems, including records, clinical documentation and personnel. Ensures documentation is complete, accurate, and in compliance with regulations and the policies and procedure manual

  • Organizing and conducting regular care planning and supervision

  • Facilitating the orientation and training of all new staff, including joint home visits, supervisory meetings and documentation review

  • Assessing the educational needs of staff; developing and coordinating an education and training plan that assures a high level of skill and competency in the understanding of case management, community resources and family systems

  • Establishing and implementing Quality Assurance mechanisms that measure and maintain high standards of care and programming, including regular chart reviews and peer reviews

  • Developing and maintaining collaborative working relationships and cooperative arrangements with community individuals, groups and organizations; takes advantage of opportunities to educate the public and the community regarding CLS services.

  • Remaining current with changes in Santa Clara County community resources, Medi-Cal and Medicare regulations and procedures that will impact the practice and direction of the program; acts as a resource to CLS staff and IOA staff

  • Ensuring that CLS’ purchase of service funds are used as a last resort and that all community resources and referrals are made prior to the authorization of CLS funds

  • Ensuring that CLS funds are used to prevent institutionalization when there are gaps in client care

  • Providing back-up coverage for clinical staff

  • Working with local universities to secure and to supervise social work interns

  • In collaboration with the Regional Director of CLS, establishing annual goals and objectives relevant to the needs of the programs including planning, developing and evaluating policies and procedures; actively involves staff in the process.

  • Actively participating in, and encouraging actions that promote good public relations with clients, their families and the community

  • Expanding personal knowledge, skill and attitudes specific to care management, family systems, geriatrics and gerontology, addiction and other relevant management or health care issues.

  • May direct and monitor additional smaller programs to adhere to contract guidelines and acceptable clinical standards of practice.

  • Performing other related duties and responsibilities as required


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Masters’ degree in Social Work (M.S.W.) or within a related field

  • Two years’ experience working directly with disabled adults and/or frail seniors

  • Demonstrated ability to supervise intensive care management staff who work with adults with disabilities at risk of hospitalization, present with complex medical conditions, mental health diagnoses, substance abuse, as well as physical rehabilitation needs

  • Demonstrated understanding of behavioral health services and behavioral health interventions

  • Proven previous training of staff as it relates to the population served through CLS

  • Demonstrates understanding of the health and psychosocial needs of this population

  • Proven ability and willingness to provide leadership among peers and mentor junior staff

Compensation

  • Range: $117,000 - $125,000/annual

description:
One North is a digital experience agency that combines curiosity, scale, and agility to shape the future. As part of TEKsystems, a leading provider of business and technology services, we offer boutique solutions to solve complex problems. Our multidisciplinary teams of strategists, designers, and technologists excel in research and discovery, experience strategy, design, experience management, and technology implementation. Whether clients are establishing a vision for an experience or optimizing an existing one, we help businesses understand their audiences, design experiences, maximize technology, and bring their digital ideas to life. The world’s most successful companies rely on us to forge the future through electrifying work that sparks innovation and drives results.

Here’s what the opportunity supported through our TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) Talent Acquisition Team requires:

About You

You’re a Senior Content Strategist with experience leading the full content strategy lifecycle and advanced content strategy engagements. You bring deep content strategy expertise and business acumen– combining both to identify concepts and patterns in complex situations. You’ve been known for solving problems with a pragmatic and practical approach, scaling your impact across the team.

The Opportunity

As our next Senior Content Strategist, you will build and lead content strategy across a portfolio of clients with increased complexity and strategic demand– serving as the Content Strategy subject matter expert across a spectrum of mid- to large-scale projects, with no oversight.

You will drive project implementation and lead advanced content strategy, working across disciplines to bring highly polished, innovative, and transformative digital solutions to life. Although you will not directly manage people, you will regularly drive team camaraderie, bringing empathy to create safe spaces for taking risks and healthy debate.

This role will ideally be based in the Chicago area for a light hybrid onsite/remote work model, but we are open to remote locations across the U.S.

Core Responsibilities

• Develop content strategy and messaging frameworks, editorial calendars, editorial/brand guidelines, content models, and publishing workflows that solve clients’ business and brand challenges.

• Shape and steward the processes, governance, and operational frameworks that translate content strategy into repeatable, scalable execution.

• Search engine optimization (SEO): Develop strategies that raise clients’ digital presence and discoverability within tradition search experiences.

• Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Develop strategies that improve clients’ visibility, legibility, relevance, and discoverability within AI-powered search and large language model (LLM) experiences.

• Create and structure compelling content for websites, collateral, apps, and other digital experiences aligned to clients’ strategic imperatives and vision.

• Conduct content audits and gap analyses.

• Interview subject-matter experts to gather relevant background information.

• Facilitate client discussions, workshops, and presentations with clarity, credibility, and

confidence—guiding stakeholders toward alignment, informed decisions, and actionable outcomes.

• Collaborate across disciplines to create and refine solutions.

• Apply AI to accelerate and deepen strategic work (e.g., research, theme identification, concept exploration), while critically evaluating outputs and implications.

• Collaborate with teammates to assess how AI may enhance or impact a client's business, customers, or employees—surfacing opportunities, risks, and experience considerations.

Power Skills

• Empathy: Internalizes human experiences and perspectives to advocate and drive change

• Business Insight: Applies business and customer knowledge to advance client goals

• Clarity: Operates effectively and creates focus and certainty in the face of ambiguity

• Communication: Delivers effective multi-mode communications with clarity and tact; leads by listening first

• Collaboration: Partners deeply with others to meet shared objectives

• Innovation: Generates and cultivates new ways for clients to be successful

• Motivation: Action-oriented; takes on new opportunities/challenges with energy and enthusiasm

• Resilience: Persistently works toward and realizes desired outcomes, even under tough circumstances

• Adaptability: Pivots or refines approaches in real-time to meet shifting demands of different situations

• Integrity: Has a strong sense of ethical and moral principles and adheres to them consistently

Required Experience

• You bring 5 or more years of content strategy experience; agency or consultancy experience preferred

• You have a bachelor’s degree—preferably related to marketing, communications, or writing/journalism

• You’re familiar with content strategy, messaging and channel strategy frameworks/best practices, SEO/GEO and audience/market research methods and tools; Semrush, GA4, Yougov knowledge a plus

• You’re familiar with content design principles and creating content models and templates

• You’re familiar with content management systems; WordPress and Sitecore knowledge a plus

• You’re conversant in back-end content management, processes, and publishing workflows

• You’re familiar with AI’s potential to augment content work; hands-on proficiency in various AI tools a plus

• Experience in multicultural marketing a plus

*Don’t check all the boxes? We encourage you to apply anyway. We know smarts grow from a breadth of experiences. Don’t disqualify yourself before you have the chance to be considered. We’d love to meet you.

description:

-

At Hy-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.

Job Description:

Job Title: Coffee Lead

Department: Coffee Shop

FLSA: Hourly

Revision Date: 07/2026

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

As the Coffee Lead at Hy-Vee, you'll help keep our Coffee Shop running smoothly while supporting the Department Manager and leading the barista team. You'll make sure every customer gets a fresh, high-quality product and a genuinely warm experience from the moment they walk up to the counter.

If you love coffee, enjoy leading a team, and take pride in delivering great service in a fast-paced environment, this could be a great fit for you.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service by greeting customers warmly, learning their names, and going the extra mile to make every visit a positive one

  • Take customer orders at the counter and over the phone, and assist with finding products and answering questions

  • Ensure food is handled safely and the work area is always clean, neat, and up to department standards

  • Monitor product freshness and appearance throughout your shift and prepare and replenish product as needed

  • Anticipate daily product needs and follow or develop a production list to stay ahead

  • Check in product, put product away, and review invoices as needed

  • Run the department register and process payments where applicable

  • Instruct, assign, and coordinate work for Coffee Shop Baristas

  • Order product and supplies as needed and price products for customers as necessary

  • Remove trash promptly and maintain a clean, organized department

  • Handle confidential information including sales percentages and employee wages with discretion

  • Maintain compliance with Hy-Vee's dress code, hygiene standards, and all company policies

  • Assist in other store areas and take on special projects as needed

  • You'll receive direction and support from: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home, Food Service Director, and Coffee Shop Department Manager

Your Skills

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be able to:

  • Deliver outstanding customer service and motivate your team to do the same

  • Solve practical problems and make sound decisions with a variety of variables

  • Use basic math skills, including fractions, decimals, and percentages

  • Guide and support team members with clear direction and follow-through

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; food safety or sanitation courses encouraged; one year of similar or related experience preferred

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director, Store Manager, Assistant Managers of Store Operations, Perishables, and Health Wellness Home, Food Service Director, and Coffee Shop Department Manager

Direct Reports: Coffee Shop Baristas

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Food safety or sanitation courses encouraged

  • One year of similar or related experience preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in sales, food service, or delivery areas

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to safely use sharp knives and blades for food preparation

  • Where applicable to the role: exposure to heat- and burn-related hazards associated with cooking, baking, or grilling equipment

  • Where applicable to the role: ability to operate a delivery vehicle in accordance with applicable DOT standards

  • Perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

​

Working Environment

This is a fast-moving role in a coffee shop environment. You may frequently encounter cool temperatures, dampness, noise and vibrations from equipment, and daily exposure to cleaning chemicals or solvents. The role also involves working with and around food service equipment including slicers and choppers. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $16.00 to $20.00 depending on experience.

title: USA SCIB Portfolio Management Analyst - CIB Lending
description:
USA SCIB Portfolio Management Analyst - CIB Lending

Country: United States of America

It Starts Here:

Santander is a global leader and innovator in the financial services industry and is evolving from a high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization. Our people are at the heart of this journey and together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible. This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

If you are interested in exploring the possibilities We Want to Talk to You!

The Difference You Make:

The SCIB Portfolio Management Analyst is an entry to early-career individual contributor role within US SCIB COO Lending Solutions responsible for supporting credit spreading, portfolio monitoring, covenant tracking, collateral monitoring, annual and quarterly review preparation and portfolio reporting across SCIB lending portfolios. The role supports multiple products and business lines, including Infrastructure Finance, Structured Finance, Leveraged Finance, Investment Grade corporate lending and GTB-linked credit exposures. Objectives are to 1) provide accurate analytical and administrative support for portfolio monitoring, 2) maintain disciplined tracking of financial reporting, covenants, collateral and review deliverables, and 3) develop foundational expertise in CIB lending lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Credit Spreading and Analysis Support

·Perform financial spreading and basic credit analysis for assigned borrowers using financial statements, internal systems and portfolio management templates.

·Support quarterly and annual review preparation by gathering financials, covenant certificates, collateral data, borrower updates, rating inputs and prior review materials.

·Prepare initial variance analysis, ratio outputs, covenant calculations and portfolio data summaries for review by Associates and Vice Presidents.

2. Monitoring and Tracking

·Maintain trackers for financial statement delivery, covenant certificates, borrowing base certificates, collateral deliverables, insurance requirements, annual reviews, quarterly reviews and other monitoring obligations.

·Identify missing or late deliverables, data inconsistencies and potential exceptions for escalation.

·Update portfolio monitoring tools and shared records accurately and on schedule.

3. Lifecycle and Documentation Support

·Assist with amendment, waiver and lifecycle event tracking by collecting data, maintaining logs and supporting evidence files.

·Coordinate with Transaction Management, Agency, Operations and Portfolio Management colleagues to confirm post-close and ongoing monitoring requirements.

·Support document organization and retrieval for audits, credit reviews, regulatory requests and management reporting.

4. Reporting and Process Support

·Prepare recurring status reports, covenant dashboards, exception trackers and portfolio data extracts under supervision.

·Support data quality reviews, procedure updates, training materials and process improvement initiatives.

·Help maintain organized records for portfolio monitoring and control evidence.

5. Development and Collaboration

·Build knowledge of Infrastructure Finance, Structured Finance, Leveraged Finance, IG and GTB credit products, documentation and monitoring requirements.

·Collaborate with Front Office, Credit, Risk, Agency, Operations, Transaction Management and Finance stakeholders as directed.

·Demonstrate ownership, responsiveness and willingness to learn in a fast-paced CIB lending environment.

Bachelor degree or equivalent work experience. Foundational knowledge of financial statements, credit analysis, Excel and corporate finance. Exposure to banking, credit, lending, infrastructure finance, structured finance, leveraged finance, IG corporate lending or GTB helpful.

Skills:

·Strong Excel, analytical, organizational and written communication skills.

·Ability to perform accurate data entry, financial spreading and basic variance analysis.

·Attention to detail and comfort working with recurring deadlines and trackers.

·Willingness to learn credit systems, covenant tools, loan systems and portfolio reporting processes.

Key Competencies:

·High degree of accuracy and follow-through.

·Curiosity and interest in CIB lending and credit risk.

·Ability to ask good questions and escalate potential issues promptly.

·Collaborative and service-oriented approach.

title: Principal Strategy Architect
description:
Think of TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) as the growth solution for enterprises today. We unleash growth through technology, strategy, design, execution and operations with a customer-first mindset for bold business leaders. We deliver cloud, data and customer experience solutions. Our partnerships with leading cloud, design and business intelligence platforms fuel our expertise. We value deep relationships, dedication to serving others and inclusion. We drive positive outcomes for our people and our business, and we stay true to our commitments and act in harmony with our words. We exist to create significant opportunity for people to achieve fulfillment through career success.

Ready to join us?

Here’s what the opportunity supported through our TGS Talent Acquisition Team requires:

We're looking for a bold, independent thinker who thrives at the intersection of enterprise strategy and architecture. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do — it's for a leader who challenges conventional thinking, brings a distinct point of view, and drives outcomes without hesitation.

You connect strategy to execution. You build frameworks that resonate. You walk into a C-suite conversation without a safety net and say something worth hearing — then back it up. You listen first, then lead. You develop the people around you. And when the engagement ends, the client knows exactly what they got and wants more.

Responsibilities

Strategic Consulting, Problem Structuring & Executive Presence

You get beneath the surface. You don't take the stated problem at face value — you dig until you understand what's actually driving it, then you build a framework that makes it solvable. And you do all of it in the room, without a safety net.

• Problem Structuring: Rapidly decompose complex, ambiguous client problems into structured frameworks and actionable recommendations — without waiting for direction.

• Problem Structuring: Assess client landscapes with depth and rigor — identifying gaps, opportunities, and maturity levels — and translate findings into strategic direction tied to real business outcomes.

• Strategy to Execution: Connect enterprise strategy to execution through architecture, roadmaps, and sequenced plans that clients can actually follow.

• Outcomes: Translate every engagement into a concrete next step — a roadmap, an artifact, a scoped SOW. Never open-ended dialogue that goes nowhere.

• Executive Presence: Walk into C-suite and board-level conversations independently — credible, prepared, and without senior cover.

• Executive Presence: Command the room through credibility and preparation, not title. Make complex ideas land with any audience.

• Facilitation: Design and lead high-impact workshops — from executive alignment and strategy sessions to working sessions that produce decisions, artifacts, and prioritized next steps.

• Facilitation: Bring business and IT into the same room and make sure they leave speaking the same language.

• POV: Bring an independent, defensible point of view grounded in domain authority. Tell clients what they need to hear, not just what they want to hear.

Enterprise Architecture

You think in systems. You know how business capability and technology architecture connect, and you use that lens to help clients make better decisions — faster.

• Apply Enterprise Architecture frameworks pragmatically — not just theoretically. You know the frameworks and know when to flex them.

• Assess current-state architecture honestly and define target-state with clarity, charting a pragmatic path between the two.

• Develop architecture artifacts — capability models, value stream maps, integration diagrams, operating model designs — as strategic consulting tools, not documentation exercises.

• Design target-state architectures built for where the business is going, spanning application, data, integration, and AI layers.

• Connect architecture decisions to financial and operational impact — making the business case clear and defensible to both technical and executive audiences.

• Stay current on modern architecture patterns — cloud-native design, API-led integration, event-driven architecture, AI-ready infrastructure — and know when each is the right tool for the job.

AI Strategy & Solution Architecture

You know what's real and what's hype. You help clients cut through the noise, make smart AI investment decisions, and build the foundations to move beyond proof-of-concept into something that actually scales.

• Design and architect AI-enabled enterprise solutions — buildable, adoptable, and grounded in client context, not generic blueprints.

• Identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases based on feasibility, ROI, and strategic alignment — and pressure-test them before recommending pursuit.

• Help clients evaluate platform and tooling options across foundation model providers, enterprise AI platforms, and MLOps infrastructure — and make sound build vs. buy vs. partner decisions.

• Bring fluency in enterprise AI architecture: RAG, agentic workflows, model fine-tuning tradeoffs, and AI-ready data infrastructure — credible with tech teams and able to translate it into recommendations that land with executives.

• AI Governance: Develop governance models and responsible AI frameworks — risk, regulatory considerations, and ethical guardrails — built in from the start, not bolted on after.

• Change & Adoption: Recognize that technology delivery alone does not create value. Advise on the organizational and behavioral side of AI adoption — ensuring change and enablement are part of every AI engagement.

Commercial Acumen, Business Development & Team Leadership

You grow the practice — externally through client relationships and new work, internally by raising the bar on the people around you.

• Business Development: Actively grow accounts — identify revenue opportunities and initiate conversations about new work without prompting.

• Business Development: Write statements of work, scope and price engagements independently — you own the commercial side without needing a handler.

• Business Development: Navigate enterprise sales conversations without senior cover — qualify, shape, and advance opportunities to a close.

• Business Development: Contribute to proposals, pursuit efforts, and practice go-to-market positioning.

• Team Leadership: Develop junior consultants and architects — give direct feedback, share your thinking, and hold a high quality bar.

• Team Leadership: Run high-performing engagement teams — set clear direction, manage quality, and ensure client outcomes are met.

• Team Leadership: Model what Principal-level looks like — self-direction, intellectual curiosity, bias toward action, and accountability for outcomes.

• Practice Building: Contribute to offering development, internal knowledge sharing, and capability frameworks that make the practice stronger.

Qualifications

Experience & Background

• 10+ years in management consulting, strategic IT consulting, enterprise architecture, or equivalent senior roles with breadth — across strategy, architecture, technology, and client-facing consulting.

• Management consulting experience preferred — you know how to structure a problem, build a framework, and deliver work clients will act on.

• Deep, applied experience in enterprise and solution architecture — not just advisory familiarity. You have designed things that got built.

• Proven track record at Principal or equivalent level: you have owned client relationships, led engagements, and grown accounts without supervision.

• You are a self-starter — you lead and drive next steps without waiting for direction.

• You are an exceptional communicator — in writing and in person. You adapt your message to your audience without dumbing it down or losing the substance.

• You collaborate across groups — delivery, sales, practice leadership, and client stakeholders — without losing momentum.

• Advanced degree (MBA, Master's) strongly preferred; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field required.

Technical Depth

• You have command of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (TOGAF or equivalent) and apply them in practice, not just reference them in decks.

• Broad technology depth across one or more of: data platforms, cloud infrastructure, systems integration, process architecture, AI/ML platforms.

• You can go deep with architects and engineers, then walk into a boardroom and make the same ideas land with a CEO. That range is not optional — it is the job.

• Fluency in enterprise AI architecture: RAG, agentic workflows, model fine-tuning tradeoffs, and AI-ready data infrastructure.

• Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native data, analytics, and AI services.

Desirable Certifications

• Enterprise Architecture: TOGAF or equivalent; Archimate (The Open Group); FEAF / DoDAF.

• AI & Data: AI practitioner credentials — platform-specific (Azure AI Engineer, Google Professional ML Engineer, AWS Certified ML) or vendor certifications such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent emerging AI platforms.

• IT Service & Operations: ITIL 4 Strategic Leader or equivalent.

• Process & Quality: Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent).

• Change & Adoption: Prosci Change Management Certification or OCM equivalent.

• Business Analysis: CBAP (IIBA) or BIZBOK.

Travel

5–25% travel depending on client engagement model. In-person presence required for key workshops, assessments, and client solutioning sessions.

This is a Permanent position based out of Chicago, IL.

description:
About Us

IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel companies in the world and one of the world’s leading hotel and resort companies with a family of 21 brands. Our purpose – True Hospitality for Good – comes to life in every one of our collections. With luxury and lifestyle, we are taking it to new heights.

Five visionary brands - InterContinental, Regent Hotels, Six Senses, Vignette Collection and Kimpton Hotels - make up our luxury collection. Individually, they are icons. Together, they bring unforgettable and unparalleled experiences to travelers in over 430 hotels and resorts in 100 countries around the world.

Having recently added a host of incredible properties to our portfolio, we now stand as one of the world’s leading luxury operators. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests unforgettable and unparalleled experiences.

About the hotel

A luxurious hotel destination at The Wharf on D.C.’s Waterfront, the InterContinental Washington D.C. – The Wharf in the reimagined Wharf neighborhood brings sophistication to its contemporary style. Perfectly placed on the beautiful Potomac River, InterContinental Washington D.C. – The Wharf enjoys the most incredible waterfront views of D.C. Steps away from America’s political epicenter, the hotel embraces guests with an exquisitely curated resort destination that reignites the river’s edge and a captivating sanctuary in the center of The Wharf neighborhood, paying homage to the maritime and industrial-working heritage of its setting. Featuring a relaxing seasonal rooftop pool with striking Potomac River views and the indulging full-service spa, The Spa at The Wharf, modern luxury, culture, and a rich history combine in the Wharf neighborhood to create a perfect atmosphere for guests and locals alike.

About the Receiving Clerk position

We are searching for an efficient, detail-oriented Receiving Clerk to manage all incoming shipments. You will inspect deliveries, verify quantities against purchase orders, and enter inventory data into our system. Your main goal is to ensure all incoming stock is accurate, undamaged, and stored correctly.

A little taste of your day-to-day

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

  • Receive, unload and inspect packages and check for broken or missing items.

  • Verify paperwork and match delivery slips and packing lists to original purchase orders.

  • Record and log incoming stock into inventory software or digital databases.

  • Organize stock and place items in appropriate storage areas.

  • Handle and prepare damaged or wrong items to go back to vendors.

What we need from you

  • Communication skills

  • Your problem-solving skills will turn issues into opportunities

  • Fluency in the local language - extra language skills would be great, but not essential

  • Literate and tech-savvy - you’ll need a good grasp of reading, writing, basic math and computer skills

What you can expect from us

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401k, and many other benefits to eligible employees.

title: Controls Technician
description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Controls Technician

About the Role

The Controls Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting building automation and process control systems that are critical to CVI Laser Optics' manufacturing operations. This role supports reliable environmental controls, facility utilities, cleanroom monitoring, and equipment control systems within a precision manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, program, troubleshoot, and maintain building automation and control systems supporting HVAC, cleanroom, environmental monitoring, utilities, and manufacturing operations.
  • Install, wire, configure, and commission controllers, sensors, actuators, and other field devices using industrial communication protocols such as BACnet and Modbus TCP/IP.
  • Support PLC and automation systems, including troubleshooting control logic, inputs/outputs, communications, and equipment interfaces.
  • Diagnose and repair electrical and controls issues involving low-voltage wiring and 24V/120V control circuits.
  • Perform preventive maintenance on control panels, controllers, sensors, instrumentation, and associated equipment.
  • Support calibration and verification of environmental and process instrumentation, including temperature, humidity, differential pressure, and particle monitoring devices.
  • Monitor system alarms, trends, and operating data to identify issues and support proactive maintenance and reliability improvements.
  • Maintain controls documentation, including points lists, network architecture, control drawings, system backups, equipment records, and changes to sequences of operation.
  • Document work orders, preventive maintenance, and repairs within the site's CMMS.
  • Partner with Facilities, Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, and external vendors on equipment installations, system integrations, cleanroom monitoring improvements, and capital projects.
  • Respond to facility and equipment issues that could impact production, product quality, safety, or environmental conditions.
  • Follow applicable safety procedures, cleanroom requirements, and site standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 3–5 years of experience with building automation, industrial controls, instrumentation, or similar automation systems in a manufacturing, industrial, cleanroom, or commercial environment.
  • Technical education, certification, apprenticeship, or training in controls, automation, electrical, instrumentation, or a related field is a plus.
  • Experience in cleanroom, semiconductor, optical, aerospace, medical device, or other precision manufacturing environments is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of PLCs, control logic, and industrial automation systems.
  • Knowledge of building automation or SCADA platforms such as Niagara, Ignition, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols, including BACnet and Modbus TCP/IP.
  • Strong electrical and controls troubleshooting skills.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical drawings, control schematics, wiring diagrams, sequences of operation, and technical documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Working knowledge of preventive maintenance and equipment reliability practices.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work, and respond effectively to equipment or facility issues.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

  • Regular work in a manufacturing and cleanroom environment, including required cleanroom gowning and contamination-control practices.
  • Exposure to manufacturing equipment, moving mechanical parts, electrical systems, chemicals, fumes or airborne particles, and elevated noise levels.
  • Work may involve varying temperatures and indoor and outdoor conditions while supporting facility and equipment needs.
  • Required personal protective equipment must be worn based on the work being performed.
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, crouching, climbing, and use of hands and tools to perform maintenance and repair work.
  • Work at heights, on ladders, and in confined or limited-access spaces may be required.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds as needed.


Additional Requirement:

Certain positions with IDEX Corporation and its business units require access to controlled goods and technologies subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations or the Export Administration Regulations. Applicants for these positions may need to be "U.S. Persons," as defined in these regulations. Generally, a "U.S. Person" is a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or an individual who has been granted refugee or asylum status.

title: Data Scientist - Finance AI & Analytics
description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: No

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Insights & Intelligence (i2) is seeking a Data Scientist to join Northrop Grumman’s Finance AI & Analytics organization. This position will support the Business Management function, and the selected candidate will report to the Manager, Finance AI & Analytics.

The location for this position is Falls Church, VA with the opportunity for a 100% virtual/telework arrangement. The role can be hired as a Level 3 or Level 4, based on the incumbent's education and experience.

At Northrop Grumman, Finance AI & Analytics is a core domain within our Insights & Intelligence (i2) organization. As part of our Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO), i2 works with all enterprise domains and businesses to drive our data, analytics & AI transformation.

Insights and Intelligence (i2) Solutions is a team of data scientists, behavioral research scientists, insight analysts, data engineers, and technologists who use science to drive insight and data strategy within the business. As a member of Finance AI & Analytics, you will be responsible for guiding the organization with strategic analysis and providing meaning behind data.

As a data scientist, you will be responsible for developing and scaling models to approximate our complex business and potential future scenarios to ultimately help answer “what if…?” questions. You will be curious, detail-oriented, and ethically conscious. You are a creative problem-solver who can determine appropriate methodologies to apply to unique data applications. You think architecturally about the business management domain to comprehensively solve Enterprise problems at scale. You want to drive positive change and are candid and collaborative in taking on our most difficult analytics projects as well as the process and culture changes that accompanies them.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop statistical and machine learning models with a modeling & simulation lens to help quantify and reduce future uncertainty across various scenarios

  • Build well-structured and understandable code to enable smooth collaboration across the team and successful model deployment

  • Serve as a trusted technical expert who can offer informed guidance on methodology or technology decisions and communicate core requirements to our technology teams

  • Mentor junior team members by providing guidance on best practices in data science

  • Stay abreast of industry trends and methodologies and contribute innovative ideas to drive business value

Basic Qualifications for Level 3:

  • PhD with 1 years of related professional experience OR Master’s degree and 3 years of related professional experience OR bachelor’s degree and 5 years of related professional experience

Basic Qualifications for Level 4:

  • PhD with 3 years of related professional experience OR Master’s degree and 6 years of related professional experience OR bachelor’s degree and 8 years of related professional experience

Additional Basic Qualifications for both levels:

  • Must have deep foundational knowledge of statistical modeling and machine learning concepts

  • Must have expertise with Python (at least 4 years)

  • Must have proficiency with data transformation using SQL or similar data querying language

  • Must have experience using version software control (e.g. git) with a team of collaborators

  • Must have experience using cloud-based data science tools – i.e. AWS, Azure, DataBricks, Spark/PySpark

  • Fluency in translating business problems into questions that can be answered via analytic methods

  • Experience collaborating on projects with multiple teams, managing relationships, and communicating findings to audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree in a quantitative field (engineering, mathematics, statistics, computer science, etc.) is preferred

  • Experience with Monte Carlo simulation, time series modeling, or probabilistic modeling

  • Proven experience putting models into production

  • Experience interfacing and presenting to executive audiences

  • Experience with finance- or business management-related data

Primary Level Salary Range: $113,900.00 - $170,900.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $142,200.00 - $213,200.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results.
